spell.name: Absorb Weapon
entries: You touch a weapon with the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property that isn't being worn or carried by another creature, and it sinks harmlessly into your arm. Coatings such as poison stay on it, and so do any magical properties it has. While absorbed, the weapon doesn't hinder your movement, can't be felt beneath your skin, and can't be found by any physical search. {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} and similar magic reveal an aura of transmutation on the spot where it lies, which shows only as a faint, weapon-shaped blotch on your skin.

You can draw the weapon whenever you could normally draw a weapon, including as part of an attack. You draw it by touching the blotch. The weapon then appears in your hand and the spell ends. The first attack roll you make with the weapon before the end of that turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, provided the target didn't see you absorb it.
When the spell ends for any other reason, the weapon appears in your hand. If your hand is full, it appears at your feet instead.

A sentient weapon can resist this spell with a successful Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. Other weapons get no save. You can have only one weapon absorbed at a time. If you cast this spell again, the earlier weapon appears in your hand.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 2+ spell slot, the weapon can be any weapon that lacks the {@itemProperty H|XPHB|Heavy} and {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} properties.

spell.name: Absorption
entries: For the duration, you soak up hostile magic and store its energy. When you cast this spell, the DM secretly rolls {@dice 1d4 + 6}; the result is the number of spell levels the spell can absorb.

Whenever you are the only target of another creature's spell, the spell is absorbed if its level (treat a cantrip as level 1) is no higher than the number of levels the spell can still absorb. An absorbed spell has no effect on you, its level is subtracted from the remaining total, and that many levels of energy are stored within you. Spells that affect an area, and spells delivered by touch, can't be absorbed.

If a targeting spell's level exceeds the remaining total, the spell instead partially breaks against the ward: you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any saving throw against it and take only half damage from it, the remaining total drops to 0, and that many levels are stored.

{@b Stored Energy.} When you cast a spell of level 1+ while you have stored levels, you can expend stored levels equal to the spell's level instead of a spell slot (the spell is cast at that level, maximum 9). You must still provide any Material components the spell requires. Stored levels you haven't used vanish when this spell ends.

spell.name: Abyssal Army
entries: You call a pack of demons from the Abyss to serve you. When you finish casting the spell, {@dice 2d4} {@creature Dretch|XMM|Dretches} appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range. Ten minutes later, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Barlgura|XMM|Barlguras} appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the point where the first creatures appeared, and ten minutes after that, one {@creature Vrock|XMM} appears in the same way. Each demon has the maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for its stat block.

The demons are allies to you and your allies, and no other effect can take control of them while the spell lasts. In combat, the demons share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but they take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can dismiss any number of the demons you can see. Each demon disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creatures can't willingly move more than 200 feet from the point where the first wave appeared.

spell.name: Accelerated Movement
entries: Until the spell ends, you move nimbly without slowing down, gaining the following benefits:

items: Climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement.
Moving through nonmagical {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement.
Traveling at a Normal or Fast pace doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

spell.name: Acid Breath

components.m: a handful of fire ants, alive or dead

entries: You exhale a spray of acidic droplets. Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Acid Sheath

m.text: a handful of fire ants and a glass sculpture of a humanoid worth 50+ GP

entries: A translucent sheath of acid coats your body for the duration. It doesn't harm you or hinder your breathing or spellcasting, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid damage.

Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes {@damage 2d8} Acid damage. A creature that starts its turn {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you, or grappling you, also takes {@damage 2d8} Acid damage.
In addition, whenever you cast a spell that deals Acid damage, the spell deals 1 extra Acid damage for each of its damage dice.

spell.name: Acid Storm
entries: A dark green cloud whirls into being and unleashes a downpour of acid rain in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d6} Acid damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Aiming at the Target
entries: You steel your focus on a spell you are already maintaining. You can cast this spell only while you have the {@status Concentration|XPHB} on another spell, and casting it doesn't break that Concentration.

Until this spell ends, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws you make to maintain Concentration on that spell. This spell ends early if your Concentration on that spell ends.

spell.name: Air Breathing

components.m: a short reed or piece of straw

entries: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe air until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

spell.name: Allegro

components.m: a tail feather from a bird of prey

entries: Blue motes burst from you and settle on your companions. Choose up to six creatures (you can include yourself) in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Each target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 30 feet until the spell ends, to a maximum of double its normal Speed. Targets keep this benefit even if they leave the Emanation.

spell.name: Amanuensis
entries: Choose a source of writing you can see within range, such as a book or letter, and a blank book, sheet of paper, or piece of parchment within range. For the duration, the spell copies the source's nonmagical text onto the blank surface at a rate of about 250 words per minute, creating a perfect duplicate of the text. Illustrations aren't copied, and neither is magical writing, such as the text of a spellbook, a spell scroll, or a {@spell Glyph of Warding|XPHB}; where such writing would appear, the copy is left blank. Any magical trap keyed to reading or touching the source's writing is triggered, but not copied.

When a page fills, the spell turns to the next blank page, if any. If it runs out of blank pages, it stops copying. While the spell lasts, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to redirect it to a new source, a new blank surface, or to resume an interrupted copy.
The spell doesn't translate the text. If you can't read the original, you can't read the copy.

spell.name: Amorphous Form
entries: A willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, slumps into a boneless, oozelike form for the duration. The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or if it takes a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to end the spell on itself.

While in this form, the target can move through any space as narrow as 2 inches without squeezing, it gains a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and it doesn't need to breathe. It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions, it can't be shape-shifted by other effects, and any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against it becomes a normal hit.

The target's gear melds into its form: armor it wears grants no benefit to its {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, and it can't use or benefit from its magic items. The target can't talk, manipulate objects, attack, or cast spells.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Amplify
entries: You magnify every sound within a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point, an object, or a creature within range. If you center the spell on an object or a creature, the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} moves with it. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw; on a success, the spell has no effect.

For the duration, sounds made inside the area carry as if they were much louder: you and other creatures within 300 feet of the area can hear normal speech in it clearly and whispers as if they were normal speech, and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks made to hear sounds in the area have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. Creatures in the area don't notice the amplification.
If you cast this spell so that its area overlaps the area of a {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell, both spells end.

spell.name: Analyze Portal

components.m: a crystal lens and a small mirror

entries: When you cast this spell, you learn the size and location of each magical portal in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, including one created by {@spell Gate|XPHB}. For the duration, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to study one such portal you can see, learning the next of the following properties in order:

items.name: Activation
entries: Any key, command word, or other trigger needed to activate the portal.

items.name: Circumstances
entries: Any special circumstances governing the portal's use, such as specific times when it can be activated.

items.name: Direction
entries: Whether the portal is one-way or two-way.

items.name: Destination
entries: You glimpse the area where the portal leads, seeing up to 60 feet into it until the end of your next turn as if you stood at the portal's other end. Other divination spells and effects can't extend through the portal this way.

The spell reveals unusual portals only in part. For a portal that functions at random, you learn that it's random and whether it can be activated now. For a portal with variable destinations, you learn only its current destination. For a portal that sends creatures and their equipment to different places, you learn only where creatures go. For a malfunctioning portal, you learn that it malfunctions, but not how.

spell.name: Anger of the Noonday Sun
entries: Your body erupts with the light of the midday sun in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. This light is sunlight. Each creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that can see you makes a Constitution saving throw. A creature that has Sunlight Sensitivity or that is harmed by sunlight, such as a vampire, has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this save. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A {@condition Blinded|XPHB} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Each Ooze, Undead, or fungus creature (such as a {@creature Violet Fungus|XMM}) in the area, whether or not it can see you, also takes {@damage 8d6} Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Animate Breath
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} to cast this spell. When you cast it, you expend one use of your Breath Weapon (or {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} ends), and your exhalation coalesces into a living elemental in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. Its damage type is that of the breath: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

The elemental uses the {@creature Fire Elemental|XMM} stat block, with these changes: it is Huge; it deals damage of the breath's type instead of Fire damage; it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the breath's damage type and Poison damage instead of Fire and Poison; it doesn't cause creatures or objects to start {@hazard burning|XPHB}; and it lacks the Water Susceptibility trait. It sheds light only if its damage type is Fire or Lightning.

The elemental is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger. It disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Animate Fire

components.m: a handful of charcoal, sulfur, and soda ash

entries: Choose a nonmagical fire you can see within range that is at least as large as a campfire. Part of it rises into a Small, vaguely humanoid form of living flame for the duration. The form is an effect, not a creature, and it occupies no space.

When it animates, the form moves up to 30 feet, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Fire damage. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the form up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.

The form can't move more than 60 feet away from its source fire, and the spell ends early if the source fire goes out or if the form enters water. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB} if the form touches them, and it sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Animate Snow
entries: Snow within a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range draws together with an audible crunch, forming either two Large or one Huge vaguely humanoid figure in unoccupied spaces in the area. Each figure is a Construct that uses the {@creature Animated Object|XPHB} stat block, with these changes: its Slam deals Bludgeoning damage instead of Force damage plus an extra {@damage 1d6} Cold damage, and it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage. If the temperature around a figure is above freezing, it loses {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns as it melts.

Each figure is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the figures share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count and take their turns immediately after yours. Until the spell ends, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mentally command any of them within 500 feet of you, issuing the same command to each one. If you issue no commands, a figure takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves only to avoid harm. When a figure drops to 0 Hit Points or the spell ends, it collapses into ordinary snow.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Slam damage of each figure increases by {@damage 1d6} (Large) or {@damage 1d12} (Huge) for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Animate Water

components.m: a vial of spring water mixed with cinnabar oil

entries: Choose a body of nonmagical water you can see within range that fills at least a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. Part of it rises into a Small, vaguely humanoid form of living water for the duration. The form is an effect, not a creature, and it occupies no space.

When it animates, the form moves up to 30 feet, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Bludgeoning damage. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the form up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.

The form can't move more than 60 feet away from its source water. The form extinguishes nonmagical flames it touches, and a creature hit by its attack can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the start of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Animate Wood

components.m: powdered cinnabar and a ground peach pit

entries: You touch a nonmagical wooden object that is Small or smaller and isn't being worn or carried, such as a stool, branch, or crate. The object twists into a crude, mobile shape that animates for the duration. It is an object, not a creature, and has AC 15 and 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}; if it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.

When it animates, the form moves up to 30 feet, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Bludgeoning or Piercing damage. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the form up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.
The spell ends early if the object is ever more than 60 feet away from you. Damage dealt to the object by fire or other means can destroy it as normal.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Anticipate Teleportation

m.text: a tiny platinum-and-crystal hourglass worth 500+ GP, which the target must carry for the duration

entries: You touch a willing creature, surrounding it with an invisible 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that anticipates teleportation. Whenever a creature teleports into the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} by any means, the warded creature instantly learns the exact space where the creature will arrive, its size, and the number and sizes of any creatures arriving with it.

The arrival is then delayed: the teleporting creature arrives at the start of its next turn. It doesn't perceive the delay. The warded creature can share what it learned with others, giving them time to prepare.

If a creature intends to teleport into the area but would arrive outside it instead, the warded creature learns only that a creature tried to teleport in, and the arrival is delayed as normal. A creature teleporting away from the area isn't affected unless its destination is also within the area.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 5+ spell slot, the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is 60 feet, the warded creature also learns the creature type of each arriving creature, and the arrival is delayed until the start of the teleporting creature's third turn after it teleported (about 18 seconds later).

spell.name: Anticold Sphere
entries: A rosy, warm glow extends from you in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration. While in the aura, you and other creatures have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage.

The aura also hedges out creatures of elemental cold. A creature that has Immunity to Cold damage, other than you, can't pass or reach through the aura's edge, though it can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through it. When you cast the spell, each such creature inside the aura is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside it.
If you move so that a hedged-out creature is forced to pass through the aura's edge, the spell ends.

spell.name: Antidragon Aura

m.text: a chunk of platinum worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Up to three creatures of your choice within range are bathed in a white aura patterned with silver scales. For the duration, each target has a +2 bonus to AC against attack rolls made by Dragons and a +2 bonus to saving throws against the breath weapons, spells, and other effects of Dragons.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Antimagic Ray

m.text: iron filings mixed with ruby dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: An invisible ray springs from your fingertips toward a creature or an object you can see within range.

A target creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is wrapped in antimagic for the duration. It can't cast spells, take {@action Magic|XPHB} actions, or use other magical abilities, and spells and other magical effects can't target or otherwise affect it. Ongoing spells and magical effects already affecting it are suppressed; while suppressed, an effect doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration. Magic items the creature wears or carries are unaffected, and the creature can still use them, though their effects can't affect the creature itself. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

A target object has its magical properties suppressed for the duration, including any spells affecting it, and spells and magical effects can't target it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, that creature makes the Wisdom saving throw for the object, and the object repeats the save in the same way. An unattended object gets no save.
The spell affects only the target. Other creatures and objects, including the equipment of a target creature, are unaffected. {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can end this spell normally.

spell.name: Anyspell
entries: Throughout the casting, you study a spellbook or a {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} you are holding and channel divine power into one spell it contains. Choose a spell of level 1 or 2 from the Wizard spell list that is written in the book or stored in the scroll. If you chose a spell from a {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG}, the scroll crumbles to dust when the casting ends; a spellbook is unharmed.

You hold the chosen spell in your mind until you cast it or you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. While you hold it, you can cast it once without expending a spell slot, at its normal level. It counts as a Cleric spell for you and uses your spellcasting ability. You must still provide any components it requires, though your Holy Symbol can serve as its {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} unless the component has a cost specified.
You can hold only one spell in this way. If you cast this spell again before casting the held spell, the held spell is lost.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 6+ spell slot, you can choose a spell of level 1 through 5 from the Wizard spell list.

spell.name: Appraising Touch
entries: You encircle your eye with your thumb and forefinger, and objects near you come into sharp focus. For the duration, whenever you spend 1 minute handling an object, you learn its approximate market value, within 10 percent of its true worth. This works for coins, gems, art objects, trade goods, and other objects.
This spell doesn't reveal an object's magical properties. If the object is a magic item, you learn only the value of its materials and craftsmanship, and that it is worth more than that.
You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) checks to tell whether someone is misrepresenting the value of an object you've appraised with this spell.

spell.name: Arc of Lightning
entries: Choose two creatures you can see within range. A crackling bolt of lightning forms a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} between them, running from a point in one creature's space to a point in the other's. Each of the two creatures and each other creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Armor of Darkness
entries: You touch a willing creature and envelop it in a shroud of flickering shadows. For the duration, the target gains a +2 bonus to AC, has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other effects that deal Radiant damage. The shroud doesn't hinder the target's vision.
If the target is Undead, it also has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Arrow Mind
entries: The bow in your hand becomes an extension of your body. For the duration, while you are holding a {@item Shortbow|XPHB} or {@item Longbow|XPHB}, you gain the following benefits:

items: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your ranged attack rolls with the bow.
You can make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} with the bow, making a ranged attack with it against a creature that leaves your reach.

spell.name: Arrow Storm
entries: Your bow glows blue and feels as light as a feather. As part of casting this spell, you make one ranged attack with a {@item Shortbow|XPHB} or {@item Longbow|XPHB} you are holding against each of up to five creatures of your choice that you can see within the weapon's normal range. Each attack uses a separate piece of ammunition, and you make a separate attack roll for each target. On a hit, a target takes the weapon's normal damage.

spell.name: Arrow of Bone

m.text: a sliver of bone and a vial of oil worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You scribe necromantic runes onto a piece of ammunition or a weapon with the {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} property, and it turns into an identical item made of cold bone. For the duration, the item counts as a magic weapon.

The first time the item is used to make a ranged attack roll, the spell is discharged and the item is destroyed, whether the attack hits or misses. If the attack hits a creature, the target takes the attack's normal damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 7d8 + 30} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this Necrotic damage dies. Constructs and Undead are unaffected by the Necrotic damage.
If the spell ends before the item is used, the item reverts to its original material.

spell.name: Aspect of the Earth Hunter

components.m: a fragment of a bulette's armored shell

entries: Your face lengthens into a snout, your limbs thicken, and your skin hardens into silvery chitin as you take on the aspect of a {@creature Bulette|XMM}. For the duration, you can't speak or cast spells, and your gear melds into your new form; you can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment. You retain your other game statistics and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Armored Hide.
entries: You gain 30 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, which vanish when the spell ends, and your AC can't be lower than 17.

items.name: Bulk.
entries: Your size becomes Large if you were smaller and there is room for you to grow, and your Strength score becomes 19 unless it is higher.

items.name: Burrower.
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 40 feet unless it is higher, and you gain a {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} of 20 feet. You also gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} and {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

items.name: Claws.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your claws, it deals {@damage 2d8} Slashing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional claw attack as part of that action.

items.name: Deadly Leap.
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can spend 5 feet of movement to leap to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you. Each creature of your choice within 5 feet of the space where you land makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Aspect of the Wolf
entries: With a howl, you drop to all fours as your body sprouts thick fur and your limbs shorten into a wolf's. For the duration, you can't speak or cast spells, and your gear melds into your new form; you can't use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment. You retain your other game statistics and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Lupine Stride.
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 50 feet unless it is higher.

items.name: Keen Senses.
entries: You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

items.name: Bite.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your fangs, it deals {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls. Once on each of your turns when you hit a Medium or smaller creature with your bite, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spell.name: Attune Form

components.m: a bit of stone or earth from your home plane

entries: You touch up to three willing creatures and attune them to the plane you are currently on for the duration.

Each target is protected from the natural environment of whatever plane of existence it is on. This includes extreme heat or cold, damage the plane itself deals (such as the searing heat of the Elemental Plane of Fire or the life-draining chill of a negatively charged plane), blinding or overwhelming positive or negative energy, poisonous or unbreathable air (a target can breathe normally even underwater or encased in earth), and the deafening winds of planes such as Pandemonium. The DM determines which environmental effects of a plane the spell negates.

The spell doesn't protect against creatures, spells, or other magic, nor against a plane's gravity, its effects on magic, or the traits that trap or influence travelers who linger (such as the hold of Elysium or the despair of the Gray Waste). It also doesn't protect against unusual local hazards: a target can survive on the Elemental Plane of Earth, but it still burns if it walks into a pool of magma there.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Augment Familiar
entries: You empower your familiar, making it quicker, sturdier, and stronger. Choose your familiar (such as one summoned by {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}) within range. For the duration, it gains the following benefits:

items: It gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. When the spell ends, it loses any of them that remain.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks and saving throws.
It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Aura Against Flame
entries: A cool, blue mist clings to your body for the duration. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage.
Any nonmagical flame no larger than a campfire that touches the mist, such as a torch or a flask of burning oil hurled at you, is extinguished and deals no damage to you.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch a magical fire created by a spell, such as {@spell Wall of Fire|XPHB} or {@spell Flaming Sphere|XPHB}. If the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used to cast this spell, the fire spell ends. Otherwise, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability ({@dc 10} plus that spell's level); on a success, the fire spell ends. If the fire spell ends, this spell also ends, and you take no damage from touching the fire. On a failure, both spells continue, and you take any damage the fire would normally deal for touching it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration increases to 1 hour with a level 2+ spell slot.

spell.name: Aura of Evasion

m.text: powdered emerald worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: A silver-green nimbus surrounds you in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration. Whenever you or another creature in the aura makes a saving throw against a Breath Weapon (or a similar exhalation, at the DM's discretion) that deals half damage on a successful save, the creature instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails.
A creature in the aura that already has the Evasion feature or a similar trait has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on such saving throws.

spell.name: Aura of Glory
entries: Soft golden light radiates from you as you invoke your oath. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you, including yourself, ends the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition on itself and gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 3 for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Aura of Terror
entries: Violet light wreathes you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration, granting you a terrifying presence akin to a dragon's.

Once on each of your turns, when you make an attack roll or cast a spell, each creature of your choice in the aura that can see you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition while it is in the aura. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on any save against this spell is immune to it for 24 hours.

spell.name: Avascular Mass
entries: You fire a black ray of necromantic energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 8d10} Necrotic damage as its blood vessels violently burst from its skin, and it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead are unaffected by the spell.

If the ray hits, the purged vessels erupt into a writhing, adhesive mass that fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the target and lasts for the duration. The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition while in the mass. Each other creature in the Sphere when it appears must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition while in the mass. A creature that enters the mass for the first time on a turn must also make this save.

The mass is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. A creature behind at least 5 feet of the mass has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover}, and a creature behind 20 feet of it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}.

A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the mass can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it is no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB}. When the spell ends, the mass collapses into limp, decaying tissue.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d10|8-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 8.

spell.name: Avasculate
entries: You fire a black ray of necromantic energy at a creature within range, causing it to violently purge blood and other vital fluids through its skin. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 10d10} Necrotic damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.
Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead are unaffected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Avoid Planar Effects

time.condition: which you take when you or a creature you can see within 20 feet of you is harmed by the environment of the plane you're on

entries: You bark out words of power that shield you and up to five other creatures of your choice within range for the duration, including against the triggering effect.

Each target is protected from the natural environment of whatever plane of existence it is on. This includes extreme heat or cold, damage the plane itself deals (such as the searing heat of the Elemental Plane of Fire or the life-draining chill of a negatively charged plane), blinding or overwhelming positive or negative energy, poisonous or unbreathable air (a target can breathe normally even underwater or encased in earth), and the deafening winds of planes such as Pandemonium. The DM determines which environmental effects of a plane the spell negates.

The spell doesn't protect against creatures, spells, or other magic, nor against a plane's gravity, its effects on magic, or the traits that trap or influence travelers who linger (such as the hold of Elysium or the despair of the Gray Waste). It also doesn't protect against unusual local hazards: a target can survive on the Elemental Plane of Earth, but it still burns if it walks into a pool of magma there.

spell.name: Awaken Construct

m.text: the brain of a Humanoid that died within the last 8 hours and a diamond worth 2,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You spend the casting time weaving the memories of the brain into the diamond's facets, and then touch the target: a roughly humanoid-shaped Construct with an Intelligence of 3 or less. The spell fails if the target is a Construct only temporarily, such as an object animated by {@spell Animate Objects|XPHB}.

The target's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores each become 10 if they were lower, and it gains the ability to speak one language you know. It is no longer bound to obey the commands of its creator or anyone else; it becomes an independent being with its own will, though its attitude toward you and toward its creator starts as {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly}.

spell.name: Awaken Sin
entries: You touch a creature and force it to feel the full weight of its misdeeds. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower succeeds automatically.

If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it isn't killed; it instead has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition and is {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}, overwhelmed by guilt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Awaken Undead

m.text: a humanoid finger bone and black onyx worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Choose any number of Undead you control within range that have an Intelligence of 6 or lower, such as a {@creature Skeleton|XMM} or {@creature Zombie|XMM} created by {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB}. Each target gains the following permanent benefits:

items: Its Intelligence becomes 10, and it regains the memories and skills it had in life. It understands the languages it knew in life and can speak them if it is physically able to.
It can follow complex commands, act on its own judgment to carry them out, and report what it has seen.
It has proficiency with all armor and with Simple and Martial weapons, and it will don armor and take up weapons when told to.
It regains any innate, nonmagical abilities it had in life, such as a poisonous bite or a keen sense of smell, at the DM's discretion.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that turn Undead or that would wrest control of it from you.

entries: Awakening an Undead doesn't change how long your control over it lasts. If your control ends, the awakened Undead acts on its own will and remembers how you treated it.

spell.name: Babau Slime
entries: You touch a willing creature, and its skin, armor, and gear weep a coat of hot red slime for the duration. Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the target hits it with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} or with a melee attack that isn't made with a weapon (such as a bite, a claw, or a touch spell), the attacker takes {@damage 2d6} Acid damage.

Any creature that starts its turn {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the target, or grappling it, takes {@damage 2d6} Acid damage. While the spell lasts, the target also has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks it makes to escape a grapple.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Backbiter
entries: Choose a melee weapon you can see within range. If a creature is holding the weapon, that creature makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a successful save, the spell has no effect. A creature that fails doesn't know it failed or that the weapon is affected.

The next time a creature makes a melee attack with the weapon before the spell ends, the weapon twists in its grip and strikes the wielder instead. The attack automatically hits the wielder, who takes the attack's normal damage (including its ability modifier and any extra damage or effects the attack would deal), and the original target is unaffected. The spell then ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional weapon for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Backlash
entries: You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be wreathed in a faint red aura that fades from sight a moment later. A creature that fails doesn't know it failed.

The next time the target casts a spell before this spell ends, that spell backfires: it fails and has no effect, any spell slot or use of a feature spent to cast it is wasted, and the target takes {@damage 2d6} Force damage for each level of the failed spell ({@damage 2d6} for a cantrip). This spell then ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Balancing Lorecall
entries: Magic presses in on you from all sides, keeping you upright. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks and on saving throws you make to avoid having the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
Narrow, slippery, or unstable surfaces such as ice, tightropes, and loose scree aren't {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for you, and you don't need to make checks to keep your balance on them.
You can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces as if they were level ground, while leaving your hands free. You can't move along ceilings.

You can move across liquids and semisolid surfaces, such as water, mud, quicksand, or deep snow, as if they were solid ground. If you end your turn on such a surface, you must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check or sink into it, and the DC increases by 5 for each consecutive turn you end there.

spell.name: Baleful Transposition
entries: Choose two creatures you can see within range, each of which is Large or smaller. You can be one of them. A solid object such as the ground, a bridge, or a rope must connect the two creatures. Each target that is unwilling makes a Charisma saving throw, and if either target succeeds, the spell has no effect.
Otherwise, the two creatures teleport, swapping places. Each brings along the equipment it is wearing or carrying, but not other creatures, even ones it is carrying.

spell.name: Ball Lightning

components.m: a handful of copper and iron pellets

entries: You create a 5-foot-diameter ball of crackling lightning in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It lasts for the duration and sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the ball makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature wearing armor made of metal has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this save.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the ball up to 30 feet in any direction, including straight up. If you move the ball into a creature's space, that creature makes the save against the ball, and the ball stops moving for the turn. The ball can't push aside creatures or break through obstacles, and the spell ends if the ball is ever more than 120 feet away from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Balor Nimbus
entries: Lurid flames burst from your body for the duration. They don't harm you or anything you are wearing or carrying, and they shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

When a creature starts grappling you or you start grappling a creature, and at the start of each of your turns, each creature grappling you or {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you takes {@damage 3d6} Fire damage. A creature takes this damage no more than once per turn.
Flammable objects you touch that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Bands of Steel
entries: Bands of steel streak from your hand toward a Medium or smaller creature you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the bands lock around it, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for the duration. On a successful save, the bands only tangle its limbs, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved until the end of its next turn.

A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the bands can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on itself on a success. The bands can also be attacked; they have AC 18, 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. Destroying them ends the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Barghest's Feast

m.text: a diamond worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Black flames flicker over a corpse or the remains of a dead creature you touch, consuming it utterly; when they pass, not even dust remains. The spell has no effect on Undead or on remains being worn or carried by a creature.

The creature can't be returned to life by any spell or effect that requires its body or any part of it, such as {@spell Revivify|XPHB}, {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB}, {@spell Reincarnate|XPHB}, or {@spell Resurrection|XPHB}. If {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB}, {@spell Wish|XPHB}, or a similar effect that doesn't need the body is used to restore it to life, roll a {@dice d100}: on a 50 or lower, that effect fails, and the creature can never be returned to life by mortal magic. Roll once for each destroyed creature.

spell.name: Battering Ram

components.m: a piece of carved ram's horn

entries: An invisible wedge of force slams into a creature or object you can see within range. A target creature makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d8} Force damage, is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from you, and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

An object that isn't being worn or carried automatically takes the damage. If it is a door, window, gate, chest lid, or similar closure that is stuck or barred (but not locked by magic), the force also bursts it open with a bang audible out to 300 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Battle Hymn
entries: A stirring martial tune fills the air around you, as though played by an unseen troupe. For the duration, the music fills a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Whenever you or an ally in the Emanation fails an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, that creature can reroll the save and must use the new roll. Each creature can reroll in this way only once per turn.
While in the Emanation, you and your allies also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

spell.name: Beast Claws

components.m: the claw of a bird of prey

entries: Your hands become long, curving claws. Until the spell ends, your claws are Simple Melee weapons with the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} properties that you are proficient with. A hit with a claw deals {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls. Your claws score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
The claws can't be disarmed and don't hinder your spellcasting or your ability to handle objects, but you can't wield other weapons with your hands while the spell lasts.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The claws' damage die becomes a d8 with a level 3 or 4 spell slot and a d10 with a level 5+ spell slot.

spell.name: Beastland Ferocity
entries: You touch a willing creature and give it a fighting spirit that doesn't know when to stop. For the duration, the target doesn't have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition from being at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Instead, it can move and act normally while it has 0 Hit Points, though it still makes {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}, takes failures from damage as normal, and dies normally.

While the target has 0 Hit Points, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and its melee attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the attack's type. If the spell ends while the target still has 0 Hit Points, the target has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition as normal.

spell.name: Beget Bogun

m.text: a mannequin woven from living or once-living plant matter with a strand of your hair or a drop of your blood worked into it, which the spell consumes

entries: You must cast this spell outdoors in a forest grove, and you weave the mannequin during the casting. If any creature other than you interrupts the casting, the spell fails. When the spell is complete, the mannequin awakens as a bogun, a Tiny construct of compost, nettles, and branches whose features you choose. It uses the Bogun stat block below.

data.name: Bogun
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

trait.name: Telepathic Bond
entries: While the bogun is within 1,500 feet of its creator on the same plane of existence, the two can communicate telepathically, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} the creator can see and hear what the bogun sees and hears until the start of the creator's next turn. The bogun never willingly travels beyond this distance.

trait.name: Willful
entries: Whenever its creator gives the bogun a command, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the bogun balks; its creator must succeed on a DC 11 Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, or the bogun refuses to act on any commands for 24 hours.

trait.name: Linked Life
entries: If the bogun is destroyed, its creator takes {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage. If its creator dies, the bogun collapses into a heap of rotting vegetation.

action.name: Nettles
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the bogun's next turn.

entries.name: Combat
entries: The bogun is an ally to you and your allies. It rolls its own {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} and acts on its own turn. It obeys your commands (no action required by you) subject to its Willful trait, and it can carry messages, open doors and windows, attack, and perform other simple tasks.

entries.name: One Bogun Only
entries: You can't have more than one bogun at a time. A bogun that drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} is destroyed, leaving a heap of rotting vegetation; you can cast this spell again to create a new one.

spell.name: Belker Claws
entries: Your hand turns to swirling smoke shaped like a belker's claw. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d12} Slashing damage, and the smoke clings to it. At the end of the target's next turn, it takes {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage from the clinging smoke. A strong wind, such as that created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}, disperses the smoke and prevents this later damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d12|2-9|1d12} for each spell slot level above 2, and the smoke deals its damage at the end of one additional turn of the target's for every two slot levels above 2.

spell.name: Benign Transposition
entries: Choose two willing creatures you can see within range, each of which is Large or smaller. You can be one of them. The two creatures teleport, swapping places. Each brings along the equipment it is wearing or carrying, but not other creatures, even ones it is carrying.

spell.name: Binding Winds
entries: Whipping winds encircle one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be bound by the winds for the duration. While bound, the target has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0 (a flying target is held aloft in place), has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition, and can speak, but no one beyond its space can hear it. Ranged attack rolls against the target and ranged attack rolls the target makes have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

Whenever the bound target casts a spell with a Verbal component, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, or the spell fails and has no effect; the spell's slot isn't expended.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Dexterity save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Bite of the King
entries: Your mouth opens impossibly wide and engulfs a creature you touch whose size is no larger than yours. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be swallowed into a temporary extradimensional "stomach" for the duration. Each casting creates a separate stomach.

While swallowed, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against effects originating outside the stomach, and can't leave the stomach by teleportation or planar travel. At the start of each of its turns, it takes {@damage 3d8} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 3d8} Acid damage.

The target can cut its way free by attacking the stomach, which has AC 20, 40 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Acid, Poison, and Psychic damage, and which takes damage only from Slashing or Piercing attacks. If the stomach drops to 0 Hit Points, or when the spell ends, the target reappears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 feet of you, seeming to cut its way free from thin air.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Acid damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|8-9|1d8} with a level 9 spell slot.

spell.name: Bite of the Werebear
entries: With an inhuman roar, your face swells into an ursine muzzle, your hands become great clawed paws, and heavy muscle builds beneath your fur-covered skin. Until the spell ends, you retain your game statistics, can still speak, cast spells, and use your equipment, and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Hybrid Vigor.
entries: When you cast this spell, you gain 30 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

items.name: Thick Hide.
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 17 if it is lower than that.

items.name: Claws.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your claws, it deals {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

items.name: Mauling Fury.
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack with your claws as part of that action.

items.name: Bite.
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with your claws as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make a bite attack against that creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. This attack uses the same attack and damage modifiers as your claws, and on a hit it deals {@damage 2d8} Piercing damage.

items.name: Bear Hug.
entries: When you hit the same Large or smaller creature with two claw attacks on the same turn, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC).

items.name: Brawn.
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

items.name: Keen Senses.
entries: You gain {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain 5 additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Bite of the Wereboar
entries: Your face reshapes itself into the tusked visage of a boar, your body grows bulky, and stiff bristles sprout along your shoulders and back. Until the spell ends, you retain your game statistics, can still speak, cast spells, and use your equipment, and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Hybrid Vigor.
entries: When you cast this spell, you gain 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

items.name: Thick Hide.
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 17 if it is lower than that.

items.name: Tusks.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your tusks, it deals {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

items.name: Charge.
entries: If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hit it with your tusks on the same turn, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it must also succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Boar's Ferocity.
entries: The first time you would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright before the spell ends, you are reduced to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

items.name: Brawn.
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

items.name: Keen Senses.
entries: You gain {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain 5 additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Bite of the Wererat
entries: Your face lengthens into a whiskered snout, a ratlike tail sprouts behind you, and coarse gray fur covers your thickening skin. Until the spell ends, you retain your game statistics, can still speak, cast spells, and use your equipment, and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Hybrid Vigor.
entries: When you cast this spell, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

items.name: Thick Hide.
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 14 if it is lower than that.

items.name: Bite.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your teeth, it deals {@damage 1d8} Piercing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

items.name: Ratlike Agility.
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws, and you gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

items.name: Scurry.
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} or {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Keen Senses.
entries: You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain 5 additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Bite of the Weretiger
entries: You snarl as your features shift into those of a tiger, your hands sprout hooked claws, and thick striped fur covers your body. Until the spell ends, you retain your game statistics, can still speak, cast spells, and use your equipment, and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Hybrid Vigor.
entries: When you cast this spell, you gain 25 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

items.name: Thick Hide.
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 16 if it is lower than that.

items.name: Claws.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your claws, it deals {@damage 1d10} Slashing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

items.name: Bite.
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with your claws as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make a bite attack against that creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. This attack uses the same attack and damage modifiers as your claws, and on a hit it deals {@damage 2d8} Piercing damage.

items.name: Pounce.
entries: If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hit it with your claws on the same turn, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, if it is Large or smaller.

items.name: Brawn.
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

items.name: Feline Stride.
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

items.name: Keen Senses.
entries: You gain {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain 5 additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Bite of the Werewolf
entries: A howl erupts from your lips as your face stretches into a lupine muzzle and coarse fur bristles across your body. Until the spell ends, you retain your game statistics, can still speak, cast spells, and use your equipment, and gain the following benefits:

items.name: Hybrid Vigor.
entries: When you cast this spell, you gain 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

items.name: Thick Hide.
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 15 if it is lower than that.

items.name: Bite.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your fangs, it deals {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

items.name: Pack Hunter.
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Lupine Stride.
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

items.name: Keen Senses.
entries: You gain {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain 5 additional {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Black Blade of Disaster
entries: You tear a crackling, sword-shaped rift in reality, about 3 feet long, that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration.

When the blade appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 10d10} Force damage on a failed save or {@damage 5d6} Force damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are disintegrated into gray dust. The target can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.
On your later turns, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move the blade up to 30 feet to a spot you can see and repeat the attack against the same target or a different one.

The blade can also strike a nonmagical object or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}. A hit automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller such target, or a 10-foot-{@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} portion of a Huge or larger one. The blade can move through magical barriers created by spells of level 8 or lower, but it can't enter an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB}.
The spell ends early if the blade is ever more than 60 feet away from you or if you lose line of sight to it.

spell.name: Blackfire

components.m: a pinch of dust from a vampire destroyed by sunlight

entries: A ray of black energy springs from your hand. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d10} Necrotic damage and is engulfed in chill black flames that feed on its life force. Constructs and Undead are unaffected by the flames.

While engulfed, a creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. At the start of each of its turns, it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 5d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or no damage on a successful one. If it succeeds on three of these saves in a row, the flames gutter out on it.

The flames spread. At the end of each engulfed creature's turn, each other creature within 5 feet of it that isn't already engulfed makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, that creature is engulfed as well.

A creature reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this spell crumbles into black ash and can be revived only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell. The flames can't be extinguished by nonmagical means such as water or smothering, but {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} ends them on one creature, and a creature under the effect of {@spell Death Ward|XPHB} can't be engulfed.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d10|8-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 8.

spell.name: Blacklight

components.m: a piece of coal and the dried eyeball of any creature

entries: You draw the light out of an area, filling a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} with magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. The Emanation originates from a point you choose within range, from an object that isn't being worn or carried, or from a creature you can see within range. {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} can't see through this darkness, nonmagical light can't illuminate it, and creatures outside the area can't see into it. You, however, can see normally within the area.

If you target an unwilling creature, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Emanation moves with the creature. On a successful save, the Emanation instead originates from the point where the creature was and doesn't move.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

spell.name: Blade Storm
entries: Your weapon flashes blue and feels as light as a feather as an unseen force pulls it toward your enemies. As part of casting this spell, you make one melee attack with a weapon you are holding against each creature of your choice within your reach. You make a separate attack roll for each target. On a hit, a target takes the weapon's normal damage.

spell.name: Blade Thirst
entries: You touch a nonmagical weapon that deals Slashing damage, and unearthly blue flames crackle along its length without harming it. Until the spell ends, the weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls, and it sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet.

spell.name: Blade of Pain and Fear
entries: A 3-foot-long column of disembodied, gnashing teeth springs from your free hand and lasts for the duration. If you let go of it, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can make a melee spell attack with the teeth. On a hit, the target takes Piercing damage equal to {@damage 3d6} plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Blades of Fire
entries: Up to two melee weapons you are holding burst into harmless flames. Until the start of your next turn, each of those weapons deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Fire damage on a hit.

spell.name: Bladeweave
entries: Every movement you make with your weapon becomes a mesmerizing flourish. Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with a melee attack using a weapon, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. A creature that can't see you automatically succeeds. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this spell's effect for the duration.

spell.name: Blast of Flame

components.m: a bit of wick soaked in oil

entries: Flames burst from your hand. Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Blast of Force
entries: You hurl a whistling ray of invisible force at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Force damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. A Large or larger target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Blessed Aim
entries: You exhort your allies to strike true. Choose any number of creatures within range. Whenever a target makes a ranged attack roll before the spell ends, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the roll.

spell.name: Blessing of Bahamut

components.m: a canary feather, which is flung into the air

entries: A distant dragon's roar that only you can hear answers your prayer, and your skin takes on a platinum sheen. Until the spell ends, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

spell.name: Blinding Breath
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon that deals Fire or Lightning damage, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} with Fire or Lightning chosen, to cast this spell. The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it blazes with eye-splitting light. In addition to the breath's normal effects, each creature that fails its saving throw against it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition. Creatures that lack eyes or sight are unaffected by the blinding.

A creature Blinded by this spell repeats a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or three failures. If it succeeds on three of these saves, the condition ends on it. If it fails three of them, it remains {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until it is cured by {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic.

spell.name: Blinding Spittle
entries: You spit a globule of caustic saliva at the eyes of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d4} Acid damage and has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

The condition lasts until the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to rinse the target's eyes with water or another fluid, or until 1 minute passes. A creature that has no eyes or that has {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} takes the damage but isn't Blinded.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. Make a separate attack roll for each target.

spell.name: Blindsight
entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, it has {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3. With a level 4+ spell slot, the range of the {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} increases to 60 feet and the duration increases to 8 hours.

spell.name: Blistering Radiance

components.m: a bit of tinder and a small lens

entries: You hurl a blazing mote of light to a point within range, where it erupts into a brilliant hovering orb that fills a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} for the duration. The area is {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and the orb sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. Creatures that rely on sight have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks while in the area, as the glare dazzles them.

When the orb appears, each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when it enters the Sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} created by a spell of level 4 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: You touch a willing creature and fill its veins with hot, rushing anger.

If the target has the {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} feature, it can immediately enter its Rage without expending a use of it (no action required). That Rage follows its normal rules and isn't limited by this spell's duration.
