If the target lacks that feature, it enters a lesser frenzy for the duration instead. While frenzied, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and it gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls of attacks that use Strength. It can't cast spells or maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} while frenzied. The target can end the frenzy early on its turn (no action required).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Blood Sirocco
entries: A stifling, sand-choked wind tears out from you in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} in a direction you choose, and it keeps blowing for the duration. When you cast this spell and at the end of each of your turns for the duration, each creature in the Cone makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage as the wind parches it, and if it is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 15 feet away from you and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. Constructs and Undead take no damage from this spell but can still be pushed.
Any creature in the Cone must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.

The wind disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a {@chance 50|||Extinguished!|No effect} chance to extinguish them.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can change the direction in which the Cone blows from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Blood Wind
entries: The limbs of one willing creature you can see within range ripple with power. For the duration, the target can make attacks with its {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} and natural weapons (such as claws or a bite) against creatures up to 20 feet away. It strikes the air as if attacking in melee, and the blow lands on the distant target. These remain melee attacks, using the target's normal attack and damage rolls, but the distant target benefits from {@variantrule Cover|XPHB} as if the attack were ranged.
This spell doesn't increase the target's reach for any other purpose, such as making {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Blood to Water
entries: Sea-green orbs of energy streak from you toward up to five creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw as its blood turns to water. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 8d8} Necrotic damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.
This spell has no effect on Constructs, Elementals, or Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|7-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Bloodhound
entries: Your eyes sharpen to the faintest traces of passage. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to follow tracks. If you fail such a check, you can immediately make it again against the same DC instead of having to search to find the trail; you must use the new roll.
In addition, when you examine a creature's tracks, you learn how many creatures made them, their approximate size, and roughly how long ago they passed.

spell.name: Bloodstar

m.text: a ruby worth 30+ GP

entries: A blood-colored, glowing crystal appears at a point you choose within range and hovers there for the duration. It sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. The bloodstar can't be attacked or harmed.

When you cast the spell, choose any number of creatures you can see. Whenever one of those creatures takes damage from any source while within 10 feet of the bloodstar, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take an extra {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage as the bloodstar draws blood from its wounds. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is also reduced by an amount equal to this Necrotic damage until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. A creature makes this save only once per turn. Constructs and Undead are unaffected.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the bloodstar to a point you can see within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Bodak's Glare

m.text: a black onyx gem worth 500+ GP

entries: Your eyes vanish, becoming holes into an endless darkness. Choose a creature you can see within range that can see you; the target doesn't need to meet your gaze. It makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 10d8 + 25} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies.
A Humanoid killed by this spell rises 24 hours later as a {@creature Bodak|MPMM} unless it is restored to life in the meantime. The bodak isn't under your control.

spell.name: Body Blades
entries: Slender, daggerlike blades erupt from your body and clothing for the duration. They never harm you or hinder your movement or actions.

The blades count as a Simple Melee weapon with the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} properties that you are proficient with. A hit with them deals {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls.

When you hit a creature with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to grapple it, and at the start of each of your turns while you have a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, that creature takes {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage. The same damage applies to a creature that grapples you, when it does so and at the start of each of its turns while it has you Grappled.
You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws you make to escape a grapple or to end the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition on yourself.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The grappling damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Body Harmonic

m.text: a crystal goblet filled with water worth 500+ GP

entries: You rub the rim of a water-filled goblet, and the body of one creature you can see within range begins to vibrate painfully in harmony with the tone. The target makes a Constitution saving throw when you cast the spell and again at the start of each of your later turns for the duration. Each time, choose one ability before the save. You can't choose the same ability again until you have chosen each of the six abilities once during this casting.

On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 3d10} Thunder damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws that use the chosen ability until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

For the duration, the target's body hums loudly. It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and it can be heard up to 100 feet away. Constructs and Undead are unaffected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d10|5-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Body of War
entries: Your flesh turns to metal and you swell into a towering war machine for the duration. You stop breathing, and your equipment melds into your new form. You gain the following benefits and drawbacks:

items.name: Titan Form.
entries: Your size becomes Huge and your creature type becomes Construct. Your Strength score becomes 28 and your Dexterity score becomes 8; your other ability scores, {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and proficiencies are unchanged. Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 50 feet, your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} can't be lower than 18, and you have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

items.name: Construct Resilience.
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage, and you have Immunity to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Petrified|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions. Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you becomes a normal hit.

items.name: Axe and Maul.
entries: Your arms end in a massive axe and maul, which you are proficient with and which have a reach of 10 feet. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can attack twice with them instead of once; this doesn't stack with the Extra Attack feature. The axe deals {@damage 3d8} Slashing damage plus your Strength modifier on a hit. The maul deals {@damage 3d8} Bludgeoning damage plus your Strength modifier on a hit, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Trample.
entries: You can move through the space of a Large or smaller creature. The first time on a turn that you enter a creature's space, it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning damage plus your Strength modifier on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: War Mind.
entries: You can't speak or cast spells, including from magic items, though you can maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this spell. You can end the spell early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

spell.name: Body of the Sun
entries: Drawing on the power of the sun, you wreathe yourself in fire that fills a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you for the duration. The flames shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet, and they don't harm you or what you wear or carry.

Whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} or ends its turn there, the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Bolt of Glory
entries: You project a white bolt of hissing positive energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 6d12} Radiant damage, or {@damage 12d12} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead. A Celestial is unaffected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d12|6-9|1d12} for each spell slot level above 6, or by 2d12 against a Fiend or an Undead.

spell.name: Bolts of Bedevilment
entries: With a strangled peal of laughter, you fire a black ray from your finger at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
Until the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on each of your later turns to fire another ray at the same target or a different one within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Bombardment

components.m: a quartz crystal embedded in a rock

entries: Boulders tumble into being from the empty air, filling a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d8} Bludgeoning damage and is buried in rubble. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

A buried creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, can't cast spells that have a Somatic component, and has Total {@variantrule Cover|XPHB} against attacks and effects originating outside the rubble. As an action, it can try to dig itself free with a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the burial on a success. A creature within 5 feet of a buried creature can take an action to make the same check, freeing the buried creature on a success.
Afterward, the ground in the area is covered in dense rubble and is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until cleared.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d8|8-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 8.

spell.name: Bonefiddle

m.text: a miniature silver fiddle worth 30+ GP

entries: A ghostly, bone-white fiddle bow appears above one creature you can see within range, sinks into its body, and begins sawing at its skeleton. The spell fails if the target has no skeleton or exoskeleton (as is true of most Elementals and Oozes).

The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. On a successful save, the spell ends. While the spell lasts, the eerie music issues from the target's body, giving it {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

At the start of each of the target's turns, it repeats the save, taking the damage again on a failed save and ending the spell on a successful one. The spell continues even if you lose sight of the target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Bottle of Smoke

m.text: an ornate, corked bottle worth 50+ GP

entries: You draw a plume of smoke into the bottle used in the casting and cork it. While the bottle is corked, the spell is dormant, and the time it spends dormant doesn't count against its duration. Regardless of how much duration remains, the spell ends 24 hours after you cast it.

When the bottle is uncorked, the smoke pours out and forms a Large, silent, horselike creature in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the bottle. Only a creature holding the bottle in one hand can mount or ride the steed; anything else passes through its form. If the rider lets go of the bottle, the rider falls through the steed and can't remount without the bottle in hand.

The steed has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 120 feet and can travel 15 miles in an hour. It can't attack, and it can't be harmed: weapons, spells, and other effects pass through it harmlessly. Whenever the steed moves, the rider can have it leave a trail of smoke behind it (no action required). The trail fills a 5-foot-wide, 20-foot-high path along the steed's route, is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}, and lasts for 10 minutes or until a strong wind disperses it.
While mounted or within 5 feet of the steed, the creature holding the bottle can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to draw the steed back into the bottle and cork it, making the spell dormant again.

The spell ends early if the bottle is broken, or if the steed is exposed to a strong wind or any magical wind (such as that of {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}). When the spell ends, the steed and any smoke it has produced vanish, and a mounted rider falls to the ground.

spell.name: Brain Spider

components.m: a dead spider with all eight of its legs

entries: Choose up to eight creatures you can see within range. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed. For the duration, you are telepathically linked to each target that fails, as long as you are both on the same plane of existence. An affected creature is unaware of the link.
When you cast the spell, and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on your later turns until it ends, you can do one of the following:

items.name: Surface Thoughts.
entries: You learn what is most on the mind of each affected creature right now.

items.name: Topic.
entries: Name a topic, object, place, or creature. You learn what each affected creature knows about it, as if each had answered your questions truthfully and in full.

items.name: Deep Study.
entries: Choose one affected creature. You discern its reasoning, emotions, and the memories it holds most strongly, and you can learn the answer to one question about its past experiences.

items.name: Implant Suggestion.
entries: Choose one affected creature and describe a course of action in no more than 25 words, as with {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for up to 8 hours, even if this spell ends, and pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability; the effect ends early if you or your allies deal damage to it. Success on this save doesn't end this spell on that creature.

spell.name: Brambles
entries: You touch a melee weapon whose striking surface is wood, such as a {@item Club|XPHB}, {@item Greatclub|XPHB}, or {@item Quarterstaff|XPHB}. The weapon sprouts hard, rose-like thorns and becomes a magic weapon for the duration. It has a +1 bonus to attack rolls, deals your choice of Bludgeoning or Piercing damage with each hit, and deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage when it hits.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases to {@damage 2d6} when you use a level 4-5 spell slot and to {@damage 3d6} when you use a level 6+ spell slot.

spell.name: Branch to Branch
entries: Your fingers thicken and your arms lengthen slightly. For the duration, you have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} while climbing trees.

While you are at least 10 feet above the ground in a forest or jungle with a canopy dense enough to swing through, you can brachiate from branch to branch. While brachiating, your Speed increases by 10 feet, and you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by undergrowth, branches, and other plants. Clearings, rivers, and other breaks in the canopy might force you back to the ground.

spell.name: Breath Flare
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon that deals Fire or Lightning damage, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} with Fire or Lightning chosen, to cast this spell. The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it flashes with brilliant light. In addition to the breath's normal effects, each creature that fails its saving throw against it is dazzled for 1 minute. Creatures that lack eyes or sight are unaffected by the flash.

A dazzled creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight. It makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Breath Weapon Admixture
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} to cast this spell. When you cast it, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, other than the breath's own damage type. Even opposed energies, such as Cold and Fire, can be combined.

The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it carries both energies. Its area doubles in size (a 15-foot Cone becomes a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, a 30-foot Line becomes a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, and so on), and in addition to the breath's normal damage, each creature in the area takes an extra {@damage 15d10} damage of the chosen type on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

spell.name: Breath Weapon Substitution
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB} to cast this spell. When you cast it, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, other than the breath's own damage type.

The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it deals damage of the chosen type instead of its normal type, and it deals an extra {@damage 5d10} damage of the chosen type to each creature that fails its saving throw against it (half as much extra damage on a successful save). This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}.

spell.name: Breath of the Jungle
entries: A fine, foul-smelling mist fills a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. The mist doesn't obscure vision.

A creature in the mist has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, on saving throws against effects that deal Poison damage, and on saving throws against diseases.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The radius of the Cylinder increases by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Brilliant Aura
entries: Choose up to six willing creatures within range. Each target's body is limned in white brilliance, and so are its weapons, including those it draws later during the spell and its {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. Ammunition fired from an affected weapon is affected too.

Until the spell ends, each affected weapon becomes a magic weapon that glows with a pale blue-white halo, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. Its damage becomes Radiant damage, and a hit with it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage.

The weapon passes through nonliving matter. When it is used to make an attack roll against a creature that wears armor or carries a Shield, that armor and Shield are ignored: the target's {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} for the attack is 10 plus its Dexterity modifier, plus any bonuses from sources other than armor and Shields (such as a {@item Ring of Protection|XDMG} or the {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB} spell). A creature whose AC comes from its natural hide or plating isn't affected by this benefit.
Because it passes through nonliving matter, the weapon can't damage Constructs, Undead, or objects.

spell.name: Brilliant Blade
entries: Choose one weapon or up to twenty pieces of ammunition within range that aren't being worn or carried by a creature other than a willing one. The weapon or ammunition takes on a soft blue-white halo that hums faintly and smells of ozone. A piece of ammunition loses this magic after it is used in an attack, whether it hits or misses.

Until the spell ends, the weapon becomes a magic weapon that glows with a pale blue-white halo, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. Its damage becomes Radiant damage, and a hit with it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage.

The weapon passes through nonliving matter. When it is used to make an attack roll against a creature that wears armor or carries a Shield, that armor and Shield are ignored: the target's {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} for the attack is 10 plus its Dexterity modifier, plus any bonuses from sources other than armor and Shields (such as a {@item Ring of Protection|XDMG} or the {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB} spell). A creature whose AC comes from its natural hide or plating isn't affected by this benefit.
Because it passes through nonliving matter, the weapon can't damage Constructs, Undead, or objects.

spell.name: Bristle
entries: You touch a suit of armor that is unattended or worn by a willing creature. The armor sprouts long, flexible spikes that don't hinder its wearer. For the duration, once on each of its turns when the wearer hits a creature within 5 feet of it with a melee attack, the spikes lash out at that creature, dealing an extra {@damage 2d6} Piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Buoyant Lifting

time.condition: which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you is submerged in water or another liquid

entries: Choose up to five willing creatures within range that are in a liquid. Each target rises toward the surface at a rate of 60 feet per round until it floats on top of the liquid, where it stays without sinking for the duration. A floating target can breathe if it breathes air, and it can swim along the surface or be pulled by others normally, but it can't move below the surface.
The spell ends on a target if it leaves the liquid. A target can also end the spell on itself (no action required).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Burning Blood

components.m: a drop of blood and a pinch of saltpeter

entries: You taint the blood of one creature you can see within range with a searing, corrosive infusion. The spell has no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, or Undead.

The target makes a Constitution saving throw when you cast the spell and again at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d6} Acid damage and {@damage 2d6} Fire damage, and until the start of its next turn, it can't take Reactions and can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both. On a successful save, it takes no damage, but the spell continues.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Acid damage and the Fire damage each increase by {@scaledamage 2d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Burning Sword
entries: You touch a weapon, which becomes wreathed in harmless blue flames for the duration. The flames shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. The weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage when it hits, and when it scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, it deals an additional {@damage 1d10} Fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage on a hit increases to {@damage 2d6} when you use a level 4-5 spell slot and to {@damage 3d6} when you use a level 6+ spell slot.

spell.name: Burrow

components.m: a claw from a burrowing creature

entries: Your hands glow with a yellow aura that takes the shape of translucent mole claws. Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains a {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet, or 20 feet if it wears Medium or Heavy armor. It can burrow through earth, sand, mud, and loose rock, but not solid stone.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Buzzing Bee
entries: A small but extremely loud magical bee appears and buzzes around the head of one creature you can see within range. The bee stays with the target despite darkness, invisibility, shape-shifting, cover, or any other attempt to hide or lose it. It can't be attacked or harmed, but it can be dispelled. The spell ends early if the target is ever more than 120 feet away from you.

For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and it has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws it makes to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. A creature that can't hear is unaffected.

spell.name: Cacophonic Burst
entries: A burst of low, discordant noise erupts at a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d8} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The noise can't enter the area of a {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell or similar magical silence, and creatures within such an area are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Cacophonic Shield
entries: A barrier of sonic energy forms at the edge of a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you, and it moves with you for the duration. Creatures on either side of the barrier hear it as a loud but harmless buzzing. Nonmagical sound can't pass through the barrier in either direction, though sounds created by spells and other magical effects pass through normally.

When a creature crosses the barrier for the first time on a turn, whether entering or leaving the Emanation, it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 4d8} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A creature isn't affected if the barrier passes over it because you moved.
Ranged attack rolls made against targets on the other side of the barrier have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Call Kolyarut

m.text: a platinum seal stamped with the terms of a broken bargain, worth 1,250+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You call a {@creature Kolyarut|MPP}, an inevitable from the plane of Mechanus, which appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. If you know an individual kolyarut's name, you can speak that name when you cast this spell to request that creature, though you might get a different one anyway (DM's choice).

You can ask the kolyarut to perform one duty that takes no more than 1 hour to complete. It asks no payment, but the duty must suit its mandate: it punishes those who break bargains, oaths, and contracts, and it can enforce or witness such agreements. The kolyarut refuses a duty outside its mandate or one that would require it to break a law or bargain it respects; if it refuses, it returns to Mechanus immediately.

The kolyarut isn't under your control. The DM determines its actions, and it carries out the duty in its own relentless way. When the duty is done or 1 hour has passed, it reports back to you if it can and then returns to Mechanus.

spell.name: Call Marut

m.text: a platinum hourglass worth 2,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You call a {@creature Marut|MPMM}, an inevitable from the plane of Mechanus, which appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. If you know an individual marut's name, you can speak that name when you cast this spell to request that creature, though you might get a different one anyway (DM's choice).

You can ask the marut to perform one duty that takes no more than 1 hour to complete. It asks no payment, but the duty must suit its mandate: it punishes those who cheat death, such as creatures that unnaturally extend their lives or that chose undeath, and those who help them do so. The marut refuses a duty outside its mandate or one that would require it to break a law or bargain it respects; if it refuses, it returns to Mechanus immediately.

The marut isn't under your control. The DM determines its actions, and it carries out the duty in its own relentless way. When the duty is done or 1 hour has passed, it reports back to you if it can and then returns to Mechanus.

spell.name: Call Zelekhut

m.text: a silver chain worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You call a zelekhut (stat block below), an inevitable from the plane of Mechanus, which appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. If you know an individual zelekhut's name, you can speak that name when you cast this spell to request that creature, though you might get a different one anyway (DM's choice).

You can ask the zelekhut to perform one duty that takes no more than 1 hour to complete. It asks no payment, but the duty must suit its mandate: it hunts down those who flee from lawful justice, such as escaped prisoners, fugitives, and anyone evading a sentence or punishment lawfully imposed on them. The zelekhut refuses a duty outside its mandate or one that would require it to break a law or bargain it respects; if it refuses, it returns to Mechanus immediately.

The zelekhut isn't under your control. The DM determines its actions, and it carries out the duty in its own relentless way. When the duty is done or 1 hour has passed, it reports back to you if it can and then returns to Mechanus.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The zelekhut can't shape-shift.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The zelekhut has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The zelekhut regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

trait.name: Unerring Pursuit
entries: The zelekhut always knows the direction to the creature it is pursuing, as long as that creature is on the same plane of existence.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The zelekhut doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The zelekhut makes two Spiked Chain attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Spiked Chain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The zelekhut casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

spell.name: Caltrops
entries: Magical caltrops cover a 5-foot square of ground you can see within range for the duration. When a creature enters the area or ends its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage, loses 10 feet of movement this turn, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. A creature makes this save only once per turn, and a creature that doesn't walk on the ground (such as one that is flying) isn't affected.
The caltrops vanish when the spell ends. If you cast this spell again, any caltrops from the previous casting vanish.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: You cover one additional 5-foot square, which must be adjacent to another square covered by this spell, when you reach levels 5 (2 squares), 11 (3 squares), and 17 (4 squares).

spell.name: Camouflage
entries: For the duration, the coloration of your skin, clothing, and gear shifts to match the background of whatever environment you are in, changing instantly as you move. You have a +5 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

spell.name: Capricious Zephyr
entries: You create a 5-foot-diameter ball of swirling wind and dust in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It lasts for the duration and hovers in the air regardless of the terrain beneath it.

Whenever the ball enters a creature's space, and whenever a creature ends its turn in the ball's space, that creature makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d8} Bludgeoning damage, has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and is pushed 15 feet in a random direction. Roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the direction: 1 is toward you, and 2 through 8 are the other directions, going clockwise. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the ball up to 30 feet. It can pass through creatures' spaces. The spell ends if the ball is ever more than 120 feet away from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Cast in Stone
entries: Your eyes become gray stone orbs traced with golden veins, and your gaze turns flesh to stone. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you that can see your eyes makes a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns. In addition, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to force one creature you can see within 30 feet of you to make the save.

On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition as its flesh starts to harden, and it repeats the save at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on it. On a failure, it has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. This petrification lasts until it is ended by a {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic, or until you end it by speaking a command word you set when you cast the spell (no action required). Constructs automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

A creature that isn't {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by this spell can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save until the start of its next turn. If it does so, it treats you as if you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until then.

spell.name: Castigate
entries: You shout your deity's teachings, rebuking your foes with sacred words. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you that can hear you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Fiends and Undead have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this save, and creatures that can't hear you are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Celebration
entries: You strike up a raucous drinking song that leaves listeners increasingly drunk. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range that can hear you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for the duration. On a successful save, it is unaffected.

On each of your later turns, you must take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to keep performing, or the spell ends. When you do, each creature {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} by this spell makes another Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature. On a failed save, the creature sinks further into drunkenness: the first time it fails, it also has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for the duration; the second time it fails, it has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for the duration. The spell ends on an {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} creature if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake.
Creatures that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

spell.name: Chain Missile
entries: You create five glowing darts of magical force that unerringly strike one creature you can see within range, each dealing {@damage 1d4 + 1} Force damage to it. The darts then ricochet: each one can strike a different creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of the first target, dealing {@damage 1d4 + 1} Force damage to it. No creature other than the first target can be struck by more than one dart, and you can choose to have darts not ricochet.

This spell counts as {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} for any effect that protects against that spell, such as {@spell Shield|XPHB}. If the first target is protected in this way, it takes no damage, but the darts still ricochet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Chain of Eyes
entries: You touch a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead. It makes a Wisdom saving throw, which it can choose to fail. On a failed save, you can see through its eyes for the duration, as long as it is on the same plane of existence as you. The spell gives you no control over the target, which doesn't know it is being watched unless it notices the spell being cast.

Once on each of your turns (no action required), you can switch between seeing through the target's eyes and seeing through your own. While you see through the target's eyes, you have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition with regard to your own surroundings.

Whenever the target touches another creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, you can transfer the spell to that creature (no action required). The new creature makes the Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you now see through its eyes instead. On a successful save, the spell ends.

spell.name: Charge of the Triceratops
entries: You touch a willing creature, which grows large horns, a bony skull plate, and a thickened hide. Until the spell ends, the target gains the following benefits.

items.name: Bony Hide.
entries: The target has a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

items.name: Horns.
entries: When the target makes an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, it can gore with its horns. On a hit, the gore deals {@damage 1d10} Piercing damage plus the target's Strength modifier, instead of the strike's normal damage.

items.name: Trampling Charge.
entries: If the target moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature immediately before hitting it with a gore, the gore deals an extra {@damage 2d10} Piercing damage, and if the creature is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. The target can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

spell.name: Cheat

components.m: a pair of dice carved from humanoid bone

entries: Once before the spell ends, when a die is rolled to determine the outcome of a nonmagical game of chance you are playing, such as one using cards or dice, you can have that die rerolled and choose which of the two results to use. The spell then ends. The spell can't affect a game that involves magic or a magic item, such as a {@item Deck of Many Things|XDMG}.

Because the spell alters probability, there is no trick for others to spot. However, each creature observing the game can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC when you use the reroll. On a success, the creature suspects that the outcome was altered by magic.

spell.name: Checkmate's Light
entries: You touch a nonmagical melee weapon, which hums in response and begins to glow red. Until the spell ends, the weapon is a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls, and it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. You can suppress or restore the light (no action required). While the light shines, you and your allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition while in its Bright Light.
The spell's effects are suppressed while the weapon isn't held by you or by another creature that worships your deity. Time spent suppressed counts against the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3-5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

spell.name: Chill of the Grave
entries: A pale, moaning ray streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Cold damage, and it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Circle Dance
entries: You dance to each point of the compass, then finish the spell with a wide, circular sweep. Name or describe a creature you have seen at least once. If that creature is alive and within 1 mile of you, you finish the dance facing in its direction and you learn whether it is unharmed, {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, {@condition Unconscious|XPHB}, or dying. You also get a vague impression of its emotional state, such as calm, frightened, or furious.
If the creature is dead or more than 1 mile away, the spell reveals nothing, and you can't tell which of those is the case.

spell.name: Clarity of Mind
entries: A nimbus of silver light surrounds the head of a willing creature you touch, clearing its thoughts. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws and on any saving throw to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
In addition, once on each of its turns when the target misses with an attack roll against a creature it can't see, it can reroll the attack roll and must use the new roll.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Claws of Darkness
entries: You draw shadowstuff around your hands and forearms, which become featureless claws of inky blackness. Until the spell ends, you can't hold anything in your hands, and you can't cast spells that have Somatic or Material components. You can lengthen or retract the claws freely; while lengthened, they let you attack a target up to 10 feet away from you.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, or in place of one of your attacks when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make a melee spell attack with a claw against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} Cold damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be chilled by shadow until the start of your next turn. While chilled, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved and it can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}. A creature that succeeds on this save can't be chilled by this casting of the spell again.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Claws of the Bear
entries: With a howling curse, your hands sprout long, heavy claws. Until the spell ends, each claw is a Simple Melee weapon with the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property that you are proficient with. A hit with a claw deals {@damage 1d8} Slashing damage plus your Strength modifier, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

When you make the extra attack granted by the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property with a claw, you add your ability modifier to that attack's damage, even if it is positive. The claws can't be disarmed, but you can't wield other weapons or hold a Shield while the spell lasts.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration increases to 10 minutes with a level 2+ spell slot.

spell.name: Clear Mind
entries: A silver glow sheathes your body, then fades into a quiet touch of the divine at the back of your mind. When you cast this spell, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions end on you. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end those conditions.

spell.name: Climb Walls
entries: A willing creature you touch perceives handholds and toeholds where others see smooth stone. For the duration, the target has a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks made to climb. While climbing this way, it needs at least one free hand, and it can't move along ceilings or other surfaces that overhang it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Cloak Pool
entries: Choose a color pool on the Astral Plane, or another stationary magical portal no larger than a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, that you can see within range. For the duration, the portal is {@condition Invisible|XPHB}, and it takes on the appearance of its surroundings, such as the silver-gray void of the Astral Plane. The spell hides only the portal, not anything around it or passing through it, and the portal still functions normally.

A creature that has {@sense Truesight|XPHB} or that is under the effect of {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} sees the portal normally. {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} reveals an aura of illusion where it lies.

spell.name: Cloak of Bravery
entries: You sweep your arm across the area, cloaking your allies in a glittering mantle of courage. Choose any number of creatures within a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you, which can include you. The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition ends on each target, and for the duration, each target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end that condition.

spell.name: Cloak of Dark Power
entries: A dim gray haze surrounds a willing creature you touch, bending light around it into a patch of shifting dusk. The haze doesn't hinder anyone's vision. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits:

items: It doesn't suffer the effects of Sunlight Sensitivity or any similar trait that hinders it in sunlight or {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.
It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage.

spell.name: Cloak of the Sea
entries: A blue-green glow passes from your hand into a willing creature you touch, tinting its skin the same shade. For the duration, the target can breathe underwater.
While the target is completely submerged, it also gains the following benefits:

items: It has a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to twice its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

Its body shimmers with the water around it, and attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. An attacker is immune to this effect if it has {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} or {@sense Truesight|XPHB}.

Its movement and attacks are unaffected by being underwater, so it doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on melee weapon attacks for fighting underwater, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} nor cause it to have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.
It suffers no ill effects from cold water or the pressure of deep water.

entries: The target can leave and reenter the water without ending the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Close Wounds

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself takes damage

entries: With a quick word of power, you close the wound the instant it opens. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus your spellcasting ability modifier. This healing happens immediately after the triggering damage is dealt; if that damage reduced the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the target doesn't have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} or {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition from it, provided this healing leaves it with at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.
This spell can't save a creature that the triggering damage killed outright.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Cloud Wings
entries: Mist forms crude wings that cling to the back of a willing creature you touch. If the target has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}, that speed increases by 30 feet for the duration. In addition, the target can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while flying, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against being moved or knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB} by wind.
The spell doesn't let a creature fly if it can't already do so, and it has no effect on its other speeds.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Cloud of Bewilderment
entries: You exhale a spray of noxious vapor that fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range. The Cube is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. The vapor lingers for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it.

Each creature that starts its turn in the Cube must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, the creature can't take an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, though it can still move, including out of the cloud. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on this save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Cube's size increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Cloud-Walkers
entries: You blow a kiss toward each of up to ten willing creatures you can see within range, which can include you, and gaseous pads of cloudstuff form on their feet. For the duration, each target has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet and can hover, but only while under the open sky. If a target moves indoors or underground, it descends 60 feet per round until it lands, taking no falling damage.

A target can shake off the cloudstuff as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, ending the spell on itself. You can end the spell early only for all targets at once. When the spell ends for a target that is still aloft, it falls unless it can stop the fall.

spell.name: Cloudburst
entries: With a peal of thunder, clouds gather and release a drenching downpour in a 100-foot-radius, 100-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point you can see within range. The spell fails if the point isn't outdoors under the open sky, or if it is underwater or in a desert. Until the spell ends, the following effects apply within the Cylinder:

items: The area is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}, and creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight or hearing.
Ranged weapon attack rolls have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if the attacker or the target is in the area.
Exposed flames are extinguished. A protected flame, such as a lantern's, has a 50 percent chance to go out when the spell starts or when it enters the area.
Whenever a creature or object in the area takes Fire damage, it reduces that damage by 1 for each damage die rolled.

entries: When the spell ends, the water evaporates over the next 10 minutes. The rainwater doesn't slake thirst or nourish plants.

spell.name: Clutch of Orcus
entries: You clench your hand into a claw, and magical force grips the heart of a Humanoid you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for the duration. At the start of each of its turns, the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} target takes {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
If this damage kills the target, its smoking heart appears in your hand.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Cocoon

m.text: a silkworm cocoon and spun silk worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Silk threads coalesce from the air around the corpse of a creature within range that died within the last minute, wrapping it in a cocoon and beginning a slow rebirth. The creature's soul must be willing and free to return; otherwise, the spell fails and the material component isn't consumed.

The cocoon protects the body from decay and has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage. While the creature is cocooned, the time it has been dead doesn't count against the time limits of spells such as {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB} or {@spell Resurrection|XPHB}. If the creature is restored to life by any spell within 7 days, the cocoon dissolves and the creature suffers no penalties that spell would normally impose, and it returns with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

If the creature hasn't been restored to life when the 7 days end, it emerges from the cocoon reincarnated, as if by the {@spell Reincarnate|XPHB} spell, with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and no {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. Any diseases, curses, and poisons that afflicted it at death are gone.

spell.name: Cold Fire
entries: You chill a fire or a creature within range. Choose one of the following effects.

items.name: Cold Flames
entries: Choose one nonmagical fire that fits within a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} or one magical fire of that size created by a spell of level 1 or lower. For 10 minutes, the flames burn blue-white and give off cold instead of heat. Anything that would take Fire damage from the fire takes Cold damage instead, and the fire doesn't ignite flammable objects.

items.name: Chilling Flare
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 2d10} Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 1, and the level of a magical fire you can affect increases by 1 for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Cold Snap
entries: You call down a bitter cold front within 1 mile of you. The spell lasts for {@dice 2d4} hours (roll when you cast it). You must be outdoors to cast this spell.

Within {@dice 1d4 × 10} minutes, the temperature in the area drops to 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower, imposing {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG} on creatures in the area; any rain becomes snow or sleet. A thin, freezing mist hangs in the air, but it doesn't obscure vision or hinder movement. Still water in the area freezes, and after 1 hour the ice is thick enough to bear the weight of a Medium creature.
While the spell lasts, whenever a spell deals Cold damage to a target in the area, that damage increases by 1 for each Cold damage die rolled.
When the spell ends, the temperature returns to normal over the course of an hour.

spell.name: Combust

components.m: a drop of oil and a piece of flint

entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target's flammable gear erupts into flame, even if it is damp: the target takes {@damage 4d8} Fire damage and starts {@hazard burning|XPHB}.
Alternatively, you can touch a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried and weighs no more than 250 pounds. The object takes {@damage 4d8} Fire damage and starts {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Cometfall
entries: A blazing comet of rock and ice plunges from above onto a point on the ground that you can see within range. The point must have at least 40 feet of open space above it, or the spell fails and is wasted. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 5d6} Cold damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

The comet shatters on impact, and its rubble turns the ground in the area into {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until cleared. Clearing each 5-foot-square portion of it requires at least 1 minute of work.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Bludgeoning damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d10|6-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Cone of Dimness
entries: A translucent gray cone bursts from your hand, convincing those within it that darkness has swallowed them. Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for the duration.

A Blinded creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it is no longer Blinded, but its vision stays dim and hazy: it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the spell ends.

spell.name: Consumptive Field
entries: A field of hungering death surrounds you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration. Whenever a creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but isn't dead, including when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} there, when the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters its space, or when it starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it dies. A creature makes this save only once per casting of this spell.

Whenever a creature other than you dies in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} (from this spell or otherwise), unless it is a Construct or an Undead, you inhale its last breath. You gain {@dice 2d8} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Temporary Hit Points increase by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 4. In addition, the spell also affects a creature that has a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to or less than 7 times the number of slot levels above 4 (7 with a level 5 slot, 21 with a level 7 slot, 35 with a level 9 slot), including when it drops to that number or lower in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

spell.name: Contagious Fog
entries: You create a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of brown, fever-laden fog centered on a point within range. The fog is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} and lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it, ending the spell. It can't be created underwater and can't pass into liquids.

When a creature enters the fog for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage and contracts the shakes: it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, and while {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, rolling along the ground or the surface of water. The fog is heavier than air, sinking to the lowest available level and pouring down openings, even through narrow cracks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Contagious Touch
entries: Your hand withers with disease. When you cast the spell, choose one ability. Until the spell ends, you can touch a creature within your reach as part of casting the spell and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on each of your later turns.

The touched creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws made with the chosen ability. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Contingent Energy Resistance
entries: A pearlescent film sinks into your skin. When you cast the spell, choose one damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. The first time you take damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, you gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage type, including against the triggering damage. The Resistance lasts for 1 hour or until this spell ends, whichever comes first.
You can have only one Contingent Energy Resistance in effect on you at a time. If you cast it again, the earlier casting ends.

spell.name: Conviction

components.m: a small parchment bearing a holy passage

entries: A sea-blue nimbus surrounds a willing creature you touch, bolstering its resolve. Until the spell ends, whenever the target makes a saving throw, it adds {@dice 1d4} to the save.
A creature can't benefit from this spell and {@spell Bless|XPHB} at the same time. While a creature is affected by both, it gains only the benefit of {@spell Bless|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Corona of Cold
entries: Numbing cold radiates from you in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage.

Whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters the space of a creature other than you and whenever such a creature enters the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} or ends its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d8} Cold damage and shivers uncontrollably, halving its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} until the start of its next turn. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Corporeal Instability
entries: You touch a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, and its body begins to melt into a writhing, amorphous mass. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected for the duration.

While affected, the target drops whatever it is holding and can't hold or use items, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 10 feet (unless it is already lower), it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition, and it can't cast spells or make attack rolls. Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against it becomes a normal hit.
At the end of each of its turns, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage from the shock of its unmade body, then repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

spell.name: Corpse Candle

m.text: a piece of an unpreserved corpse, which the spell consumes

entries: A ghostly, severed hand bearing a lit candle appears at a point you choose within range. The candle sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

Creatures and objects in the Bright Light can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, and creatures and objects on the Ethereal Plane within it are visible as wispy outlines, though they remain out of reach.

On each of your turns, you can move the hand up to 50 feet to a point within range (no action required). The hand and candle are intangible and can pass through creatures and objects. They can't be attacked or damaged, but {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can end the spell. The spell ends if the hand is ever more than 60 feet from you.

spell.name: Corrosive Grasp
entries: Your hand glistens with smoking acid that doesn't harm you. When you cast the spell and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on each of your later turns until it ends, you can make a melee spell attack against one creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} Acid damage.
In addition, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} or a natural weapon and deal damage, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Acid damage to it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of the melee spell attack increases by {@scaledamage 1d10|1-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Countermoon

components.m: a hair, scale, or other cast-off bit from a creature of the target's lycanthropic kind

entries: Translucent red chains lash out at a lycanthrope you can see within range, such as a {@creature Werewolf|XMM} or a {@creature Wererat|XMM}, or at a creature afflicted with a lycanthrope's curse. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or immediately return to its true form, and it can't change its shape by any means, voluntarily or involuntarily, for the duration. A creature that isn't a lycanthrope or afflicted with lycanthropy is unaffected.

spell.name: Crabwalk
entries: You touch a willing creature, which gains a fast, scuttling gait. Until the spell ends, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

In addition, when the target moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then makes a melee attack roll against that creature on the same turn, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that attack roll. Only the first such attack roll each turn benefits.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Crawling Darkness
entries: A shroud of dark, writhing tentacles forms around your body. The tentacles don't hinder your movement or spellcasting, and they completely hide your features, so you can't be identified by sight. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Shrouded.
entries: Ranged attack rolls against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

items.name: Grasping Limbs.
entries: You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks.

items.name: Lashing Retort.
entries: Whenever a creature within 10 feet of you hits you with an attack roll, the tentacles strike back, dealing {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning damage to the attacker.

items.name: Seize.
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can cause the tentacles to snatch at one creature you can see within 10 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). The tentacles can grapple only one creature at a time, and grappling with them doesn't require a free hand.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of Lashing Retort increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|5-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Creaking Cacophony
entries: A deafening din of groaning wood and creaking branches fills a 40-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. The noise is as loud as a pitched battle and can be heard up to 1 mile away. Until the spell ends, each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} that doesn't have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition is subjected to the following effects:

items: It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing.
It has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Thunder damage unless it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to that damage.

Whenever it casts a spell, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

spell.name: Create Magic Tattoo

m.text: tattoo inks worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes, and tattoo needles

entries: You touch a willing creature and inscribe a magic tattoo on its skin. Choose one of the following benefits, which the tattoo grants to the creature until the spell ends:

items.name: Warding.
entries: Choose Constitution, Dexterity, or Wisdom. The creature has a +2 bonus to saving throws of the chosen ability.

items.name: Fortune.
entries: The creature has a +1 bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Deflection.
entries: The creature has a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

A creature can bear up to three tattoos from this spell at a time, and bonuses from multiple tattoos to the same roll or statistic don't stack. Casting the spell on a creature that already bears three of these tattoos fails, but the material component isn't consumed. The tattoo fades when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 4+ spell slot, you can instead choose one of these benefits: a +1 bonus to all saving throws, or a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

When you cast it using a level 7+ spell slot, you can also choose one of these benefits: {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells; a 2-point increase to one ability score of your choice, to a maximum of 20; or a +1 bonus to the creature's spell save DC and spell attack rolls.

spell.name: Creeping Cold

m.text: a small glass or pottery vessel worth 25+ GP filled with ice, snow, or water

entries: You make a crushing gesture at a creature you can see within range, turning its sweat to blistering ice on and beneath its skin. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d6} Cold damage immediately, {@damage 2d6} Cold damage at the end of its next turn, and {@damage 3d6} Cold damage at the end of its turn after that. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage each time. The target makes only the one saving throw against this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2. With a level 4+ spell slot, the spell lasts 1 round longer: the target also takes {@damage 4d6} Cold damage at the end of its third turn (half on a successful save), and on a failed save its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the spell ends.

spell.name: Critical Strike
entries: You speak an ancient phrase, and your weapon is drawn toward the gaps in your foes' guard. Until the end of this turn, whenever you make an attack roll with a melee weapon against a creature that has at least one of your allies within 5 feet of it (and that ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition), or against a creature you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} against, you gain the following benefits:

items: The attack scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
The first time you hit with such an attack this turn, it deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the weapon's type.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Crown of Glory
entries: You crown yourself with your deity's favor and are wreathed in an aura of celestial authority that draws every eye toward you. Until the spell ends, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.

In addition, you and up to ten other creatures of your choice that you can see within range are inspired by your glory. Each target gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and until the spell ends, each target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and adds {@dice 1d6} to its {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}.

spell.name: Crumble
entries: You bring the forces of erosion to bear on a Construct or an object you can see within range that isn't being worn or carried, aging it centuries in a few seconds. The target must have been fabricated rather than formed by nature (such as a stone bridge, a wooden door, an iron gate, or a Construct), and it must be Large or smaller. If you target a structure, you affect a portion of it no larger than a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}.

A Construct makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d10} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. An object automatically fails the save, and the damage ignores its {@variantrule Damage Threshold|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d10|3-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 3. The target can be Huge if you use a level 5+ spell slot (portion of a structure up to a 20-foot Cube) or Gargantuan if you use a level 7+ spell slot (up to a 40-foot Cube).

spell.name: Curse of Ill Fortune
entries: You loose a stream of foul incantations at a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for the duration. Whenever a cursed target makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it subtracts {@dice 1d6} from the roll. {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} ends the curse on a target. This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
