entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. Alternatively, with a level 5+ spell slot, you can instead target each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range.

spell.name: Curse of Impending Blades

components.m: a nail driven through a piece of leather

entries: A small black dagger of shadow streaks from your hand and strikes a creature you can see within range, cursing it. The target gets no saving throw. Until the spell ends, a cursed target stumbles into harm's way, and its {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is reduced by 2. {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can't end this curse, but {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} can.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. Alternatively, with a level 3+ spell slot, you can instead curse each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each of those creatures makes a Wisdom saving throw and is cursed only on a failed save.

spell.name: Curse of Lycanthropy
entries: Your hand dripping with blood, you grip a Humanoid and call the curse of the wererat into its flesh. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 8d8} Necrotic damage and is cursed for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't cursed.

While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it takes {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns as vermin gnaw at it from within. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the curse on itself on a success. {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} also ends the curse.

If the target dies while cursed, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Wererat|XMM|Wererats} in hybrid form claw their way out of its body, appearing in unoccupied spaces as close to it as possible. The wererats aren't under your control, but they don't attack you or your allies. They roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} as a group and attack other creatures nearby; if no such creature is present, they scurry away to spread their lycanthropy. They remain after the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Cursed Blade
entries: You whisper a vehement curse and draw your finger along a melee weapon. Until the spell ends, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Necrotic damage on a hit, and its wounds are cursed: whenever a creature takes damage from an attack made with the weapon, the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The creature dies if this effect reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until the creature is targeted by {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} or similar magic.

A creature killed by an attack with the weapon while the spell lasts can't be raised from the dead until {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} or similar magic is cast on its body, unless it is returned to life by {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or {@spell Wish|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Cutting Hand
entries: A smooth, metallic edge extrudes from one of your hands, turning it into a flexible, razor-sharp blade. Until the spell ends, you can't hold anything with that hand, and you can make melee attacks with the blade. It counts as a magic Simple Melee weapon with which you have proficiency, it has the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} properties, and it deals {@damage 1d8} Slashing damage on a hit. You can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of attacks with the blade.
The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you dismiss it (no action required).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The blade has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with a level 3-4 spell slot, a +2 bonus with a level 5-6 spell slot, or a +3 bonus with a level 7+ spell slot.

spell.name: Cyclonic Blast
entries: A twisting torrent of wind, like a tornado turned on its side, blasts from your fingertips in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d8} Bludgeoning damage and, if it is Huge or smaller, is pushed 30 feet away from you in a direction following the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} (60 feet if it is flying). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

Nonmagical objects in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that aren't being worn or carried also take the damage; objects larger than Large take half damage. If the damage destroys an object or a barrier blocking the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, the blast continues beyond it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Daggerspell Stance
entries: The daggers in your hands glow silver and move as though they were part of your body. While you hold a Dagger in each hand for the duration, you gain the following benefits.

items.name: Bladework.
entries: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack using a Dagger, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Force damage, and you have a +1 bonus to the attack rolls of your other Dagger attacks until the end of that turn.

items.name: Spell Deflection.
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action, you also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Turning Blades.
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action, you also have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn.
The spell ends early if you stop holding a Dagger in either hand at the end of a turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Dance of the Unicorn
entries: A cool, cleansing mist swirls around you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration, leaving everything it touches damp. The air within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is always clean and breathable: nonmagical smoke, dust, fumes, spores, and inhaled poisons are negated as soon as they enter it, and they can't make the area {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} or {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.

Any cloud, fog, gas, or vapor created by a spell of level 4 or lower, such as {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB}, {@spell Stinking Cloud|XPHB}, or {@spell Cloudkill|XPHB}, is suppressed in the parts of its area that overlap the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

While in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, you and creatures of your choice have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against magical clouds, gases, and vapors, as well as against breath weapons.

spell.name: Dark Way
entries: A ribbon of solid shadow, 5 feet wide and up to 60 feet long, arches between two points you can see within range. Each end must rest on a solid surface, but the bridge can rise or fall at any angle between them. It must form an unbroken span when it appears, or the spell fails.
The bridge is weightless, immune to all damage, and can't be moved. Creatures can walk on it normally; it is no more slippery than an ordinary stone floor.

The bridge supports up to 1,000 pounds at once. If a creature or object would push the total weight on the bridge above that limit, that creature or object falls through it as if the bridge weren't there. You never fall through the bridge unless your weight alone exceeds the limit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The bridge's maximum length increases by 30 feet, and the weight it supports increases by 500 pounds, for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Darkbolt
entries: Beams of jet-black power gather in your palm. When you cast the spell, you hurl three bolts at one target or several within range. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can hurl one more bolt. The spell ends once you have hurled seven bolts.

Make a ranged spell attack for each bolt. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. An Undead hit by a bolt takes no damage but still makes the saving throw. A creature makes this save only once per turn, no matter how many bolts hit it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You hurl one additional bolt when you cast the spell, and the spell's limit of bolts increases by one, for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Darkfire
entries: Dark flames appear in your hand. They shed no light and are {@condition Invisible|XPHB} to creatures without {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} or {@sense Truesight|XPHB}, though they give off the heat of a real fire and harm neither you nor your equipment. A creature with {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} sees them as easily as a normal flame in darkness, so the flames can serve as a signal visible only to such creatures.

When you cast this spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can strike a creature within 5 feet of you or hurl the flames at a creature within 120 feet of you, and a new set of flames immediately appears in your hand. Make a melee or ranged spell attack, as appropriate. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage.
The flames can't exist underwater; the spell ends if your hand is submerged.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Dawn
entries: You let out a cry like a rooster's call. Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you that is asleep wakes up. If a creature has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition because of an effect that ends when the creature is shaken awake, such as the {@spell Sleep|XPHB} spell, that effect ends on it.
This spell has no effect on a creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

spell.name: Dead End
entries: You touch up to three willing creatures. For the duration, an illusion perfectly hides the trail each target leaves behind, masking its tracks, scent, and every other sign of its passage, even from touch and taste.

A creature attempting to track a target by any means, including Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks, Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks, or a keen sense of smell, finds no trail unless it first succeeds on an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the creature sees through the illusion and can track the targets normally. Creatures that merely pass through an area the targets crossed don't interact with the illusion.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Deadfall
entries: A towering mass of logs, branches, and fallen trees forms in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on the ground you can see within range, then collapses with a deafening roar. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d10} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried also take the damage.

The collapsed wood remains as a tangle of brush 5 feet high covering the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}'s base. That area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until it is cleared, which takes at least 1 hour of work for each 5-foot-square portion.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d10|8-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 8.

spell.name: Deafening Clang
entries: You touch a weapon, which rings like a struck tuning fork. Until the start of your next turn, whenever an attack with the weapon hits a creature, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-5|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Death Armor

m.text: a paste of ground bone and an onyx worth 50+ GP

entries: A wreath of lightless black flames crackles around you for the duration. Whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack roll, the flames lash it, and it takes {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Death Dragon
entries: You gird yourself in a dragon-shaped cocoon of bone and necrotic energy. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits and drawbacks.

items.name: Bone Carapace.
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} can't be lower than 18.

items.name: Dragon Claws.
entries: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage plus your Strength modifier. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} with one hand, you can make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} with your other hand as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}; you don't add your ability modifier to that strike's damage unless the modifier is negative.

items.name: Dread Breath.
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you exhale a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} of terror. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Death Touch.
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d10} Necrotic damage.

items.name: Encased.
entries: You can't cast spells that have Somatic or Material components.

spell.name: Death Pact

m.text: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a willing creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead and bind it in a pact with your deity or patron that will return it to life if it is slain. The target's Constitution score is permanently reduced by 2. This reduction can't be undone while the pact lasts, and once the pact ends, only a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell can restore it.

If the target dies while the spell is in effect, the spell ends and the target immediately returns to life, as if by the {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} spell. A creature can be the subject of only one death pact at a time.

spell.name: Death Throes
entries: You bind a vengeful charge of force into your own flesh. If you die before the spell ends, your body explodes. Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from your body makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d8} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The explosion destroys your body and everything you are wearing or carrying that isn't magical, so you can be returned to life only by a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell or similar magic that doesn't require a body.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Decomposition
entries: An air of decay surrounds you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration. Whenever a creature of your choice that isn't a Construct or an Undead takes damage while in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, its wound festers if it doesn't already have a festering wound from this spell. A creature with a festering wound takes {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, even if it leaves the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

A festering wound closes when the creature regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when a creature takes an action to tend the wound and succeeds on a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. Once the wound closes, the next time the creature takes damage while in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, a new wound begins to fester.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Decoy Image
entries: To flush out ambushes, you create illusory duplicates of yourself and each ally within 30 feet of you, appearing at a point you can see within range. The duplicates include sound, smell, and temperature and exactly mimic everything you and those allies do, including speech. As you move, the duplicates stay at the same distance and direction from you. An ally that moves more than 30 feet from you vanishes from the illusion.

The illusion can't deal damage or cause conditions, and physical interaction reveals it as an illusion, since things pass through it. A creature that takes a {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine the duplicates can determine that they are illusions with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. If the duplicates' terrain differs noticeably from yours, or one of you does something the duplicates can't plausibly mimic (such as climbing a tree where none stands near them), any creature watching them can make this check without taking an action. A creature that discerns the illusion sees through all the duplicates.

spell.name: Deep Breath

time.condition: which you take when you are submerged in a liquid or start to suffocate

entries: Your lungs instantly fill with air and keep refilling for the duration, so you don't need to breathe. When the spell ends, you can hold your breath as if you had just inhaled (see {@hazard Suffocation|XPHB}).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration increases to 10 minutes with a level 2 spell slot and to 1 hour with a level 3+ spell slot.

spell.name: Deeper Darkvision

components.m: a pinch of dried carrot or an agate

entries: For the duration, a willing creature you touch has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 150 feet. Within 120 feet, this Darkvision also lets the creature see normally in magical and nonmagical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, such as that created by the {@spell Darkness|XPHB} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Defenestrating Sphere

m.text: a gray pearl worth 100+ GP

entries: You create a 5-foot-diameter sphere of howling wind in an unoccupied space within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sphere appears, you can make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Bludgeoning damage, and if it is a Large or smaller creature, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target is hurled up to 30 feet in a direction you choose, which can be up to 15 feet upward, and it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition when it lands. If there is a window, doorway, or similar opening within that distance, you can hurl the target through it. A target hurled upward falls unless it can hover.
If a hurled target strikes a solid surface before it travels the full distance, it stops and takes {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it didn't travel.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet and repeat the attack against one creature or object within 5 feet of it. The sphere can fly, and it vanishes if it ends a turn more than 120 feet away from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of the sphere's attack increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Dehydrate
entries: You draw the moisture out of one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 4d8} Necrotic damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.
Ooze and Plant creatures, and creatures made of water such as a {@creature Water Elemental|XMM}, have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this save. This spell has no effect on Constructs and Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Deific Vengeance
entries: You call on divine power to punish one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target is Undead, it takes {@damage 6d8} Radiant damage instead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2, or by 2d8 if the target is Undead.

spell.name: Delay Death

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points or would die

entries: A soft golden glow surrounds the target's heart. For the duration, the target can't die as a result of damage or failed {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}. It still falls {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, still makes Death Saving Throws, and still records failures, but it doesn't die from three failures or from damage that would kill it outright, and its failures can exceed three. If the triggering event would have killed the target, it instead remains at 0 Hit Points.
Effects that kill without dealing damage, or that turn the body to dust (such as {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB}), still kill the target.

If the target regains any Hit Points, its Death Saving Throw failures and successes reset as normal. When the spell ends, the target dies if it has 0 Hit Points and three or more Death Saving Throw failures.

spell.name: Delay Disease
entries: You touch a creature and hold any nonmagical disease afflicting it in check. For the duration, the target suffers none of the disease's effects, makes no saving throws against it, and the disease doesn't progress. Any disease the target is exposed to during the duration doesn't begin to take effect until the spell ends.
This spell doesn't cure the disease or undo any harm it has already caused.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 3+ spell slot, the spell also suppresses magical diseases, such as {@spell Contagion|XPHB}. While a magical disease is suppressed, any condition it imposes has no effect on the target.

spell.name: Delusions of Grandeur
entries: You flatter one creature you can see within range, filling its mind with a phantasm of its own greatness. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target believes itself far more capable and safe than it really is for the duration. Its wounds seem like scratches, and its foes seem weak and cowed.

While affected, the target subtracts {@dice 1d4} from its attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and it can't take the {@action Dodge|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action. The target doesn't realize it is under the effect of a spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Fiend Dirge
entries: You chant a dirge that boils the blood of fiends at one creature you can see within range. If the target isn't a Fiend, the spell has no effect on it.
A Fiend target takes {@damage 3d6} Radiant damage when you cast the spell and again at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends. No saving throw is allowed against this damage.
If the target is a Demon or a Devil, it also makes a Constitution saving throw when you cast the spell. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the spell ends.
At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Demonhide
entries: You touch a willing creature, and its skin takes on a deep red, fiendish luster. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage, and whenever it takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, that damage is reduced by an amount equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1). This reduction doesn't apply to Radiant damage or to damage from a weapon made of silver or cold iron.
If the target is a Fiend, it also has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that would end, banish, or turn it.

spell.name: Desiccating Bubble

components.m: a tiny bag of air and a sprinkle of dust

entries: You create a 5-foot-diameter globe of supernaturally dry air in an unoccupied space within range. It lasts for the duration. When the globe appears, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the globe up to 30 feet. It can leap across gaps and over obstacles up to 30 feet but can't fly, and it can't batter down obstacles. Objects pass through it harmlessly.

If you move the globe into a creature's space, the globe stops moving for the turn, and that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage as moisture is drawn from its body. Ooze creatures and creatures made of water, such as a {@creature Water Elemental|XMM}, take {@damage 3d12} Necrotic damage instead.
The globe vanishes if it ends a turn more than 120 feet away from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} (or 1d12 against Oozes and creatures made of water) for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Detect Favored Enemy
entries: When you cast the spell, choose a creature type, such as Fiend or Undead. If you choose Humanoid, you can instead choose a specific kind of Humanoid, such as orcs or goblinoids. For the duration, you sense whether any creature of that type is within 60 feet of you, and how many there are.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can focus on those creatures. You learn the location of each of them within range, and whether each one's Challenge Rating or level is lower than, about equal to, or higher than your level.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

spell.name: Diamondsteel

m.text: diamond dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a suit of metal armor, and it gains a sparkling, diamond-hard sheen for the duration. While the armor is worn, any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against the wearer becomes a normal hit, and Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage the wearer takes is reduced by an amount based on the armor's base Armor Class, as shown below.
If the armor is being worn by an unwilling creature, that creature can make a Charisma saving throw to negate the spell.

spell.name: Dinosaur Stampede
entries: A herd of spectral, stampeding dinosaurs fills a 20-foot-radius, 10-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on the ground within range. The Cylinder lasts for the duration.

When the Cylinder appears, each creature in it makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d10} Force damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the Cylinder moves into its space, when it enters the Cylinder for the first time on a turn, or when it ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the Cylinder up to 40 feet along the ground.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d10|6-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Dire Hunger
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed. On a failed save, the target is overcome by a ravenous hunger for the duration. Its jaws stretch into a toothy snout, and it gains a bite attack that it is proficient with. On a hit, the bite deals Piercing damage based on the target's size, as shown below, plus its Strength modifier. If the target already has a bite attack that deals more damage, it uses that attack instead.

While affected, the target can't take reactions, and on each of its turns, it must use its movement to approach the nearest creature it can see, avoiding obvious hazards, and use its action to make one bite attack against that creature, regardless of allegiance. If it can't reach a creature, it uses its action to search for one.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Dirge
entries: You sing a dirge, and translucent spectral skulls drift down like snow in a 50-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you for the duration. Whenever a creature of your choice starts its turn in the Emanation, it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 5d6} Necrotic damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it is unaffected this turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Dirge of Discord

components.m: a pinch of ashes from a creature that hunts by sound

entries: A cacophony of screams, wails, and howls fills the minds of creatures in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Wisdom saving throw. A creature that can't hear automatically succeeds. On a failed save, a creature is affected for the duration. While affected, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and whenever it casts a spell, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or the spell fails and is wasted.
An affected creature repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Discern Shapechanger

m.text: a balm of honey and lotus flower worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You smear the balm on your eyelids, and your eyes pierce false forms. When you cast the spell and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on your later turns, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. You learn whether the creature is disguised by an illusion, has its form altered by magic (such as {@spell Alter Self|XPHB} or {@spell Polymorph|XPHB}), or has shape-shifted using a trait or feature, and if so, you see its true form superimposed over its current one.

If the creature is in its true form but has a trait or feature that lets it shape-shift (as a lycanthrope or {@creature Doppelganger|XMM} does), you sense that it is a shape-shifter, though you don't learn which forms it can assume. Spells such as {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} that a creature merely casts don't count as such a trait or feature.

spell.name: Discolor Pool
entries: Choose a color pool on the Astral Plane, or another stationary magical portal no larger than a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, that you can see within range. For the duration, the portal takes on the color and appearance of a portal leading to a different destination of your choice, including any glimpses of that destination visible through it. The portal still leads to its true destination.

A creature that takes the {@action Study|XPHB} action to examine the portal can make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, recognizing the illusion on a success. A creature that has {@sense Truesight|XPHB} sees the portal's true appearance, and {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} reveals an aura of illusion on it.

spell.name: Disguise Undead

components.m: the cocoon of a death's-head moth

entries: You touch a corporeal Undead that is willing or under your control and make it—including its clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings—look different until the spell ends. It can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. It must keep the same basic arrangement of limbs, but otherwise the extent of the illusion is up to you; a {@creature Ghoul|XMM} could pass for a living Humanoid courtier, for example. The spell doesn't grant the abilities, voice, or mannerisms of the chosen form.
Spells and other magical effects that detect creature types, such as {@spell Detect Evil and Good|XPHB} or a Paladin's Divine Sense, perceive the target as a creature of the type it appears to be.

The changes fail to hold up to physical inspection; a creature that touches the target feels its true form. To discern that the target is disguised, a creature must take the {@action Study|XPHB} action to inspect its appearance and succeed on an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC.

spell.name: Dispel Ward
entries: Choose one object, or one point, within range. Any Abjuration spell of level 1 on that object, or whose area includes that point, ends; examples include {@spell Alarm|XPHB}, {@spell Arcane Lock|XPHB}, {@spell Glyph of Warding|XPHB}, and {@spell Guards and Wards|XPHB}. For each such spell of level 2 or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends. A glyph, ward, or similar spell ended this way isn't triggered.
This spell has no effect on spells affecting creatures, or on spells of any school other than Abjuration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You automatically end an Abjuration spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

spell.name: Dispelling Breath
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB}, to cast this spell. The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it glitters with motes of starlight that unravel magic. Before the breath's normal effects are resolved, the following happen:

items: For each creature or object that fails its saving throw against the breath, any spell of level 5 or lower on it ends. For each spell of level 6 or higher on it, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

If a creature that was summoned or created by a spell fails its saving throw against the breath, that spell ends if it is level 5 or lower; if it is level 6 or higher, make the same ability check to end it.
Each spell whose area is centered on a point within the breath's area, or that creates an effect occupying a space there, is affected in the same way.

entries: Magic items aren't affected, and neither are creatures and objects that succeed on their saves against the breath. You can choose for any spell you cast to be unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You automatically end a spell if its level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

spell.name: Dispelling Screen

components.m: a sheet of fine lead crystal

entries: You create a shimmering, immobile screen of violet energy at a point you choose within range. The screen appears in any orientation you choose, as a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels, each contiguous with another panel, or as a hemispherical dome or globe with a radius of up to 10 feet. The screen doesn't block creatures or objects. If it cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature chooses which side of the screen it is on.

The first time on a turn that a creature or an object that isn't being worn or carried passes through the screen, any spell of level 4 or lower on it ends. For each spell of level 5 or higher on it, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends. Objects worn or carried by a creature passing through the screen aren't affected. An unattended magic item that passes through has its magical properties suppressed for 1 minute.

Spells and other magical effects that aren't on a creature or an object, such as the area of {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} or {@spell Spirit Guardians|XPHB}, can't extend through the screen. A spell that targets a creature or an object can be cast through it normally.
{@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can end the screen, and a {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell destroys it instantly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The level of spells the screen ends automatically increases by 1 for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Displacer Form

components.m: a claw from a displacer beast

entries: You shape-shift into the sleek, six-legged form of a {@creature Displacer Beast|XMM}, with a pair of barbed tentacles sprouting from your shoulders. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Beast Body
entries: Your size becomes Large (if there is room), your creature type becomes Monstrosity, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 40 feet if it was lower, and you gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. If you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

items.name: Displacement
entries: Attack rolls against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, since you project an illusion that makes you appear to be near your actual location. This benefit is suppressed while you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. A creature is unaffected by this benefit if it has {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} or {@sense Truesight|XPHB}.

items.name: Avoidance
entries: If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the save and half damage if you fail. You can't use this benefit while you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Tentacles
entries: You can make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} with your tentacles, which have a reach of 10 feet. You can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for their attack and damage rolls, and on a hit they deal Piercing damage equal to {@damage 1d8} plus that modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional tentacle attack as part of that action.

Your gear melds into your new form, except for one item you choose to hold in a tentacle, such as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} or a component. You can speak and cast spells normally while in this form.

spell.name: Disquietude
entries: You sing a warning of unseen dangers and untrustworthy allies to one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be overcome with distrust of everyone around it for the duration. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on this save.

While affected, the target can't willingly move to a space within 15 feet of any other creature. If it starts its turn within 15 feet of another creature, it must use its movement to move to a space at least 15 feet away from all other creatures before it can take any action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. If it can't reach such a space, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and doesn't move that turn.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Dissonant Chant
entries: A discordant chant fills a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range, continuing on its own once you fall silent. For the duration, the following effects apply to every creature in the area other than you:

items: When the creature casts a spell, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.
The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other effects that require it to hear or understand spoken words, such as {@spell Command|XPHB} and {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}.

entries: The chant can't be heard within the area of a {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell, and creatures there are unaffected.

spell.name: Dissonant Chord
entries: You emit a terrible, piercing note that pulses outward like a shockwave. Each other creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 7d8} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The note can be heard up to 300 feet away.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Distort Speech
entries: You point at one creature you can see within range and babble nonsense. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have its speech twisted into gibberish for the duration.

While affected, whenever the target casts a spell that has a Verbal component, there is a {@chance 50|||The spell fails!|The spell does not fail.} chance that the spell fails; the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted, but any spell slot isn't expended. Likewise, whenever the target speaks, including to activate a magic item with a command word, there is a 50 percent chance that its words come out as incomprehensible gibberish and have no effect.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Distract
entries: You fill up to three creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart, with a sudden zest for every sight, sound, and scent around them. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be distracted for the duration.

A distracted target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. It also can't take Reactions.
At the end of each of its turns, a distracted target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Distract Assailant

components.m: the dried wing of a fly

entries: You buzz like a fly and swat at the air, and one creature you can see within range starts at shadows and unseen assailants. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be caught off guard until the start of its next turn. While caught off guard, it can't take Reactions, and attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Distracting Ray

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell

entries: You fire a multicolored ray at the creature, which bursts into a dizzying swirl of flashing lights around it. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or its spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

spell.name: Divine Agility
entries: You call on divine power to imbue a willing creature you touch with supernatural grace. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits:

items: It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks, Dexterity saving throws, and attack rolls that use Dexterity.
It gains a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.
When it is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails.

spell.name: Divine Insight
entries: You whisper a short prayer, and your deity's presence fills you with confidence. Once before the spell ends, immediately before you make an ability check, you can end the spell (no action required) to have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on that check and add a bonus to it equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1).
You can't benefit from more than one Divine Insight spell at a time.

spell.name: Divine Interdiction
entries: You call on your deity to sever another's link to divine power. Choose a point, an object, or a creature within range. A 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of interdiction radiates from that point or object, or from that creature, for the duration. If you choose a creature, it makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a successful save, the spell fails. The {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} moves with the object or creature you chose; otherwise it is stationary.

While in the area, a creature can't use Channel Divinity, and it can't use any other feature or trait that expends a use of Channel Divinity. This prevents such uses as a Cleric's Divine Spark and Turn Undead and a Paladin's Divine Sense, but it doesn't affect spells or other uses of divine magic.

spell.name: Divine Protection
entries: Golden light washes over your companions. Choose any number of creatures you can see in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. For the duration, each target gains a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} and saving throws.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The radius of the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} increases by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Divine Sacrifice
entries: You offer your own life force to empower your strikes. Until the spell ends, when you make your first attack roll with a weapon on each of your turns, you can pour your vitality into the attack. If you do, you take 5 damage, which can't be reduced in any way, whether the attack hits or misses. If the attack hits, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Dolorous Blow
entries: You touch a weapon, and a dull red aura surrounds it. Until the spell ends, an attack roll made with the weapon scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 18, 19, or 20 on the d20.

This effect doesn't combine with any other feature, property, or magic that lets the wielder score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll lower than 20; the wielder uses whichever range is wider. The spell can't target an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} or a creature's natural weapons, such as claws.

spell.name: Doomtide
entries: Illusory black mist, writhing with the shapes of countless grasping tentacles, fills a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} 80 feet long and 10 feet wide that extends from you in a direction you choose and lasts for the duration. The area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. When you cast the spell, choose whether the mist stays where it is or drifts 10 feet farther away from you, in the direction of the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, at the end of each of your turns.

When the mist appears, each creature in it makes a Wisdom saving throw. A creature also makes this save when it enters the mist for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
A strong wind (such as the one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses the mist, ending the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Downdraft

components.m: a balsa-wood bird carving, which you crush underfoot

entries: A column of turbulent air slams down in a 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d6} Bludgeoning damage, and if it is standing on the ground, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

A flying creature in the area is also driven straight down, 100 feet on a failed save or 50 feet on a successful one. If this drives it into the ground or another solid surface, it takes {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it moved this way and lands {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Draconic Might
entries: You touch a willing creature, and a fine pattern of golden scales briefly covers its face. Until the spell ends, the target gains the following benefits:

items: It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength, Constitution, and Charisma checks and saving throws.
It gains a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.
It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition, and magic can't put it to sleep.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Dragon Breath

components.m: a scale from a true dragon of the chosen kind

entries: You take on the breath of a true dragon. When you cast the spell, choose one kind of true dragon from the Dragon Breath table. Until the spell ends, you can exhale that dragon's breath: you do so immediately as part of casting the spell, and you can do so again as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. After each exhalation, roll {@dice 1d4}; you can't exhale again until that many of your turns have passed.

Each creature in the breath's area makes a saving throw of the listed type. A damaging breath deals {@damage 6d6} damage of the listed type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The Brass, Copper, and Silver breaths deal no damage and instead impose the listed effect on a failed save.

entries.caption: Dragon Breath
rows: Sleep; 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}; Constitution. Instead of taking damage, a creature that fails its save has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn, or until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it awake. Creatures that don't sleep automatically succeed.

Slowing; 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}; Constitution. Instead of taking damage, a creature that fails its save has its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} halved, can't take Reactions, and can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both, until the end of your next turn.

Paralyzing; 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}; Constitution. Instead of taking damage, a creature that fails its save has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of a damaging breath increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Dragonsight
entries: Your eyes enlarge and turn yellow and catlike, like those of a dragon. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet instead, if that would be greater.
You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight, and you can see fine detail at a distance as clearly as if it were twice as close to you.

spell.name: Dragonskin
entries: Your flesh erupts with hard, colorful scales like those of a chromatic dragon. Choose a color: black (Acid), blue (Lightning), green (Poison), red (Fire), or white (Cold). Until the spell ends, you have an {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} of 17 if your AC is lower than that, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the damage type associated with the chosen color.

spell.name: Dream Casting
entries: You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence and enter a trance to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and have a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0. If the target is asleep, you appear in its dreams and can converse with it and shape the dream's environment, as with the {@spell Dream|XPHB} spell, for up to 8 hours. If the target is awake, you know it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for it to sleep. You can emerge from the trance at any time.

Before you leave the dream, you can weave a lasting influence into it. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the dream carries only your message. On a failed save, choose one of the following effects, which lasts for the spell's duration once the target wakes. The effect ends early if the target is targeted by {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, or {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}.

entries.name: Charm
entries: The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition and is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you. This effect ends if you or your allies damage the target.

entries.name: Fear
entries: Whenever the target can see you, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Harrow
entries: The target behaves strangely, gaining two odd quirks of the DM's choice. In addition, the first time the target sees you, it is affected as though by the {@spell Confusion|XPHB} spell for 1 minute (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required), repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

entries.name: Rage
entries: Whenever the target can see you, it is consumed with hatred for you. In combat, it attacks you in preference to other targets, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures other than you. It gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against you and to saving throws against your spells and other effects.

spell.name: Dream Sight
entries: You fall into a deep sleep, and your spirit leaves your body to roam the world. Until the spell ends, your body has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, and you perceive the world through your spirit instead, which appears in your space.

Your spirit is {@condition Invisible|XPHB}, has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 100 feet and can hover, and has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet. It can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and it can travel any distance from your body on the same plane of existence. It sees and hears as you would if you were there, but it can't speak, attack, cast spells, manipulate objects, or take any action other than moving. Magic that blocks incorporeal creatures or Ethereal travel, such as a {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, also blocks it.

Your spirit has an {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} of 10. If it takes any damage, or if your body takes damage or is moved, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your spirit instantly returns to your body and you wake up.

spell.name: Drown
entries: You fill the lungs of one creature you can see within range with water. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it begins to drown.

An affected target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and can't speak or breathe. It makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If it succeeds on three of these saves, it coughs up the water and the effect ends on it. If it fails three of them, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} drop to 0 and it has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.
Another creature within 5 feet of an affected target can take an action to make a DC 15 Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check, ending the effect on the target on a success.
Constructs, Undead, and creatures that don't need to breathe or that can breathe water automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 9 spell slot, you can target up to ten creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Each target makes its own saving throws.

spell.name: Duelward
entries: Your link to the Weave sharpens, readying you for a magical duel. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you see a creature casting a spell, you know which spell it is casting, if it is a spell you could identify with the {@action Study|XPHB} action.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells.

Once on each of your turns and once on each other creature's turn, you can cast {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} without using your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} (you still expend the spell slot). The target of your {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its saving throw against it.

entries: The first time a creature fails its saving throw against a {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} you cast while this spell is active, Duelward ends.

spell.name: Earth Lock

m.text: a diamond chip worth 50+ GP embedded in a piece of charcoal, which the spell consumes

entries: Choose a point within range inside a tunnel or passage no more than 10 feet wide and 10 feet high whose walls, floor, and ceiling are natural earth or unworked stone. By the start of your next turn, the tunnel constricts at that point, sealing it with a plug of earth and stone 1 foot thick. Each Large or smaller creature or object in the way is pushed harmlessly to the nearest unoccupied space on one side of the plug (a creature chooses the side; an object's side is random). If a Huge or larger creature or object is in the way, the spell has no effect until it moves.

You and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open and close the plug. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while within 30 feet of the plug, you or a designated creature can make it open or close, which happens by the start of that creature's next turn.
Other creatures can bypass the plug in the following ways:

items: {@b Squeeze Through.} A Medium or smaller creature adjacent to the plug can take an action to make a Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. On a success, it squeezes through to the other side, and the plug remains intact.

{@b Break It.} A creature adjacent to the plug can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC + 5. On a success, the plug crumbles and the spell ends. Burrowing through the plug or digging it out also ends the spell.
{@b Magic.} {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can end the spell, and {@spell Knock|XPHB} suppresses it for 10 minutes, during which time the tunnel is open.

entries: A creature that examines the plug can tell that the tunnel continues beyond it with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC; otherwise, the tunnel appears to simply end.

spell.name: Earth Reaver
entries: You point at a spot on the ground within range, and the earth there erupts in a shower of rock, dirt, and fire. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d6} Bludgeoning damage and {@damage 4d6} Fire damage and, if it is standing on the ground, has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Bludgeoning damage and the Fire damage increase by {@scaledamage 4d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Earthen Grace
entries: You touch a willing creature, giving it an affinity for earth and stone; its skin briefly takes on the speckled gray look of granite. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to damage from earthen sources, including the following:

items: Attacks made with weapons or ammunition of stone or earth, such as a stone club or sling bullet, and thrown rocks and boulders.
Attacks made by creatures composed of earth or stone, such as an {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}, a {@creature Gargoyle|XMM}, or a {@creature Stone Golem|XMM}.
Falling onto stone or earth, and rockfalls, cave-ins, and avalanches.
Spells and other magical effects that hurl, raise, or shape earth or stone, such as {@spell Earthquake|XPHB}.

entries: The DM decides whether a given source of damage is earthen.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Earthen Grasp

components.m: a miniature hand sculpted from clay

entries: A Medium arm of packed earth bursts from a patch of earth, mud, sand, or soil you can see within range, filling a 5-foot-square space. The spell fails if the ground there is worked stone or another material that isn't loose earth. The arm can't move from its space. It has AC 15, 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, it crumbles and the spell ends.

At the end of each of your turns, the arm grabs at one creature you choose within 5 feet of it. If you can't see the arm's surroundings, it instead grabs at a random creature within 5 feet of it, possibly an ally. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). A creature that the arm already has Grappled when it grabs takes {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage instead, as the hand crushes it. The arm can have only one creature Grappled at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The arm's Hit Points increase by 5, and the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6}, for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Earthfast
entries: Gray bands of force wrap around a stone structure or natural rock formation you can see within range, then sink into it. You reinforce a portion of it no larger than a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, such as a section of wall, a pillar, or a boulder. The reinforced stone's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} double, its {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} increases by 2, and it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage except Force damage. These benefits are permanent.
The spell has no effect on a creature, including a construct, or on stone that is already reinforced by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can reinforce one additional 10-foot Cube of stone for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Easy Climb
entries: You point at a cliff face, tree trunk, wall, or other vertical surface within range, and handholds and footholds press into it, forming a path 10 feet wide and up to 120 feet tall. For the duration, any creature climbing within the path doesn't need to make ability checks to climb, and climbing there doesn't cost it extra movement. When the spell ends, the surface returns to its original shape, and creatures still on it must find their own purchase.

spell.name: Easy Trail
entries: Plants near you bend aside to let you pass. For the duration, undergrowth within a 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you is held aside. Creatures in the Emanation ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} created by nonmagical plants and undergrowth, and such terrain doesn't slow your group's travel pace. Plants return to their normal shape once the Emanation passes.
Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to track a creature that traveled within the Emanation have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
The spell has no effect on Plant creatures or on plants created or controlled by magic.

spell.name: Ebon Eyes

components.m: a pinch of powdered black gemstone

entries: A jet-black film covers the eyes of a willing creature you touch. For the duration, the target can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, both magical and nonmagical, within 60 feet of itself.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Echo Skull
entries: You touch the dried animal skull used as this spell's Material component, and it glows green for a moment. For the duration, as long as you and the skull are on the same plane of existence, you can see, hear, and speak through it at any distance.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can shift your senses to the skull or back to your own body. While your senses are in the skull, you see and hear as if you were in its space, using your own senses, and you can speak through it, but you have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions with regard to your own surroundings.
The skull is a Tiny object with AC 10 and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. If it is destroyed, the spell ends.

spell.name: Ectoplasmic Armor
entries: Shimmering, translucent ectoplasm coats a willing creature you touch, fitting its form like a suit of plate. For the duration, the target has a +5 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} against attack rolls made by incorporeal creatures, such as those that have the Incorporeal Movement trait (for example, a {@creature Ghost|XMM}, {@creature Specter|XMM}, or {@creature Wraith|XMM}).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Ectoplasmic Feedback
entries: A shimmering sheath of ectoplasmic energy surrounds you for the duration. Whenever an incorporeal creature, such as one that has the Incorporeal Movement trait, hits you with a melee attack or enters your space, it takes {@damage 2d10} Force damage. A creature takes this damage no more than once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|2-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Effulgent Epuration
entries: Nine silvery spheres, each about the size of a head, appear and orbit you or another willing creature you choose within range (the warded creature). For the duration, whenever the warded creature is targeted by a spell, or by a {@action Magic|XPHB} action that duplicates a spell, the warded creature can choose to have one sphere absorb it (no action required). The spell or effect then has no effect on the warded creature, although it affects any other targets normally. The sphere then fades away. The warded creature can let spells it wants, such as healing, affect it normally. Spells that create an area of effect without targeting the creature can't be absorbed.
As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can move all the remaining spheres, and the ward, to a different willing creature within range.
The spell ends early when the last sphere fades.

spell.name: Electric Jolt
entries: A white-hot spark leaps from your fingertip toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Lightning damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@damage 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d8}), 11 ({@damage 3d8}), and 17 ({@damage 4d8}).

spell.name: Electric Loop

components.m: a loop of copper wire and a magnet

entries: Lightning leaps among your foes. Choose up to four creatures you can see within range, each of which must be within 5 feet of at least one other creature you choose. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Each creature that fails this save must then succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Elemental Body

components.m: a bit of the chosen element taken from a plane other than the one you're on

entries: You transform your body into elemental substance. Choose air, earth, fire, or water. You and your possessions appear to be made of that element, though you keep your general shape and size. Your creature type doesn't change. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: You are unaffected by the natural environmental hazards of the Elemental Plane that matches your element, and you can breathe normally there.
You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and to the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you becomes a normal hit.
You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries: You also gain benefits based on your element:

entries.name: Air
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and can hover, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning and Thunder damage. Attack rolls made against you by creatures that are flying have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Earth
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}. Once on each of your turns when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack while you are both on the ground, you can push it up to 10 feet straight away from you.

entries.name: Fire
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, or a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, that creature takes {@damage 1d10} Fire damage. Flammable objects you touch that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

entries.name: Water
entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, you can breathe water, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid damage. You can extinguish a nonmagical flame you touch (no action required), and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch a magical fire to end a spell of level 6 or lower that created it.

spell.name: Embrace the Wild
entries: You picture an animal and cry out in imitation of its call, and your senses sharpen to match it. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing or smell. You also gain one of the following senses of your choice:

items: {@b Night Eyes.} You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.
{@b Echo Sense.} You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet.

spell.name: Emerald Flame Fist
entries: One of your hands bursts into brilliant emerald flame, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. When you cast the spell, and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on your later turns until a creature is engulfed, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 7d8} Fire damage and is engulfed in green flame.

At the start of each of its turns, an engulfed creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 7d8} Fire damage and remains engulfed. On a successful save, the flames die out and the spell ends. An engulfed creature can also take an action to try to smother the flames, making a Dexterity saving throw; on a success, the spell ends.
If you touch a nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried instead, it is automatically engulfed and takes {@damage 7d8} Fire damage at the start of each of your turns until the spell ends.
The spell ends early if you cast it again.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: All the damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d8|7-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Energy Ebb
entries: A black needle of crackling negative energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d10} Necrotic damage, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken. Its life force then continues to bleed away: at the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, it takes {@damage 4d10} Necrotic damage, its Hit Point maximum is reduced by the same amount, and it makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on a success.

The spell also ends if the target receives {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or similar magic, or if a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to make a successful Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC. The Hit Point maximum reduction lasts until the target finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. A creature dies if this spell reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0.
Constructs are unaffected. If you hit an Undead, it instead gains {@dice 4d10} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} that last for 1 hour, and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: All the damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Energy Immunity
entries: You touch a willing creature and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. For the duration, the target and the equipment it wears or carries have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to damage of the chosen type.

The spell prevents only damage. The target can still suffer other effects tied to that energy, such as drowning in a pool of acid, gaining the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition from a thunderous blast, or being trapped in ice.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Energy Spheres
entries: Five colored spheres appear and orbit your head for the duration: one each of Acid (pale green), Cold (white), Lightning (blue), Fire (red), and Thunder (violet). Together they shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet.

entries.name: Hurl Spheres
entries: When you cast the spell, and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on your later turns, you can hurl any number of the remaining spheres at creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Each sphere targets one creature, and a creature can be targeted by more than one sphere. A target makes a Dexterity saving throw against each sphere that targets it, taking {@damage 2d6} damage of the sphere's type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Each hurled sphere then vanishes.

entries.name: Absorb Energy
entries: When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage while the sphere of that type remains, you can have the sphere absorb the energy (no action required). You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage, and the sphere vanishes.
The spell ends early when the last sphere vanishes.
