entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You create one additional sphere of a type you choose for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Energy Transformation Field

m.text: three drops of your blood, an eye from a Humanoid, and powdered diamond worth 5,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a lingering zone of transformative magic in a 40-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. As part of casting this spell, you also cast a spell of level 6 or lower that has a casting time of 1 action and no Material component that has a cost (the linked spell), expending its spell slot as normal. The linked spell has no immediate effect. You also choose a point within the field where the linked spell will take effect.

entries.name: Absorbing Magic
entries: Whenever a creature in the field casts a spell, including a spell cast from a magic item, or takes a {@action Magic|XPHB} action that duplicates a spell, the spell or action is absorbed: it has no effect, and any spell slot, charge, or use is still expended. The field then stores a number of spell levels equal to the absorbed spell's level (cantrips store none). Magic created outside the field, and ongoing magical effects that enter it, aren't absorbed, though they visibly dim while in the field. Stored levels fade at a rate of one per day.

entries.name: Casting the Linked Spell
entries: When the field has stored spell levels equal to or greater than the linked spell's level, it expends that many levels and casts the linked spell at the point you chose, using your spell save DC, spell attack modifier, and spellcasting ability. If the linked spell targets creatures, it targets the creature nearest to that point. If it requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, it lasts for its full duration. The field won't cast the linked spell again while a previous casting of it is still in effect.

entries.name: Ending the Field
entries: The field lasts until it is dispelled. {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} cast within the field is absorbed, but it can end the field if cast from outside it. An {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB} prevents the field from absorbing magic within the antimagic area. If two such fields overlap, each has an equal chance to absorb a spell cast in the overlapping area.

spell.name: Energy Vortex
entries: Energy wells up inside you and explodes outward. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning. Each creature other than you in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

You can choose to unleash the vortex without holding any of it back. If you do, the damage increases to {@damage 12d6}, and you take the same damage. You don't make a saving throw against this damage (other creatures still save as normal), but your Resistances and Immunities apply.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3 (by 2d6 if you unleash the vortex without holding back).

spell.name: Enervating Breath
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB}, to cast this spell. The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it is laced with spikes of living darkness. In addition to the breath's normal effects, each creature that fails its saving throw against it takes an extra {@damage 10d8} Necrotic damage and gains {@dice 1d4} {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels. Exhaustion levels gained from this spell are removed when the creature finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, rather than one level at a time.

An Undead in the breath's area instead gains {@dice 2d4 × 5} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, which last for 1 hour, before it takes any damage from the breath. It takes neither the extra Necrotic damage nor the Exhaustion.

spell.name: Enhance Familiar
entries: You touch your familiar (such as one summoned by {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}) and infuse it with vigor, turning it into a capable combatant. For the duration, it gains the following benefits:

items: Its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and current Hit Points increase by 15.
It gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.
It gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
It can take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, even if it normally can't attack (as with a familiar from {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Hit Point increase grows by 5 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Enhance Wild Shape
entries: You fill yourself with the raw power of nature, magnifying your Wild Shape. When you cast the spell, choose one of the options below. The next time you use Wild Shape during the spell's duration, your new form gains that benefit. The benefit lasts until you leave that form or the spell ends, and it doesn't apply to any later form. If you don't use Wild Shape before the spell ends, the spell has no effect.

items.name: Verdant Form.
entries: You can assume the form of a Plant instead of a Beast, using any Plant stat block whose {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} doesn't exceed the maximum allowed by your Wild Shape, such as an {@creature Awakened Shrub|XMM} or, at higher levels, an {@creature Awakened Tree|XMM}.

items.name: Untried Form.
entries: You can assume any Beast form that is eligible for your Wild Shape, even one that isn't among your known forms.

items.name: Mighty Form.
entries: The form has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and its attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the attack's type on a hit.

items.name: Nimble Form.
entries: The form gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Hardy Form.
entries: The form has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws, and when you assume it, you gain 15 more {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} than Wild Shape normally grants.
You can be affected by more than one casting of this spell at a time, but each must have a different option.

spell.name: Enrage Animal
entries: You fill a Beast you can see within range with primal fury. For the duration, it gains the following benefits and drawback:

items: It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength and Wisdom saving throws.
It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Its attacks that use Strength deal an extra 2 damage on a hit.
It takes a −2 penalty to Armor Class.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Entangling Staff
entries: You touch a Quarterstaff, which sprouts wriggling vines for the duration. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack using the staff, you can make the vines lash out at it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage, and you choose one of the following effects. A creature more than one size larger than you automatically succeeds.

items.name: Constrict.
entries: The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC), with the vines binding it to the staff. While it is Grappled this way, it takes {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns, and you can't attack another creature with the staff. You can release the target at any time (no action required).

items.name: Entangle.
entries: Some vines tear free and cling to the target, which has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. The Restrained target can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.

spell.name: Entice Gift
entries: You hold out your hand and demand an object that a creature you can see within range is holding. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

On its next turn, the Charmed target must move toward you by the most direct route and, if it can reach a space within 5 feet of you, use its action to hand you the object; you can take it without using an action if you have a free hand. If it can't reach you, it instead uses its action to toss the object so that it lands in your space. The target defends itself normally and can act as it wishes afterward, including trying to get the object back.
If the target can't do as the spell compels (for example, because it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition), the spell has no effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Enveloping Cocoon
entries: You crush the caterpillar and wrap a Large or smaller creature you can see within range in a cocoon of shimmering force. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be enclosed for the duration.

An enclosed creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, can't cast spells that have a Somatic component, and can't target anything except the cocoon with attacks or other effects. It can attack the cocoon only with {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}, natural weapons, or weapons that have the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property. The creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects originating outside the cocoon, which take the cocoon as their target instead.

The cocoon has AC 18, 60 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed and the spell ends. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell destroys it instantly.

entries.name: Attached Spell
entries: While the cocoon lasts, you can cast a spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB} and that targets only one creature, aiming it at the cocoon. The spell is held in the cocoon instead of taking effect. When this spell ends because its duration expires or because you end your Concentration on it, the held spell takes effect on the enclosed creature: it automatically fails any saving throw against that spell, and any attack roll the spell requires automatically hits. If the cocoon is destroyed first, the held spell is wasted. The cocoon can hold only one spell at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The cocoon's Hit Points increase by 15 for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Eradicate Earth

m.text: a small stone, which the spell consumes

entries: You grip the stone and it vanishes as a silent shock wave ripples out from you in a 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each Elemental and each Construct in that area that is composed of earth, stone, or crystal (such as an {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}, a {@creature Gargoyle|XMM}, or a {@creature Stone Golem|XMM}) makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 8d8} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Other creatures are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Essence of the Raptor
entries: You infuse yourself with the essence of a prehistoric raptor. Your appearance doesn't change, but for the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 60 feet unless it is higher, and your jump distance is tripled.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}), Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}), Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}), and Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks.

You can sense the presence and location of any creature within 30 feet of you by scent, even if it is {@condition Invisible|XPHB} or you can't see it, unless it has no scent (as with most Constructs, Oozes, and Undead) or its scent is masked by magic or a strong odor.

spell.name: Ethereal Breath
entries: You must have a Breath Weapon, such as that of a {@race Dragonborn|XPHB}, or be under the effect of {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB}, to cast this spell. You must be on the Material Plane or on another plane that has a coexistent Ethereal Plane. The next time you exhale that breath before the end of your turn, it manifests on the Ethereal Plane instead of your current plane.

The breath affects creatures and objects on the Ethereal Plane within its area as if they were on your plane, and it has no effect on anything on your plane. A creature that is on the Ethereal Plane can be affected by the breath even if it isn't visible to you.

spell.name: Ethereal Chamber
entries: A translucent prison of crystalline force springs into being around a creature on the Ethereal Plane that you can see within range (for example, with {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} or {@sense Truesight|XPHB}). The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be imprisoned for the duration.

An imprisoned creature has a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0 and can't leave the Ethereal Plane by any means, including to the Material Plane. It can't make attack rolls, and it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects originating outside the chamber, except Thunder damage and effects that rely only on sight (such as a gaze). It has a +2 bonus to saving throws against such effects.

The imprisoned creature can take an action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, shattering the chamber and ending the spell on a success. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell also destroys the chamber.

spell.name: Ethereal Mount
entries: You draw ether into form, creating up to four Large, quasi-real, horselike creatures in unoccupied spaces of your choice within range. Each has a foggy, almost translucent body whose colors slowly shift across the spectrum, and each is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle that vanish if carried more than 10 feet away from it.

For the duration, you or creatures you choose can ride the mounts; no one else can. Each mount uses the {@creature Riding Horse|XMM} stat block, with these changes: its AC is 18, it has 20 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it can't attack, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 100 feet. On the Ethereal Plane, its Speed is 240 feet, it can carry its rider in any direction, and it can travel 30 miles in an hour (twice as far in the Deep Ethereal, if your cosmology has one). A mount carries its rider and up to 100 pounds of other gear.
A mount melts into mist when it drops to 0 Hit Points. When the spell ends, the mounts gradually fade, giving their riders 1 minute to dismount. The mounts don't carry their riders between planes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You create one additional mount for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Evil Glare
entries: Your eyes brim with dark energy. When you cast the spell, choose one creature within range that you can see and that can see you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} conditions for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on this save.

On each of your later turns until the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to glare at another creature in the same way. You can't target a creature more than once with the same casting of this spell, whatever the result of its save.

spell.name: Exacting Shot
entries: You touch a ranged weapon and see in your mind's eye the vital areas of your chosen prey. When you cast the spell, choose a creature type, such as Fiend or Undead. For the duration, attack rolls with the weapon against creatures of that type, and against any creature marked by your {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20, and they ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and Three-Quarters Cover.
If the weapon or its ammunition has a magical property that affects Critical Hits, this spell has no effect on attacks with it.

spell.name: Excavate
entries: You toss a pinch of earth at a wooden, plaster, earthen, or stone surface (such as a wall, ceiling, or floor) that you can see within range, and the material vaporizes, boring a permanent passage into it. You choose the passage's dimensions: up to 10 feet wide, 10 feet tall, and 100 feet deep, in a straight line. The passage's walls are smooth and stable, and the passage creates no instability in a structure surrounding it. If the surface is thinner than the depth you chose, the passage breaks through to the other side.

The spell can't bore through metal or any harder material, and it stops when it reaches such material. It doesn't affect creatures, objects being worn or carried, or magic items. Because the effect is instantaneous, the passage can't be dispelled.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 9 spell slot, the passage can be up to 300 feet deep.

spell.name: Explosive Cascade

components.m: bat guano, sulfur, and copper packed into a metal tube

entries: A bright ball of flame bursts from the tube and skips along a path you choose. The path consists of up to ten 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cubes}, each within range and each sharing a face with the previous one. Each creature in the path makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature is affected only once, even if it occupies more than one Cube.

Flammable objects in the path that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB}. If the damage destroys an object in the path, such as a door, the path can continue through its space. Dying sparks shed {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} along the path until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|4-9|1d6} and the path can include two more Cubes for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Extract Water Elemental
entries: You surround a creature you can see within range with a swirling aura that draws the moisture out of its body through its eyes, mouth, and pores. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 12d8} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Constructs, Undead, and creatures that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage are unaffected.

If this damage reduces a Small or larger target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies, and the extracted water forms a {@creature Water Elemental|XMM} in its space or the nearest unoccupied space. The elemental is an ally to you and your allies, and it lasts for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 Hit Points. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 12d8|6-9|2d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Eye of Power
entries: You create a floating eye of faintly glowing blue energy in an unoccupied space within range. The eye is visible and lasts for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from it, and it can see in every direction. It also has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the eye up to 60 feet in any direction. It can travel any distance from you, but it can't leave your plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks its movement, but it can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.

entries.name: Casting Through the Eye
entries: When you cast a spell of level 5 or lower that has a range other than self, you can cast it as though you were in the eye's space. Range, line of sight, and areas are measured from the eye, and you perceive targets through the eye's senses. If you try to cast a spell of level 6 or higher through the eye, the spell fails and is wasted, and the eye is destroyed.

entries.name: Destroying the Eye
entries: The eye is a Tiny object with AC 18, 77 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. It uses your saving throw modifiers. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed and the spell ends.

spell.name: Eye of the Hurricane
entries: Hurricane-force winds spin around you in a 40-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration, leaving a calm eye within 10 feet of you. The storm moves with you, and you and anything within the eye are unaffected by it.

Ranged attack rolls that pass through the storm automatically miss, unless the projectile is Large or bigger (such as a boulder hurled by a giant or a siege engine's missile), in which case the attack roll has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

Whenever the storm moves into a creature's space, and whenever a creature enters the storm or starts its turn there, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage and suffer an effect based on its size, as shown below. A creature makes this save only once per turn. Gargantuan creatures are unaffected by the storm.

items.name: Medium or Smaller.
entries: The creature is pushed 20 feet straight away from you and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If it is flying, it is instead pushed 40 feet.

items.name: Large.
entries: The creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If it is flying, it is instead pushed 20 feet straight away from you.

items.name: Huge.
entries: The creature can't move closer to you until the start of its next turn. If it is flying, it is instead pushed 10 feet straight away from you.

spell.name: Eyes of the King
entries: You summon four fiendish bats that glow with a faint, ghoul-green light, shedding {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius. They appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range. Each uses the {@creature Giant Bat|XMM} stat block, with these changes: it is a Fiend, it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid and Fire damage, and its attacks count as magical.

For the duration, you can see through the eyes of all the bats at once, and you benefit from their {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} as well as from any special senses or magic that enhances your own sight, such as {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} or {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB}. The bats can travel any distance from you, but they must stay within 40 feet of one another.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can mentally direct the bats where to fly and explore. They fly at full speed if they scout ahead normally, or at half speed if they carefully examine the ceilings and walls. In combat, the bats share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, taking their turns immediately after yours. If you don't direct them, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger.

entries.name: Loss of Control
entries: If your {@status Concentration|XPHB} ends before the duration does, the bats don't vanish right away. For the next minute, they are hostile to all creatures, you no longer see through their eyes, and on each of their turns they move toward and attack the nearest creature they can perceive. They then disappear. Each bat also disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

spell.name: Faith Healing
entries: You lay your hands on a creature that shares your faith, channeling your god's favor into it. The target regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 3d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

The target must worship the same deity or pantheon as you, or follow the same creed or philosophy (the DM decides whether a creature qualifies). The spell has no effect on any other creature, and the spell slot isn't expended if you touch a creature that doesn't qualify.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 3d8|1-9|3d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: False Gravity
entries: You touch a willing creature and give it its own personal gravity for the duration. The target can treat any solid surface as though it were a level floor, walking or running up walls and across ceilings with its hands free and at its normal {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. Once on each of its turns (no action required), the target can choose which solid surface it treats as "down." Unattended objects it lets go of fall normally.

While it isn't standing on a surface, the target can let itself "fall" toward any solid surface it can see, which gives it a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet and lets it hover. When it moves this way, it can change direction only once on each of its turns. The target takes no damage from falling and doesn't have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition when it lands.
When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft or upside down, unless it can stop the fall.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Familiar Pocket

components.m: a tiny golden needle and a strip of fine cloth given a half twist and fastened at the ends

entries: You touch a pocket, pouch, or other container worn or carried by you and turn it into a snug extradimensional haven for your familiar (such as one summoned by {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}). The space holds one Tiny or smaller creature and adds no bulk or weight to the container. When you cast the spell, you choose a command word.

While your familiar is within 5 feet of you, you can speak the command word on your turn (no action required) to whisk it into the pocket. The familiar can also enter the pocket on its own turn by spending 5 feet of movement while within 5 feet of you. It can leave the pocket by spending 5 feet of movement, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, and you can call it forth the same way you sent it in.

While inside the pocket, the familiar has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}, can't be targeted by attacks or effects from outside the pocket, and can't make attacks or cast spells. It still breathes normally, and either of you can seal the pocket (no action required), making it airtight and watertight; a sealed pocket holds enough air for 1 hour. Your telepathic connection with the familiar works normally, but you can't see or hear through its senses while it is inside.

The spell ends early if the container is placed inside another extradimensional space, such as a {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG}. When the spell ends, a familiar inside the pocket appears unharmed in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you.

spell.name: Fangs of the Vampire King
entries: You sprout long, needle-sharp fangs for the duration. When you make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your bite, it deals {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage plus {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.
When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one bite attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

Whenever you deal Necrotic damage with your bite to a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, the creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} maximum decreases by an amount equal to that Necrotic damage. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. A creature dies if this effect reduces its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} maximum to 0.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Necrotic damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Fantastic Machine
entries: You create a noisy, many-armed Large machine of gears, pistons, and iron plates in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It uses the Fantastic Machine stat block below. When you cast the spell, you give the machine a single task of no more than twenty-five words, such as "dig a trench along this line," "carry these crates to the ship," or "attack any creature that comes through that gate." You can't change the task once it is given.

The machine is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours, starting on the turn you cast the spell. On each of its turns, it does whatever best accomplishes its task; if the task is complete or impossible, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and uses its movement to avoid danger. The machine disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

data.name: Fantastic Machine
languages: understands the languages you know but can't speak

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The machine can use its Fly and Swim Speeds only while it carries no more than 200 pounds.

trait.name: Labor Engine
entries: The machine can lift up to 1,000 pounds to a height of 15 feet and push or drag up to 2,500 pounds. Each minute, it can excavate a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} of loose rock, or two such Cubes of sand or soil.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The machine deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The machine makes two attacks, using Slam or Hurl Rock in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. The machine needs a loose rock or similar object weighing no more than 50 pounds within its reach.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 9 spell slot, you create a towering machine of adamantine gears and pistons that uses the Greater Fantastic Machine stat block below instead. Rather than a single task, it obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you), or you can give it a standing program of simple physical labor, which it carries out until it finishes or you give it a new command.

data.name: Greater Fantastic Machine
languages: understands the languages you know but can't speak

trait.name: Adamantine Body
entries: Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against the machine becomes a normal hit.

trait.name: Clumsy Flier
entries: The machine can use its Fly and Swim Speeds only while it carries no more than 400 pounds.

trait.name: Labor Engine
entries: The machine can lift up to 2,000 pounds to a height of 15 feet and push or drag up to 5,000 pounds. Each round, it can excavate a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} of loose rock, or two such Cubes of sand or soil.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The machine deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The machine makes three attacks, using Slam or Hurl Rock in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 10 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d8 + 11}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Hurl Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 3d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. The machine needs a loose rock or similar object weighing no more than 100 pounds within its reach.

spell.name: Favor of the Martyr
entries: You call on the saints of your order to steel one willing creature you can see within range against pain and collapse. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions. If the target has any of those conditions when you cast the spell, the condition is suspended for the duration rather than ended, and any {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels it has don't affect it. When the spell ends, a suspended condition returns unless its duration ran out in the meantime.

In addition, if the target has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it doesn't have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition from being at 0 Hit Points. It still makes {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} and takes failures from damage as normal, but it can move, and on each of its turns it can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, not both. If the spell ends while the target has 0 Hit Points, it gains the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition as normal.

spell.name: Favorable Sacrifice

m.text: gems worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You burn precious gems as an offering, and your deity's protection settles over a creature you touch. The protection the target gains for the duration depends on the value of the gems consumed:

items.name: 250+ GP.
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

items.name: 1,000+ GP.
entries: As the 250 GP offering, and whenever the target takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, that damage is reduced by 5.

items.name: 10,000+ GP.
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, and Thunder damage.

spell.name: Fearsome Grapple
entries: Two thick, otyugh-like tentacles sprout from beneath your arms for the duration. The tentacles can't attack, hold, or manipulate objects; they can only grapple. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to grapple with a tentacle, which doesn't require a free hand and has a reach of 10 feet. Each tentacle can grapple one creature.
When you grapple with a tentacle, you can use your spell save DC instead of the normal DC.
A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by your tentacles has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks to escape the grapple.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws to avoid or escape the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

entries: When the spell ends, the tentacles wither away, and any creature they are grappling is released.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you use a level 4+ spell slot, you grow four tentacles instead of two.

spell.name: Fell the Greatest Foe

components.m: a dragon's claw or a giant's fingernail

entries: You touch a willing creature, and its muscles ripple with yellow energy. For the duration, whenever the target hits a creature larger than itself with a melee attack, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the attack's type for each size category by which the creature is larger than the target. For example, a Medium target deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage to a Large creature, {@damage 2d6} to a Huge creature, and {@damage 3d6} to a Gargantuan one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Field of Ghouls
entries: A ravenous hunger radiates from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration, tearing life from the living. When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Whenever the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} enters the space of any other creature and whenever such a creature enters the Emanation or starts its turn there, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

A Humanoid reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this damage dies, and at the start of your next turn its corpse rises as a {@creature Ghoul|XMM} under your control. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns, you can mentally command any of these ghouls within 120 feet of you, issuing the same command to each one; if you issue no commands, they defend themselves against hostile creatures and otherwise take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action. The ghouls remain under your control for 24 hours, after which they stop obeying you. They don't disappear when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|7-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Field of Icy Razors

m.text: a silver shuriken shaped like a snowflake worth 50+ GP

entries: Needle-sharp crystals of ice erupt around any number of creatures of your choice that you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 60 feet apart. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 5d8} Cold damage and {@damage 4d8} Slashing damage, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 20 feet for 1 minute. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Cold damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|8-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 8.

spell.name: Fiendform

components.m: a bone from a Fiend, which the spell consumes

entries: Dark whispers guide your transformation as you take on the form of a Fiend, sprouting horns, claws, a barbed tail, and leathery wings. When you cast the spell, choose Demon or Devil. For the duration, you retain your game statistics, can speak and cast spells, and your gear transforms with you. You also gain the following benefits:

items.name: Fiendish Nature.
entries: Your creature type is Fiend. You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

items.name: Fiendish Vigor.
entries: You gain 30 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, which vanish when the spell ends.

items.name: Wings.
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet.

items.name: Rending Claws.
entries: When you use your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} to deal damage with your claws, it deals {@damage 1d10} Slashing damage instead of the normal damage, and you can use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional claw attack as part of that action.

items.name: Demon.
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage, and your claws deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Poison damage on a hit.

items.name: Devil.
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage, magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} doesn't impede your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, and your claws deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage on a hit.

While transformed, you are affected by spells and effects that specifically target or ward against Fiends, such as {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB}. If an effect would banish you or send you to a Fiend's home plane, such as {@spell Banishment|XPHB} or {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB}, the effect instead ends this spell, and you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Fierce Pride of the Beastlands
entries: Green-white fog rolls across the ground, and a pride of golden-pelted celestial lions with silver eyes emerges from it. When you finish casting the spell, {@dice 2d4} {@creature Lion|XMM|Lions} appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range. Ten minutes later, {@dice 1d4} dire lions appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the point where the first creatures appeared; each uses the {@creature Saber-Toothed Tiger|XMM} stat block but looks like a massive lion.

Each creature summoned by this spell is a Celestial instead of a Beast, has the maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for its stat block, and has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage. A lion's Rend deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage on a hit, and a dire lion's Rend deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage on a hit.

The creatures are allies to you and your allies, and no other effect can take control of them while the spell lasts. In combat, they share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but they take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger. The creatures can't willingly move more than 200 feet from the point where the first wave appeared.
As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can dismiss any number of the creatures you can see. Each creature disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Final Rebuke

components.m: a stick at least 1 foot long

entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 10d10} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and if this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

spell.name: Find Temple
entries: You open your mind to your god's guidance. For the duration, you sense the direction to the nearest temple, shrine, or other consecrated place of worship dedicated to your deity within 10 miles of you. If there is none, you instead sense the direction to the nearest such place dedicated to a deity of the same pantheon as yours or one that shares your deity's ideals.
Alternatively, you can name a specific temple you have visited in person (seeing it through magic doesn't count). If it lies within 10 miles of you, you sense the direction to it.
If you are moving, the direction updates as you move. The spell doesn't reveal the distance to the temple or what you might find there.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The range increases by 10 miles for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Find the Gap
entries: A blue mark that only you can see appears on your foes, highlighting the weak spots in their defenses. For the duration, the first attack roll you make on each of your turns ignores the target's armor, shield, and natural armor. Against that attack, the target's AC equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier, plus any bonuses to AC from spells, magic items other than armor and shields, and features that don't rely on armor (such as the Barbarian's or Monk's Unarmored Defense). If the target's normal AC is lower, use that instead.

spell.name: Fins to Feet
entries: You touch a willing creature, and its tail, tentacles, or finned extremities transform into a pair of legs and feet suited to its body. For the duration, the target loses any {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} it has and gains a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 30 feet (20 feet if it is Small or smaller, or 40 feet if it is Large or larger), replacing its normal Speed if that is lower. The target can't make any attacks that rely on its tail, tentacles, or fins, but it can breathe as normal.
If the target lacks a tail, tentacles, or finned extremities, the spell has no effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Fire Shuriken

components.m: a shuriken coated with pine sap and sulfur

entries: You create three shuriken of magical fire in your hand. Each one is a Simple Ranged weapon with the {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} property (range 20/60 feet) that you have proficiency with, and you can use Dexterity or your spellcasting ability modifier for its attack and damage rolls. On a hit, a fire shuriken deals {@damage 2d6} Fire damage plus the ability modifier you used, and any extra damage dealt by the attack, such as from Sneak Attack, is also Fire damage. A fire shuriken scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20.

You can throw one of the shuriken as part of the action used to cast this spell. Until the spell ends, you can throw the others in place of any attack you make with the {@action Attack|XPHB} action. Each shuriken vanishes after it hits or misses, and it can't set objects on fire or damage them. Any remaining shuriken vanish when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You create one additional shuriken for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Fire Spiders
entries: You call forth a teeming swarm of tiny fire elementals shaped like spiders, filling a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. The swarm lasts for the duration. Its area is {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}, and flammable objects in it that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

When the swarm appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when the swarm moves into its space, when it enters the swarm's area, or when it ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the swarm up to 30 feet. If you don't move it on your turn and no creature other than you is in its area, the swarm moves up to 15 feet toward the nearest creature it can sense at the end of your turn.
The spell ends early if the swarm's area is targeted by or included in the area of a spell of level 3 or higher that deals Cold damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Fire Stride
entries: Wisps of flame wrap your legs, letting you step into a fire and out of another. A fire you use must be at least as large as your space; Elementals and other creatures made of fire don't count as fires, nor do sources of extreme heat such as lava.

While you are in a fire's space, you instantly know the location of every suitable fire within 500 feet, and you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of one of them. A fire that has no room for you nearby, such as one inside a sealed furnace, isn't a valid destination and you don't sense it. If a destination fire burns on a surface that can't support you, such as a pool of burning oil, you suffer the consequences of arriving there.

You can teleport this way up to five times; the spell ends after the fifth teleport or when its duration expires. The spell doesn't protect you from fire, so you take any damage that entering or standing in a fire would normally deal.

spell.name: Fire Wings

m.text: a golden phoenix amulet worth 150+ GP and a bird's feather, which you burn

entries: Your arms become wings of brilliant flame for the duration. The flames don't harm you or anything you wear or carry, and they shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet. Items worn on your arms, such as rings and bracers, keep functioning.

You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet (40 feet if you are wearing Medium or Heavy armor) and can hover. While your arms are wings, you can't hold anything in your hands, and you can't cast spells that have Somatic components.

While you aren't flying, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make two melee spell attacks with the wings against targets within 5 feet of you. On a hit, a target takes {@damage 2d6} Fire damage.
The spell ends early if you are fully immersed in water. If the spell ends while you are aloft, you descend 60 feet per round until you land, taking no falling damage.

spell.name: Firebrand

m.text: a flask of Alchemist's Fire worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Fountains of liquid fire erupt from the ground. Choose up to five points within range. A 5-foot-radius, 20-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} of fire erupts from each point; the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}s can overlap, but a creature in more than one of them is affected only once.

Each creature in a Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d6} Fire damage, and the clinging fire deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Fire damage to it at the start of its next turn unless it or another creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to douse the flames first. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
Flammable objects in a Cylinder that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Fireburst
entries: Flame explodes outward from you. Each creature other than you in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Flammable objects in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that aren't being worn or carried start {@hazard burning|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2. With a level 5+ spell slot, the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} is 15 feet and the damage dice are d10s instead of d8s.

spell.name: Fires of Purity
entries: The willing creature you touch bursts into magical flames that don't harm it. For the duration, the target sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet, and it gains the following benefits.

items.name: Burning Strikes.
entries: The target's melee attacks deal an extra {@damage 2d8} Fire damage on a hit.

items.name: Searing Body.
entries: Whenever a creature within 5 feet of the target hits it with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage.

items.name: Purifying Flame.
entries: The target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage. If it is subjected to a Fire effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage and the damage dealt to attackers each increase by {@scaledamage 2d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Fireward
entries: You stomp the ground, and fire snuffs out in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range. When you cast the spell, every nonmagical fire in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} is extinguished, and each Elemental in it that has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

For the duration, nonmagical fire can't burn in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}; any such fire brought or kindled there goes out immediately. Magical fire is suppressed there as well: Fire damage can't be dealt to creatures or objects inside the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, and fiery magical effects (such as the flames of {@spell Wall of Fire|XPHB}) don't appear or function inside it, though they resume outside it.

spell.name: Fist of Stone

components.m: a pebble inscribed with a stylized fist

entries: One of your hands becomes a fist of living stone for the duration, without losing any flexibility. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks, and you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}s made with the fist and for the saving throw DC of its Grapple and Shove options.
When you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} using the fist, it deals {@damage 1d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier Bludgeoning damage instead of its normal damage.
In addition, when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} with the fist as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

spell.name: Flame Dagger
entries: A dagger-shaped beam of red-hot fire springs from your hand and lasts for the duration. It counts as a Simple Melee weapon with which you have proficiency, and it has the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} properties. You can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls. On a hit, it deals {@damage 2d6} Fire damage plus the ability modifier used for the attack roll.

The dagger sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet, and it ignites flammable objects it touches that aren't being worn or carried. If you let go of the dagger, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The spell ends early if the dagger is submerged in water.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases to {@damage 3d6} with a level 4-5 spell slot and to {@damage 4d6} with a level 6+ spell slot.

spell.name: Flame Whips
entries: Your arms stretch into whiplike appendages wreathed in fire for the duration.
As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can make two melee spell attacks with the whips, each against a target within 15 feet of you. On a hit, a target takes {@damage 3d8} Fire damage.
While your arms are whips, you can't hold anything in your hands, items worn on your arms stop functioning, and you can't cast spells that have Material components.

spell.name: Flame of Faith
entries: A nonmagical melee weapon you touch bursts into holy flame and becomes a magic weapon for the duration. It has a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls, and it deals an extra {@damage 1d4} Fire damage on a hit. On a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, it deals an additional {@damage 1d10} Fire damage.
The weapon sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 4+ spell slot, the bonus increases to +2 and the extra damage on a hit increases to {@damage 2d4}.

spell.name: Flashburst

components.m: a pinch of sulfur or phosphorus

entries: A blinding flash erupts in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} that can see makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

Each creature outside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} but within 120 feet of its center that can see the flash also makes the save, with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
A creature Blinded for 1 minute by this spell repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Flensing
entries: Invisible force peels the flesh from a creature you can see within range, inflicting agonizing pain. A creature without a physical body, or one in gaseous form, is unaffected.

The target makes a Constitution saving throw when you cast the spell and again at the start of each of its next three turns, after which the spell ends. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 4d10} Slashing damage, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, and it can't reduce the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum below 1.
The spell ends early if the target dies.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d10|8-9|1d10} with a level 9 spell slot.

spell.name: Fleshshiver
entries: The bones of a creature you can see within range twist and shudder beneath its flesh. The spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

At the end of the target's next turn, it makes a second Constitution saving throw (whether or not it failed the first). On a failed save, it takes {@damage 10d6} Necrotic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the Poisoned condition on itself on a success. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d6|6-9|2d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Flight of the Dragon

components.m: a dragon's wing claw, which the spell consumes

entries: Great draconic wings sprout from your shoulders for the duration, giving you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 100 feet. You can't hover; if you end your turn in the air without having moved at least 10 feet horizontally that turn, you fall unless something else holds you aloft.
When you travel for an hour or more, you cover up to 15 miles per hour.
When the spell ends, you fall if you are still aloft unless you can stop the fall.

spell.name: Focusing Chant
entries: You chant softly under your breath, and distractions fade from your mind. Until the spell ends, whenever you make an attack roll or an ability check, you add {@dice 1d4} to the roll.

spell.name: Foebane
entries: You touch a weapon and name a creature type, such as Fiends or Giants. The weapon takes on a faint blue glow, and until the spell ends, it gains the following benefits against creatures of the chosen type:

items: It counts as a magic weapon and has a +2 bonus to attack rolls.
It deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Force damage on a hit.

entries: In addition, while you hold the weapon, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other effects created by creatures of the chosen type.
If the weapon leaves your grasp, the spell ends at the end of your next turn unless you are holding it again by then.

spell.name: Force Chest
entries: A lidded box of magical force, 2 feet on each side, appears in your hands. When you cast the spell, you choose whether the box is {@condition Invisible|XPHB} or merely translucent, and you choose a password. The box weighs nothing.

The box can hold objects and Tiny or smaller creatures, and it holds enough air to sustain one Tiny creature for 1 hour. Its lid can be opened or closed only by a creature that speaks the password while touching the box (no action required). Nothing else can open it, including {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, the {@spell Knock|XPHB} spell, and similar magic.

The box is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell destroys it instantly, however. When the spell ends or the box is destroyed, its contents appear in its space.

spell.name: Force Claw
entries: You create an {@condition Invisible|XPHB} claw of magical force that guards a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} you choose within range. For the duration, whenever a creature you can see in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} moves out of a space within it, makes a ranged attack roll, or casts a spell, the claw can lash out at it (no action required): make a melee spell attack against that creature. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Force damage. The claw can strike any given creature no more than once per turn, but it can strike any number of different creatures each round. It never strikes you or creatures you designated when you cast the spell.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the guarded {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} up to 60 feet to a point within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Force Ladder

m.text: a miniature silver ladder worth 50+ GP

entries: A transparent ladder of magical force, visible only by its faintly glowing edges, appears at a point you choose within range. The ladder is 2 feet wide and 10 to 60 feet long (your choice), with rungs spaced 1 foot apart. You can set it vertically, horizontally, or at any angle, and it stays fixed in place for the duration, even in midair; a horizontal ladder can serve as a narrow bridge.
The ladder can support any amount of weight. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell destroys it instantly, however.

spell.name: Force Missiles
entries: You hurl three crackling blue missiles of magical force. Each missile strikes a creature or an object of your choice that you can see within range, dealing {@damage 2d6} Force damage to it, and then bursts. Each other creature within 5 feet of the target takes Force damage equal to half the damage the missile dealt. The missiles all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one target or several. Roll damage separately for each missile.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The spell creates one more missile for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Forceward
entries: You trace a curve in the air, and a transparent, immobile 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of shimmering energy forms, centered on yourself. For the duration, the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} has the following effects:

items: Spells and other magical effects can't deal Force damage to creatures or objects inside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

Objects and effects made of magical force, such as those created by {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, {@spell Forcecage|XPHB}, or {@spell Mage Armor|XPHB}, can't enter or form inside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, and any part of such an effect that overlaps the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is suppressed while it does so.

A creature that has the Incorporeal Movement trait, or that is made of magical force, must succeed on a Charisma saving throw to enter the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. On a failed save, it can't enter the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} until the start of its next turn.

entries: The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} doesn't push aside creatures or effects already inside it when it forms; those can remain and move within it freely.

spell.name: Forcewave

components.m: a piece of string and a drop of water

entries: You snap a wave of magical force outward from yourself. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Strength saving throw. A Huge or larger creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this save. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d6} Force damage and is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Forestfold
entries: Your feet subtly reshape themselves and the coloring of your skin, clothing, and gear shifts to match one kind of terrain. Choose Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark, or Underwater. Whenever you are in terrain of the chosen kind during the spell's duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have a +10 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.
You can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action while only {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by natural features of the terrain, such as foliage, snow, rocks, or murky water.
Moving through nonmagical {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement, and you leave no tracks unless you choose to.

spell.name: Fortify Familiar
entries: You touch your familiar (such as one summoned by {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}), and its body grows dense and resilient. For the duration, it gains the following benefits:

items: It gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.
It gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class.
Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against it becomes a normal hit.
When it is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} increase by 10 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Fortunate Fate
entries: You touch a creature and suffuse it with a golden aura that waits for the moment of its death. The first time the target would drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or would be killed by damage before the spell ends, it instead drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}, then immediately regains 70 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. This healing also ends the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions on the target. The spell then ends.
The spell can't prevent death from an effect that kills without dealing damage, such as {@spell Power Word Kill|XPHB}. A creature can benefit from only one casting of this spell at a time.

spell.name: Foundation of Stone
entries: You lend the stability of stone to up to three creatures you can see within range. Until the spell ends, each target gains the following benefits while it is standing on solid ground:

items: If it didn't move during its most recent turn, it has a +2 bonus to Armor Class.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws and ability checks it makes to avoid being moved or knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Freeze
entries: A thin blue ray streaked with white shoots from your hand toward a creature you can see within range, leaving a trail of light fog. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 6d8} Cold damage and must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be encased in ice for the duration.

While encased, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and can't speak, but it can breathe normally. A flying creature falls, and a swimming creature floats to the surface. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Cold damage. As an action, the target can make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, breaking free on a success; it can take this action despite being {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

The ice gives the target {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from everything outside it. The ice has AC 13, 30 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage. Damage dealt to the ice in excess of its remaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} is dealt to the target. The target is freed when the ice is destroyed, when it breaks free, or when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Freezing Fog
entries: A bank of frigid mist billows out in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. The fog spreads around corners and lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it, ending the spell. The spell fails if cast underwater.

The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}, and an icy rime coats the ground and every solid surface in it. The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and a creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} can't exceed 10 feet while it is inside.

A creature takes {@damage 4d6} Cold damage when it enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. It must then succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Frost Breath

components.m: three drops of water or fragments of ice

entries: You exhale a blast of frost and ice crystals. Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 3d6} Cold damage, and the shock of cold prevents it from taking Reactions until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Fugue

m.text: a miniature platinum violin bow worth 250+ GP

entries: A discordant cacophony of haunting, alien music fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. You are unaffected by it. Each creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} when it appears makes a Wisdom saving throw. A creature also makes this save when it enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, unless it has already failed it.

On a successful save, a creature is disoriented: it subtracts {@dice 1d4} from its attack rolls and ability checks while it remains in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. On a failed save, the fugue takes hold of the creature. At the start of each of its turns while it is in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, roll on the Fugue table to determine what happens to it that turn.

entries.caption: Fugue
rows: The creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.
The creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.
The creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.
The creature uses its action to make one melee attack against a random creature within its reach. If no creature is within reach, it does nothing this turn.

spell.name: Fuse Arms
entries: You touch a willing creature that has at least two arms, tentacles, or other limbs it uses to grasp and attack. With a sickening sound like melting wax, those limbs ooze together into a single massive limb. Limbs used only for walking, biting, or similar purposes are unaffected. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits and drawbacks:

items: It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws that rely on the fused limb, such as to lift, grapple, or climb.

Its attacks with a weapon wielded in the fused limb or with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} made with the limb deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage on a hit. This increases to {@damage 2d6} if the limb was formed from four or more limbs.

The fused limb can hold only one object at a time, though it can wield a weapon with the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property. A creature that relies on its fused limbs to make multiple attacks (for example, with a Multiattack action) can make only one attack with the fused limb per turn.

entries: The target can end the spell early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, its limbs separating back into their normal form.

spell.name: G'elsewhere Chant
entries: You touch a creature or an object that is Large or smaller, and it vanishes in a shower of golden sparks and a ringing chord, teleporting to a random unoccupied space up to 100 feet away that you can see. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw; on a successful save, the spell has no effect on it. On a failed save, it is teleported and takes {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage from the clap of its arrival.

To determine the destination, roll {@dice 1d8} for the direction (1 is the direction you're facing, then proceed clockwise in 45-degree steps) and {@dice 1d10} for the distance in increments of 10 feet. Roll again if the destination is out of your line of sight, inside a solid object, or more than 5 feet above the ground.

If the target is an object held or carried by a creature, or a creature that has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, the creature holding or grappling it can also make a Wisdom saving throw. If either creature succeeds, the spell has no effect. Otherwise, the teleported target is no longer held or {@condition Grappled|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature or object for each spell slot level above 3. Roll the destination separately for each target.

spell.name: Gembomb

m.text: a gem worth 1+ GP, which the spell consumes when the gem is thrown

entries: You place a spark of force in the heart of a gem you hold, turning it into a bomb that only you can use. In anyone else's hands, the gem is inert.

Until the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to lob the gem at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. It lands exactly where you aim and explodes in a 5-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d8} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell then ends.
If the spell ends before you throw the gem, the gem returns to normal.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Gemjump

m.text: a gem worth 500+ GP

entries: You touch the gem required for this spell and forge a link between it and yourself. Until the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to speak a command word and teleport instantly to the gem, provided you and the gem are on the same plane of existence. You appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the gem; you never arrive off target. If there's no room near the gem, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space. The spell then ends.

When you teleport, you can bring up to five willing creatures within 10 feet of you, along with everything you and they are wearing and carrying. They appear in unoccupied spaces as close to you as possible.
The gem can be moved, hidden, or handed to someone else after you cast the spell. You can have only one gem linked by this spell at a time; casting it again ends the earlier spell.

spell.name: General of Undeath
entries: You feed the darkness within you until it can bend far more of the dead to your will. For the duration, you gain the following benefits.

items.name: Legions of the Dead.
entries: When you cast {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB} or {@spell Create Undead|XPHB}, you animate or reassert control over twice as many creatures as normal.

items.name: Far-Reaching Command.
entries: When you mentally command Undead under your control, the range at which you can command them becomes 1 mile, and you can issue commands to all of them at once.

items.name: Seize the Dead.
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can target one Undead you can see within 60 feet of you that isn't under another creature's control. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is under your control until this spell ends, obeying your commands as if you had animated it with {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB}. The total Challenge Rating of creatures you control through this benefit can't exceed 15. An Undead that succeeds on the save is immune to this benefit until the spell ends.
When the spell ends, every creature you animated or reasserted beyond the normal number, and every creature you seized with this spell, is no longer under your control.

spell.name: Ghost Touch Armor

components.m: a tiny shield made of resin

entries: You touch a willing creature wearing armor or carrying a Shield. Until the spell ends, that protection extends into the spirit world, and the creature gains the following benefits against Undead, creatures that have the Incorporeal Movement trait, and creatures on the Ethereal Plane:

items: Such creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against the target.
Such creatures can't move through the target's space, and the target can grapple and shove them as if they were corporeal.
The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against being possessed by such creatures.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Ghost Touch Weapon
entries: Choose one weapon or up to fifty pieces of ammunition within range; the ammunition must all be touching one another. Until the spell ends, the weapon or ammunition is magical and gains the following properties:

items: Its damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage of creatures that have the Incorporeal Movement trait.
