It can strike creatures on the Ethereal Plane that are within its reach or range and that its wielder can see, as if they were on the wielder's plane.

A creature it hits loses the ability to move through creatures and objects until the start of the wielder's next turn. If the creature is inside an object when hit, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.
Incorporeal creatures can pick up and wield it, and it affects corporeal creatures normally in their hands.

entries: A ranged weapon targeted by this spell doesn't grant these properties to its ammunition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional weapon or group of fifty pieces of ammunition for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Ghost Trap
entries: A field that forces the insubstantial into solid form ripples out from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Until the spell ends, the following rules apply in the Emanation:

items: Creatures can't move through other creatures or objects, and creatures with the Incorporeal Movement trait lose their {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
A creature inside an object when the Emanation reaches it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes {@damage 4d10} Force damage.
Creatures can't enter the Ethereal Plane, by spell or otherwise. Creatures on the Ethereal Plane can't enter the Emanation's counterpart there or affect anything in the Emanation.

A creature possessing another creature in the Emanation makes a Charisma saving throw when the Emanation reaches it and at the start of each of its turns while there. On a failed save, it is expelled, appears in the nearest unoccupied space, and can't possess any creature in the Emanation until the spell ends.

spell.name: Ghostform
entries: You and everything you are wearing and carrying take on a visible, ghostly form for the duration. Objects you drop or throw, and projectiles you fire, become solid as they leave your possession. Until the spell ends, you gain the following traits:

items.name: Insubstantial.
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage except Force, Necrotic, and Radiant damage. You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and you can't be pushed or pulled against your will.

items.name: Incorporeal Movement.
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and you can hover. You can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and you move through water as easily as through air. You take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside an object. You can't move through a wall or barrier made of force.

items.name: Silent Spirit.
entries: You make no sound unless you choose to, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and you don't trigger traps or effects that depend on weight.

items.name: Ghostly Limits.
entries: You can't grapple or shove creatures, and you can't pick up or manipulate objects you weren't carrying when you cast the spell. Your attack rolls with melee weapons and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} against creatures that lack the Incorporeal Movement trait have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. Your spells and ranged attacks function normally.
If you are inside an object when the spell ends, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take Force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.

spell.name: Ghostharp
entries: You touch a Tiny object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else, and it gathers the lingering echoes of a tune played or sung within 50 feet of it in the last 24 hours. If several tunes qualify, it gathers the most recent one, or one you name if you heard it.

Until the spell ends, while you are within 30 feet of the object, you can speak a command word (no action required) to make the object replay the tune, or to stop it. The tune repeats until you stop it or the spell ends. The replay is imperfect: it doesn't record speech, and it can't reproduce magical effects such as Bardic Inspiration or spells.

spell.name: Ghoul Gauntlet
entries: Your touch begins turning a living Humanoid into a ravenous ghoul. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 7d6} Necrotic damage and its flesh begins to die.

While the transformation lasts, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. Healing restores its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} normally but doesn't stop the transformation. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save; after three successful saves, the transformation ends. {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} (against your spell's level), {@spell Heal|XPHB}, and {@spell Wish|XPHB} also end it.

If the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while transforming, it dies and rises at the start of your next turn as a {@creature Ghoul|XMM} under your control. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns, you can mentally command any Ghoul you created with this spell within 120 feet of you (if you control several, you can command them all at once). You decide what action each takes and where it moves on its next turn, or you can issue a general command. If you issue no commands, a Ghoul takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves only to avoid harm.

Ghouls created by this spell remain under your control indefinitely, but you can control no more than four at a time. If a fifth rises, you choose one of the others to become free of your control; a freed Ghoul is hostile to all living creatures.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage on a failed save increases by {@scaledamage 7d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Ghoul Gesture

components.m: a scrap of cloth from a ghoul's clothing or a pinch of earth from a ghoul's lair

entries: A sickly green ray stabs from your finger toward a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for the duration. On a successful save, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and the spell ends.
At the end of each of its turns, a {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. The ray affects only Humanoids; other creatures are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 3. You can direct the rays at the same target or at different ones; make a separate attack roll for each ray.

spell.name: Ghoul Glyph

components.m: earth from a ghoul's lair, used to trace the glyph

entries: You trace a glyph about 1 foot across on a surface or object. You choose whether it is visible as faintly glowing green lines or invisible; an invisible glyph requires a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC to notice. If the glyph's object is moved more than 5 feet from where you cast the spell, the spell ends. Only one ghoul glyph can occupy a 5-foot square.

The glyph triggers when a creature other than you moves within 5 feet of it, including an {@condition Invisible|XPHB} creature but not one on the Ethereal Plane. The triggering creature, if it is a Humanoid, makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute and reeks of the grave: each other creature within 10 feet of it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition while within 10 feet of it and the target remains {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}. The {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once triggered, the spell ends.

spell.name: Ghoul Light
entries: A sickly green flame springs from an object you touch. It sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. It creates no heat, needs no air or fuel, and can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
While within 30 feet of the flame, Undead have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that turn Undead and against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} created by a spell of level 2 or higher, the spell that created the Darkness dispels this spell.

spell.name: Giant's Wrath

components.m: four pebbles, which the spell transforms

entries: You infuse four pebbles in your hand with transmutation magic. Until the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to hurl one of the pebbles, which swells into a boulder the instant it leaves your hand. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d10} Bludgeoning damage, and if it is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

Each boulder shrinks back to a pebble after the attack. The spell ends early once you have hurled all four pebbles, or if you drop a pebble or give one to another creature, in which case the remaining pebbles become mundane.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d10|3-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Girallon's Blessing

components.m: a few strands of girallon hair

entries: You touch a willing creature, and a second pair of arms bursts from its torso. Each of its hands, new and old, ends in sharp claws with fingers and an opposable thumb. Until the spell ends, the target gains the following benefits:

items: {@b Claws.} When the target hits with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} using its claws, it deals {@damage 1d6} plus its Strength modifier Slashing damage instead of the strike's normal damage.

{@b Flurry of Claws.} When the target takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on its turn and makes every attack of that action with its claws, it can make one additional claw attack as part of that action.
{@b Rend.} Once per turn, when the target hits the same creature with two or more claw attacks on the same turn, that creature takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage.
{@b Extra Hands.} The target can hold and manipulate objects with its additional hands, and it has a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries: When the spell ends, the extra arms wither and fall away harmlessly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage from Rend increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Glass Strike
entries: A bolt of glittering energy leaps from the mirror shard in your hand. Choose one of the following effects, targeting something you can see within range.

entries.name: Glass Creature
entries: The target creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it turns to glass and has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition for the duration. While petrified this way, the target doesn't have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to damage, and it has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage. If the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while made of glass, it shatters and dies. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. On a successful initial save, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 until the start of your next turn.
If you maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this spell for the entire possible duration, the target remains glass for 8 hours, after which it returns to its normal form.

entries.name: Glass Object
entries: A nonmagical object, or a section of a larger object such as a wall or floor, that fits in a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} and isn't being worn or carried turns to glass for 8 hours. The glass has {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} 13 and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} per inch of thickness. This version of the spell doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.
Magic items, including those carried by a petrified creature, are unaffected. When the effect ends, the target returns to its normal material; any damage or breakage it suffered as glass remains.

spell.name: Glowing Orb

m.text: a glass sphere worth 50+ GP

entries: You touch a fist-sized glass sphere and fill it with light drawn from the Positive Plane, turning it into a glowing orb. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while the orb is within 30 feet of you, you can set its light to any level between none and {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 60-foot radius plus {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 60 feet. You can control any number of glowing orbs, adjusting each individually or all of them together with the same Bonus Action.

The orb keeps its magic if you die. A creature with an Intelligence or Wisdom score of 13 or higher can take control of an orb by touching it, ending your control. The orb has {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} 13 and 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}; if it breaks, the spell ends.

spell.name: Golden Barding
entries: You touch a willing creature that is serving as your mount, such as a steed summoned by {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}, and a suit of gleaming golden barding appears on it, fitting perfectly. Until the spell ends, the target's {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} is 16 if its AC is lower than that. The barding doesn't reduce the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} or impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on any of its rolls.
The spell ends early if the target stops being your mount, or if you cast this spell again.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The AC becomes 17 with a level 3-4 spell slot and 18 with a level 5+ spell slot.

spell.name: Golem Strike
entries: A dim glow fills your eyes, revealing the weak points in the magic that animates Constructs. For the duration, you know whether any Construct you can see within 60 feet of you has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}, {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to any damage types, and which ones.
In addition, once on each of your turns when you hit a Construct with an attack roll, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d6} Force damage to it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Grace
entries: You speak a single word and your body is bathed in silvery divine light. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits and drawbacks:

items: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws.
When you hit with a melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can have the attack deal Radiant damage instead of its normal damage type.

You shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet, and you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

spell.name: Grave Strike
entries: Golden motes of light dance before your eyes and converge on the Undead you look at. For the duration, Undead you can see within 60 feet of you can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition against you.
In addition, once on each of your turns when you hit an Undead with an attack roll, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage to it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Graymantle
entries: A skull-shaped cloud of gray energy streaks toward a creature you can see within range and wraps around it. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on the save.

On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 6d10} Necrotic damage, and for the duration, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by any means, and any Regeneration or similar trait that restores its Hit Points automatically doesn't function. The target can still gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.
On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only and can't regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d10|5-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Great Maelstrom
entries: You twist a body of water into a titanic whirlpool. Choose a point on the surface of water within range; the water there must be at least 120 feet wide and 60 feet deep, or the spell fails and is wasted. A vortex forms as a 60-foot-radius, 60-foot-deep {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on that point and lasts for the duration.

Each creature in the water within 50 feet of the vortex (on any side or below it) makes a Strength saving throw when the vortex appears, when it enters that water, and when it starts its turn there. On a failed save, the creature is sucked into the vortex and takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage. A creature with a Swim Speed has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this save. A vessel and everything aboard it avoids being sucked in if its pilot succeeds on a Wisdom check against your spell save DC, adding their Proficiency Bonus if they are proficient with Water Vehicles; otherwise the vessel is sucked in, taking the same damage, and so is each creature aboard it.

A creature or object inside the vortex has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, is underwater, and takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns. A trapped creature makes a Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns, escaping on a success. An escaping creature is ejected into an unoccupied space next to the bottom of the vortex of your choice, or next to its top if the creature is Huge or larger. An ejected creature can be sucked back in. When the spell ends, everything in the vortex is ejected this way.

spell.name: Great Thunderclap
entries: A deafening peal of thunder erupts from a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered there makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature Deafened this way makes another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Deafened condition on itself on a success.
The thunderclap is audible out to 300 feet.

spell.name: Greater Alarm

m.text: a carved crystal bell worth 100+ GP

entries: You set an alarm against intrusion, including intruders slipping in from beyond the physical world. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 40-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a creature touches or enters the warded area, including a creature on the Ethereal Plane that moves through the corresponding space and a creature that teleports into the area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is audible or mental:

items.name: Audible Alarm
entries: The alarm produces the sound of a crystal bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet of the warded area.

items.name: Mental Alarm
entries: You are alerted by a mental ping if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you're asleep.

spell.name: Greater Bestow Curse
entries: You touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed. The curse lasts for 24 hours or until it is ended as described below, and the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice:

items: Choose two abilities. The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws made with those abilities, and its maximum for each of those abilities becomes 8 (it can't exceed this maximum).
The target subtracts {@dice 1d8} from every attack roll, ability check, and saving throw it makes.

At the start of each of the target's turns, it rolls a {@dice d4}. On a 4, it acts normally. Otherwise, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0 until the start of its next turn.

entries: At the DM's discretion, you may choose an alternative curse of similar power.

{@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can't end the curse, and {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, and similar magic end it only if cast using a level 7+ spell slot. {@spell Wish|XPHB} also ends it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot, the curse lasts until it is ended, and only {@spell Wish|XPHB} can end it.

spell.name: Greater Blink
entries: You gain control over your passage between planes. At the end of each of your turns for the duration, you can choose to vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). While on the Ethereal Plane, you can perceive the plane you left, which is cast in shades of gray, but you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. You can affect and be affected only by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and creatures on the other plane can't perceive you unless they have a special ability that lets them perceive things on the Ethereal Plane.

You return to the other plane at the start of your next turn and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane. You return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you left. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space.

In addition, when you are hit by an attack roll while on your original plane, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to shift into the Ethereal Plane, causing the attack to miss unless it can also affect creatures on the Ethereal Plane. You return at the start of your next turn, as above.

While the spell lasts, you can also move through creatures and objects on your turn as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, flickering partly into the Ethereal Plane as you pass. If you end your turn inside a creature or an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take {@damage 1d10} Force damage for every 5 feet you are moved.

spell.name: Greater Cloak of Bravery
entries: You raise your arm, and a glittering mantle of courage settles over every ally who can see you. Choose any number of creatures within a 1-mile {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you that can see you, which can include you. For the duration, each target gains the following benefits:

items: It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
Whenever it makes an attack roll, it can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the attack roll.
The first time it would drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} before the spell ends, it instead drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}.

spell.name: Greater Dimension Door
entries: You teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."
Until the spell ends, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns to teleport again, this time to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you.

Each time you teleport with this spell, you can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.

If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take {@damage 4d6} Force damage, and that teleportation fails.

spell.name: Greater Disrupt Undead
entries: A black ray of disruptive energy springs from your hand toward an Undead you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 7d8} Radiant damage.

If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the ray leaps to another Undead of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of the first target. Make a ranged spell attack against the second target. On a hit, it takes Radiant damage equal to half the damage rolled against the first target. This spell has no effect on creatures that aren't Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Greater Enlarge Person
entries: You touch a Humanoid, which grows to a larger size for the duration. If the target is unwilling, it can make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the spell has no effect.

The target's size increases by one category (from Medium to Large, for example), along with everything it is wearing and carrying. Any item it drops returns to normal size at once, and a thrown weapon or piece of ammunition returns to normal size immediately after it hits or misses. The target also has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and its attacks with its enlarged weapons or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal an extra {@damage 1d4} damage on a hit.
If there isn't enough room for the target to grow, it attains the maximum possible size in the space available.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Greater Floating Disk
entries: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls.

The disk isn't bound to the ground: it hovers at any height and stays in place when it isn't moving. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the disk up to 30 feet in any direction, including straight up or down, carrying everything on it, including you.

If you end your turn more than 15 feet from the disk, it moves to stay within 15 feet of you, flying over pits and obstacles if necessary. If you move more than 100 feet from the disk (typically because it can't fly around an obstacle to follow you), the spell ends.

spell.name: Greater Mage Armor
entries: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a tangible field of force shaped like armor surrounds it. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 15 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor or if you cast this spell again.

spell.name: Greater Mage Hand
entries: A ghostly white radiance suffuses your hand, and you seize one creature or object you can see within range that weighs no more than 40 pounds. When you cast the spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns before the spell ends, you can move the target up to 20 feet in any direction, including up into the air, where it remains suspended. The spell ends if the target is ever more than 120 feet away from you.

You can also use the grip to manipulate the target as if with one hand, such as pulling a lever or rope, turning a key, rotating an object, or opening an unlocked door or container, provided the task requires no more force than lifting 40 pounds. The grip can't attack, activate magic items, or wield a weapon.

An unwilling creature, or a creature wearing or carrying the target object, can resist the spell with a successful Strength saving throw. A creature that fails is moved by the spell and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition while suspended in the air; at the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the spell on a success. If the spell ends while the target is in the air, it falls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The weight limit increases by 40 pounds for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Greater Resistance
entries: You touch one willing creature. For the duration, the target adds 2 to its saving throws.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you use a level 5 spell slot, the duration is 24 hours. If you use a level 6+ spell slot, the duration is 24 hours, the bonus is 3 instead of 2, and the target also has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

spell.name: Greater Stone Shape

components.m: soft clay, to be worked into roughly the desired shape

entries: You touch a stone object of Huge size or smaller, or a section of stone no more than 15 feet in any dimension, and form it into any shape that suits your purpose. You could, for example, shape a large rock into a weapon, idol, or coffer, or create a doorway through a wall, as long as the wall is less than 5 feet thick. You can also form a door and its hinges, but finer mechanical detail isn't possible.

spell.name: Greater Whirlwind
entries: A tornado forms in a 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on the ground you can see within range. It lasts for the duration. Until it ends, the area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} and difficult terrain, no ranged attack can pass through it, and flames inside it are extinguished.

When you cast the spell, and at the start of each of your turns afterward, you can move the tornado up to 60 feet. Each creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the tornado, or enters that area for the first time on a turn, makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a Large or smaller creature is pulled up to 30 feet toward the tornado's center; a Huge creature is knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}; a flying creature of Huge or smaller size is pulled all the way to the tornado's center. A Gargantuan creature that fails the save has its Speed reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

A creature that enters the tornado's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A Large or smaller creature that fails the save must also succeed on a Strength saving throw or be caught up in the tornado, having the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions and taking {@damage 6d6} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of 3 of its turns, the tornado ejects the creature to a random space within 20 feet of the tornado, 20 feet off the ground, and it falls if it can't fly.
Structures in the tornado take {@damage 4d10} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns, and the tornado uproots plants in its path and leaves difficult terrain behind it.

spell.name: Guided Shot
entries: You focus your attention on distant foes, and your aim becomes unerringly precise. Until the spell ends, your ranged attack rolls gain the following benefits:

items: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on them.
Targets gain no benefit from {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} or Three-Quarters {@variantrule Cover|XPHB} against them.

entries: The spell doesn't let you attack beyond a weapon's long range or attack a target that has Total {@variantrule Cover|XPHB}.

spell.name: Guiding Light
entries: A beam of radiance shoots down from above onto a point you choose within range, highlighting each creature in a 5-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered there. For the duration, each highlighted creature sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius, and ranged attack rolls against it have a +2 bonus.
The light follows each highlighted creature as it moves. The spell ends on a creature if it has Total {@variantrule Cover|XPHB} from you.

spell.name: Gutsnake
entries: A 15-foot-long eyeless tentacle ending in snapping reptilian jaws sprouts from your stomach. It obeys only you and doesn't interfere with your spellcasting. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Bite.} When you cast this spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can make a melee spell attack with the tentacle against a creature within 15 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d10} Piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC).

{@b Constrict.} A creature Grappled by the tentacle takes {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The tentacle can grapple only one creature at a time, and while it does so, it can bite only that creature. You can release the creature at any time (no action required).

{@b Climber.} You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks made to climb and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks made to keep your balance.

entries: Attacks and effects that target the tentacle affect you instead. Damage you take this way doesn't harm the tentacle, and it doesn't cause you to make Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Bite damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|5-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Hail of Stone

m.text: a chip of jade worth 5+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: Stones rain down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d10} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried also take this damage.
The fallen stones vanish at the end of your next turn; until then, the ground in the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|1-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Hailstones
entries: You hurl two frigid globes of ice, which you can aim at the same target or at different ones within range. If you choose different targets, they must all be within 30 feet of one another. Make a ranged spell attack for each globe. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d6} Cold damage as the globe shatters into a shower of ice crystals, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of each globe increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Hamatula Barbs

components.m: a barb from a barbed devil

entries: Slender, hellishly glowing barbs sprout from the body and clothing of a willing creature you touch. For the duration, whenever a creature within 5 feet of the target hits it with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes {@damage 2d8} Piercing damage from the barbs. The target isn't harmed by its own barbs.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Hand of Divinity
entries: A great pair of spectral hands briefly cradles a creature you touch, then fades, leaving the creature glowing with a faint orange nimbus. For the duration, the target gains a +2 bonus to saving throws.

The target must worship the same deity or pantheon as you, or follow the same creed or philosophy (the DM decides whether a creature qualifies). The spell has no effect on any other creature, and the spell slot isn't expended if you touch a creature that doesn't qualify.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2, touching each one during the casting.

spell.name: Hand of the Faithful
entries: You create an immobile, shimmering ward in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range, its border traced on the ground by the ghostly image of upraised hands. Creatures that share your faith (worshiping the same deity or pantheon as you, or following the same creed or philosophy) and creatures openly wearing or carrying your holy symbol can enter and move within the ward freely.

Any other creature that enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of the current turn. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} doesn't make this save if it spends its whole turn leaving the area by the shortest route. Once a creature succeeds on this save, it is unaffected by this casting of the spell.
The spell ends early if you cast it again.

spell.name: Hardening

m.text: an ointment of diamond dust worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You rub the ointment along an object, and a warm red glow strengthens it. The target is one object, or a section of a larger object, that fits within a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. If the object is made of metal or stone, it must instead fit within a 2-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must be willing.

For the duration, the object has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and its {@variantrule Damage Threshold|XPHB} increases by 10 (or it gains a {@variantrule Damage Threshold|XPHB} of 10 if it had none). Its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, weight, and other properties are unchanged; a hardened weapon or suit of armor works exactly as before.

The spell doesn't protect the material against change that doesn't come from damage: ice still melts, paper and wood still burn, and stone can still be reshaped by spells such as {@spell Stone Shape|XPHB}.

spell.name: Harmonic Chorus
entries: A mantle of sweet tones settles around one willing creature other than you that you can see within range, sharpening its spellcasting. For the duration, the target gains a +2 bonus to its spell save DC and to its spell attack rolls.

spell.name: Haunting Tune
entries: You weave a dread-laden melody into your music. Choose up to five creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Each target that can hear you makes a Wisdom saving throw. A creature that has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition automatically succeeds.

On a failed save, the creature is shaken for the duration: whenever it makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, it subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the roll. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Hawkeye
entries: With a hawk's cry, you sharpen your eyesight; distant creatures and objects seem closer and more distinct. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight.
The normal and long ranges of ranged and thrown weapons you use increase by half (round down to the nearest 5 feet). For example, a {@item Longbow|XPHB} you wield has a range of 225/900 feet.

spell.name: Heal Animal Companion
entries: You lay your hand on your animal companion, and its eyes clear and its breathing eases. The target must be a creature bound to you as a companion: a Beast that is your loyal companion, the beast of a Beast Master's Primal Companion feature, a familiar summoned by {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, or a steed summoned by {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}. The DM decides whether any other creature qualifies.
The target regains 40 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. This spell also ends the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions on the target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 40|3-9|10} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Healing Lorecall
entries: A divine touch guides your healing hand. Until the spell ends, whenever you cast a spell that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature, you can choose one creature that regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from it; that creature regains additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you can end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition on it.

If you have proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|XPHB} skill, you can instead reduce that creature's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level by 1. A creature can have its {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} reduced by this spell only once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

spell.name: Healing Sting
entries: You crush the wasps between your palms and strike, drawing a foe's vitality into yourself. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d10} Necrotic damage, and you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|2-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Healing Touch
entries: The skin of your hands turns translucent as you pour your own life essence into a creature you touch. Choose a number of d8s, up to six. The target regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total rolled, and you then take Necrotic damage equal to half the {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} it regained (round down). This damage can't be reduced in any way. This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The maximum number of d8s you can choose increases by two for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Healthful Rest
entries: A diffuse golden glow wraps up to six creatures of your choice within range, easing the strains of the day. For the duration, each target gains the following benefits:

items: The first time the target spends one or more {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, it regains an extra {@dice 1d8} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
If the target finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, its {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 2 instead of 1.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra healing increases by {@scaledice 1d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Heart Ripper
entries: Invisible bolts of force slam into one creature you can see within range, trying to drive its heart out of its body. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, if the target has 40 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer, its heart bursts out of its back and it dies. Otherwise, it takes {@damage 4d8} Force damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, nothing happens.
Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, and Undead are unaffected, as is any creature that has no heart or doesn't depend on one to survive (the DM decides).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Hit Point threshold increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Heart of Stone

m.text: a carved stone heart of jade, obsidian, or gold-veined marble worth 5,000+ GP

entries: You exchange your living heart for the stone heart, which settles into your chest. Your living heart appears in your hand; you can store or hide it anywhere, and it keeps beating for the duration. While the spell lasts, you gain the following benefits and drawbacks:

items: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage.
Whenever you take Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, that damage is reduced by 5.

You can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by spending {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, and finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} restores only 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} to you. Other magic heals you normally.
Your living heart is a Tiny object with AC 10 and 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or otherwise destroyed, you die instantly.

entries: If the spell is dispelled or otherwise ends, your living heart returns to your chest and the stone heart appears where your living heart was. While you're in an area of antimagic, such as an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB}, the two hearts swap places and the spell is suppressed; they swap back when you leave it. A {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell cast on you also ends this spell unless you choose to resist it, in which case you succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC.

spell.name: Heartfire
entries: A flickering red fire bursts in a 5-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range, outlining every creature in it in flame as its passions manifest as fire. Constructs and Undead are unaffected.

For the duration, each outlined creature sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet, and it can't benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition or from being {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} by nonmagical darkness.

When the fire appears, each outlined creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d4} Fire damage, and it takes this damage again at the start of each of its turns for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, both initially and on later turns.
A creature can take an action to douse the flames on itself or on another creature within 5 feet of it, as can immersion in water; doing so ends the spell on that creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|2-9|1d4} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Heat Drain
entries: You pull the warmth out of every living thing around you. Each creature other than you in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 12d8} Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Constructs and Undead are unaffected.
The stolen heat rushes into you: you gain 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} for each creature that took damage from this spell. These Temporary Hit Points last for 10 minutes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 12d8|8-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 8.

spell.name: Heatstroke
entries: You make one creature you can see within range suffer as if it had toiled for hours under a merciless desert sun. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, which it makes with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if it is wearing Heavy armor. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 4d6} Fire damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

Exhaustion levels gained from this spell are removed when the creature finishes a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, and a creature can't have more than 2 Exhaustion levels from this spell at a time. A creature that has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage is unaffected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Heavenly Host
entries: Heavenly rays lance down from above, and celestial servants manifest within them. When you finish casting the spell, {@dice 2d4} {@creature Lantern Archon|MPP|Lantern Archons} appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range. Ten minutes later, {@dice 1d4} {@creature Hound Archon|MPP|Hound Archons} appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the point where the first creatures appeared, and ten minutes after that, one {@creature Warden Archon|MPP} appears in the same way. Each archon has the maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for its stat block.

The archons are allies to you and your allies, and no other effect can take control of them while the spell lasts. In combat, the archons share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but they take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can dismiss any number of the archons you can see. Each archon disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creatures can't willingly move more than 200 feet from the point where the first wave appeared.

spell.name: Hellish Horde
entries: A wave of spectral fire bursts forth, and devils step out of the curling smoke to serve you. When you finish casting the spell, {@dice 2d4} {@creature Bearded Devil|XMM|Bearded Devils} appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range. Ten minutes later, one {@creature Chain Devil|XMM} appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the point where the first creatures appeared, and ten minutes after that, one {@creature Bone Devil|XMM} appears in the same way. Each devil has the maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for its stat block.

The devils are allies to you and your allies, and no other effect can take control of them while the spell lasts. In combat, the devils share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but they take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can dismiss any number of the devils you can see. Each devil disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creatures can't willingly move more than 200 feet from the point where the first wave appeared.

spell.name: Herald's Call
entries: You call out in a commanding voice. Choose up to three creatures in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you that can hear you. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or, until the end of its next turn, have its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} halved, be unable to take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}, and be able to take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both.

A target under the effect of {@spell Haste|XPHB} loses that spell's benefits until the end of its next turn if it fails the save, but the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell doesn't end. Creatures that have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on the save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Heroics

components.m: a scrap of a weapon or armor that was used in battle by a veteran warrior

entries: You touch a willing creature and fill it with martial vigor. For the duration, the target gains one {@filter Fighting Style feat|feats|category=FS} of your choice that it doesn't already have. The target doesn't need the Fighting Style feature to benefit from the feat, but it must meet any other prerequisite the feat has.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. Each target can gain a different feat.

spell.name: Hidden Lodge

components.m: a chip of stone, a pinch of sand, and a twig, plus silver wire and a tiny bell if you want the lodge to include an alarm

entries: You conjure a sturdy, camouflaged lodge in an unoccupied area within range that is at most 20 feet on each side and on level ground. The lodge has a single floor, a 10-foot-high ceiling, one door, two shuttered windows, and a fireplace with a chimney. Its interior holds enough bunks, a table, and stools for up to eight Medium creatures, and it is warm, dry, and comfortable regardless of the weather outside.

The walls, floor, and roof are magical stone. Each 10-foot section has AC 17 and 60 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}; a section reduced to 0 Hit Points crumbles to dust. The door and shutters are magically locked: you and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open them freely, but they otherwise can be forced open only with a successful Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC.

From the outside, the lodge looks like a natural feature suited to the surroundings, such as a house-sized boulder, a sand dune, a grassy knoll, a dense thicket, or a huge tree. No smoke, light, or sound escapes the lodge. A creature more than 30 feet away can't tell the lodge apart from the natural terrain by any means short of magic such as {@spell True Seeing|XPHB}. A creature within 30 feet of the lodge that searches the area can take a {@action Search|XPHB} action and make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB} or {@skill Survival|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, recognizing the lodge as an artificial dwelling on a success.

If you provide the silver wire and bell when you cast the spell, the lodge is also warded by an alarm: whenever a creature you didn't designate comes within 20 feet of the lodge, you hear a bell if you are within 1 mile of it, waking you if you are asleep.
When the spell ends, the lodge vanishes, and any creatures and objects inside it are left harmlessly on the ground where it stood.

spell.name: Hide from Dragons
entries: You touch up to five willing creatures. For the duration, Dragons can't perceive the warded creatures by any sense, including Blindsight. A Dragon acts as though each warded creature isn't there: it doesn't target or attack a warded creature and doesn't notice it moving about, speaking, or taking things, though it can still be harmed by a Dragon's area effects that happen to include its space.
If a warded creature attacks a Dragon, deals damage to one, casts a spell on one, touches one, or takes or disturbs any part of a Dragon's hoard, the spell ends for all warded creatures.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The duration increases to 8 hours with a level 6+ spell slot.

spell.name: Hide the Path

m.text: a 6-inch onyx sphere on an obsidian stand, worth 1,000+ GP

entries: You ward a region against divination magic. The warded area is made of up to ten contiguous 50-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}s, shaped as you like, and you must be within it when you cast the spell. You place the spell's onyx sphere anywhere within the area.

While the ward lasts, any creature that casts a Divination spell of level 6 or lower while in the warded area must succeed on an ability check using its spellcasting ability against your spell save DC, or the spell fails and the spell slot is wasted. Sensors created by Divination spells of level 6 or lower, such as that of {@spell Scrying|XPHB} or {@spell Arcane Eye|XPHB}, can't appear inside the warded area. In addition, {@spell Find the Path|XPHB} can't guide anyone to a destination inside the warded area, and it doesn't function while its caster is in the warded area.
A creature touching the onyx sphere ignores this spell's effects on its own Divination spells. The spell ends early if the onyx sphere is destroyed or removed from the warded area.
Casting this spell in the same location every day for a year makes the effect last until it is dispelled or the onyx sphere is destroyed or removed from the area.

spell.name: Hiss of Sleep
entries: You whisper a droning, sibilant chant. Choose up to ten creatures you can see within range that can hear you. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for the duration. Ordinary noise doesn't wake a target, but the spell ends on a target if it takes damage or if someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake or slap it awake.

Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} or {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target two additional creatures for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Holy Mount
entries: You touch a willing creature that is serving as your mount, such as the steed from {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}, and a golden nimbus surrounds it. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits:

items: Its creature type is Celestial.
It has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.
It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid, Cold, and Lightning damage.
Once on each of its turns when it hits a creature with an attack roll, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage, or {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|2-5|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Holy Spurs
entries: Your mount's legs glow with yellow radiance. Choose a creature within range that is serving as your mount, such as the steed from {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}. For the duration, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 40 feet, and {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} against it are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 2+ spell slot, the spell doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}, and its duration becomes 10 minutes.

spell.name: Holy Star
entries: You call into being a glowing mote of divine energy that hovers near your shoulder. It sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius. When you cast the spell, and at the start of each of your later turns, choose one of the star's functions below; that function is active until you choose another.
When you cast the spell, roll {@dice 1d4 + 3}. The result is the star's turning capacity, measured in spell levels; it doesn't replenish while the spell lasts.

items.name: Protection
entries: You have a +4 bonus to AC.

items.name: Spell Turning
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells. In addition, when you are targeted by a spell that targets only you and whose level is no higher than the star's remaining turning capacity, the star turns the spell: it has no effect on you and instead targets its caster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster. Subtract the spell's level from the turning capacity. Cantrips count as level 0 and don't reduce the capacity. Once the capacity is spent, this function only grants the {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

items.name: Star Bolt
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns while this function is active, including the turn you choose it, the star lashes out at a creature you can see within 90 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d10} Fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Star Bolt damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Holy Storm

m.text: a flask of Holy Water worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: A driving, warm rain falls in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on you. The {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} doesn't move with you. The area is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}, creatures in it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing, and ranged attack rolls made into, out of, or through the area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. The rain douses exposed flames in the area, and a protected flame such as a lantern's has a 50 percent chance of being doused when the spell is cast and at the start of each of your turns.
When a Fiend or an Undead enters the {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes {@damage 4d6} Radiant damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Horrible Taste
entries: You touch a creature or an object, and the touched target becomes foul-tasting for the duration. Whenever a creature bites the target, including with a Bite attack or by eating part of it, the biter must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions until the end of its next turn.

A creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower that fails this save won't willingly bite the target again while the spell lasts. Someone trying to make it do so must succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC each time.
Creatures that have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition or that lack a sense of taste are unaffected by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature or object for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Howling Chain

m.text: a length of platinum chain worth 500+ GP

entries: A howling, blood-red chain of force appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It can't move from that space, and it can lash out at creatures within 15 feet of it. The chain is an object with AC 18 and {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum; if it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends. {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} destroys it instantly.

When you cast the spell and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can have the chain lash one creature within 15 feet of it. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 4d8} Force damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and it must then succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
In addition, when a creature you can see leaves a space within 15 feet of the chain, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to have the chain lash it in the same way.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Hungry Gizzard
entries: A Large, pulsing gizzard of flesh seethes into being around a Medium or smaller creature you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the gizzard vanishes and the spell ends. On a failed save, the target is engulfed, and it takes {@damage 3d8} Bludgeoning damage plus {@damage 2d8} Acid damage. It takes this damage again at the start of each of its turns while it remains engulfed.

An engulfed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects originating outside the gizzard, and can't cast spells with a Somatic component. It can't otherwise leave the gizzard, except by cutting its way out.

The gizzard is an object that has AC 10 against attacks from outside and 50 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. An engulfed creature can attack the gizzard from inside (AC 12); if the gizzard takes 25 damage or more from inside, it bursts and the creature escapes, landing in the gizzard's space. The spell ends if the gizzard drops to 0 Hit Points or bursts, leaving behind a pool of blood and meaty chunks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Both types of damage increase by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Hunter's Mercy
entries: Your eyes glow red, and a pinpoint of light marks your quarry's weakest spot. Before the end of your turn, the next attack roll you make with a Longbow or Shortbow has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, and if it hits, it is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. If you don't make such an attack before the end of your turn, the spell is wasted.

spell.name: Hunters of Hades

components.m: a pinch of ash, plus a bloodstone worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes, if you call an ultroloth

entries: You call hunters from the gray wastes of the Lower Planes. Choose one of the following options; the creatures appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range:

items: Two {@creature Nycaloth|XMM|Nycaloths}, which must appear within 30 feet of each other.
One {@creature Ultroloth|XMM}.

entries: The fiends are allies to you and your allies, and no other effect can take control of them while the spell lasts. They understand your speech, regardless of language. In combat, they share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but they take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger.

You can command the fiends to hunt a creature you have seen or one you describe in detail. While hunting it, they have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB} and {@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to find and track it.
As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can dismiss any number of the fiends. Each one disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Hurl
entries: You touch a melee weapon that isn't being worn or carried by another creature. For the duration, the weapon has the {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, if it didn't already have it, and anyone can throw it whether or not it has the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property. Immediately after the weapon is thrown and the attack hits or misses, the weapon flies back to the thrower's hand, or hovers in the thrower's space until the end of its next turn if the thrower has no free hand, then falls to the ground.
The weapon returns only when thrown; it doesn't fly back if it is dropped or taken by another creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional weapon for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Hymn of Praise
entries: You sing a rousing hymn that empowers holy magic in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. For the duration, whenever a creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} casts a spell that restores Hit Points or deals Radiant damage, it can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the Hit Points restored to one target or to the Radiant damage dealt to one target.

In addition, Fiends and Undead in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the spells and Channel Divinity effects of creatures you chose.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The bonus die increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Hypothermia
entries: Deadly cold seeps into the body of a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 5d8} Cold damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level, which it loses when it finishes a Short or Long Rest. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Ice Axe

components.m: a shard of ice, glass, or crystal

entries: Shards of ice swirl down and coalesce into a jagged battleaxe in your free hand. It lasts for the duration. It counts as a Martial Melee weapon with which you have proficiency, and you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for its attack and damage rolls. On a hit, it deals Cold damage equal to {@damage 2d12} plus the ability modifier used for the attack roll.

The axe is nearly weightless, and you can't be forced to drop it. If you let go of it or use the hand for anything else, the axe disappears, but you can evoke it again in an empty hand as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases to {@damage 3d12} with a level 5-6 spell slot and to {@damage 4d12} with a level 7+ spell slot.

spell.name: Ice Claw

components.m: a white leather glove and a piece of clear rock crystal

entries: You create a Huge reptilian claw of glistening ice in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The claw lasts for the duration and moves at your command.

The claw is an object that has AC 20 and {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum. It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage and {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.
When you cast the spell and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your later turns, you can move the claw up to 60 feet and then cause one of the following effects:

items.name: Seize
entries: The claw attempts to grab a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take {@damage 4d8} Cold damage and have the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). While Grappled in this way, the target also has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The claw can grapple only one creature at a time, and it carries a Grappled creature with it when it moves.

items.name: Crush
entries: The claw squeezes the creature it is grappling, which takes Cold damage equal to {@damage 5d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
A creature Grappled by the claw also takes {@damage 1d8} Cold damage at the start of each of its turns.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of Crush increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|7-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Ice Flowers
entries: Moisture in the ground at a point you choose within range freezes and bursts violently through the surface, flinging ice shards and stones. The point must be on the ground; the spell has no effect if the point is on sand or bare, solid stone.

Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d6} Cold damage and {@damage 5d6} Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The ground in the area becomes a field of rubble and broken ice, which is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until cleared.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Cold damage and the Piercing damage each increase by {@scaledamage 5d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Ice Gauntlet
entries: Frost spreads over one of your hands, then hardens into a bristling ball of ice spikes around your fist. For the duration, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} with that hand deal {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage, and they deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Cold damage on a hit. You can't hold anything in that hand while the spell lasts.
If you fail a saving throw against an effect that deals Fire damage, the gauntlet melts and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Cold damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d4|1-9|1d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Icelance

m.text: a clear quartz gemstone worth 50+ GP

entries: You hurl a lance of ice at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Piercing damage and {@damage 2d6} Cold damage, and it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. Hit or miss, the lance then shatters.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Cold damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Illusory Feast
entries: A tantalizing feast appears to fill a 40-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area makes a Wisdom saving throw. The illusion assails every sense, so a creature doesn't need to see it to be affected. Constructs, Undead, and creatures that don't need to eat automatically succeed on the save.

On a failed save, a creature drops whatever it is holding and begins gorging on illusory food and drink, which to it looks, smells, and tastes like whatever it finds most appetizing. For the duration, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.
The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else takes an action to shake it out of its stupor.

spell.name: Illusory Pit
entries: You make the ground in a 40-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range appear to drop away into a bottomless chasm. Each creature in the area when you cast the spell makes a Wisdom saving throw. A creature also makes this save when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. Creatures that are flying are unaffected.

On a failed save, a creature believes it is plummeting into the pit. It has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0 as it claws desperately at the floor. At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the save, shaking off the illusion on a success.

If an affected creature takes damage, or if the spell ends while it is still affected, the illusion releases it, but the shock of its "landing" leaves it with the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Imbue Familiar with Spell Ability
entries: You touch your familiar (such as one summoned by {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}) and pour some of your spells into it. Choose up to three spells you have prepared that are each level 5 or lower and have a casting time of an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and expend a spell slot for each one as if you had cast it; the slot you expend determines the level at which the familiar casts that spell.

For the duration, your familiar can cast each imbued spell once, using the same type of action the spell normally requires, without expending a spell slot. It uses your spell save DC, spell attack modifier, and spellcasting ability, and it measures range and areas from itself. If an imbued spell requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, the familiar maintains it; it loses that Concentration if it would be broken or if the familiar drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If an imbued spell has a Material component, you must have that component on your person when the familiar casts it, and any component the spell consumes is consumed from your person.

When this spell ends, any imbued spells the familiar hasn't cast are lost, and you don't regain the slots spent on them. Inside an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB}, the familiar can't cast imbued spells, but it regains that ability when it leaves the field if this spell hasn't ended.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can imbue one additional spell for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Imperious Glare
entries: Motes of dark energy dance in your eyes as you fix your foes with a terrible glare. Choose up to six creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Constructs and Undead are unaffected. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or cower in terror: for the duration, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.
The spell ends on a target if it takes any damage. An affected target also repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Implacable Pursuer
entries: You attune your senses to one creature you can see within range. An unwilling target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become your quarry for the duration.

Whenever your quarry is on the move, you know its direction and distance from you, no matter how far away it is, as long as you are both on the same plane of existence. In combat, you learn this whenever it ends its turn more than 10 feet from where it started the turn. While it stays put, the spell tells you nothing. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to track your quarry.
