If your quarry leaves your plane, you learn which plane it went to, and the spell provides no further information until you and it are again on the same plane.

spell.name: Improved Portal Alarm

components.m: a small leather pouch containing three brass bells

entries: You ward a magic gate or portal within range. When you cast the spell, choose whether the alarm is mental, audible, or both. Each time a creature of Tiny size or larger passes through the portal, the alarm triggers. Ethereal and astral creatures trigger it too, and you can name a password that lets creatures pass without triggering it.

{@b Mental.} You are alerted while within 1 mile of the portal and on the same plane. You also receive a mental image of the creature that passed and the direction it went, as if you were standing 10 feet from the portal. You can instead touch another creature when you cast the spell; it receives the mental alarm in your place (an unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to resist).

{@b Audible.} The portal rings like a hand bell, clearly audible within 60 feet and faintly within 180 feet, even through closed doors and onto other planes. The ringing lasts 1 round. {@spell Silence|XPHB} blocks it.

spell.name: Improvisation
entries: You toss a pair of dice into the air and feel fate tilt in your favor. For the duration, you have a pool of four luck dice, which are d6s. Whenever you make an attack roll or an ability check, you can expend one luck die, roll it, and add the number rolled to the d20. You can do so after seeing the d20 roll but before knowing whether it succeeds. Any luck dice remaining when the spell ends are lost.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You gain one additional luck die for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Incite
entries: A spiral of sparkling motes swirls through a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range, urging those within to act now. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to bide its time for the duration. An affected creature immediately loses any action or spell it has readied (a readied spell is wasted), and it can't take the {@action Ready|XPHB} action until the spell ends.

spell.name: Incorporeal Enhancement
entries: Calling on negative energy, you bolster up to six Undead you can see within range that have the Incorporeal Movement trait. For the duration, each target gains the following benefits:

items: It gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. Any of them that remain when the spell ends are lost.
It gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class and attack rolls.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that turn Undead, such as a Cleric's Turn Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 3. With a level 6+ spell slot, the bonus to Armor Class and attack rolls becomes +2.

spell.name: Incorporeal Nova
entries: A silent nova of dissolution bursts in a 50-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range, tearing at immaterial bodies. Each creature in the area that has the Incorporeal Movement trait or is in a gaseous or mist form (such as a creature under the effect of {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB}) makes a Charisma saving throw. Other creatures are unaffected.

On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d8} Force damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this spell dissipates and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Infernal Threnody
entries: You strike up a low, pulsing dirge that wraps a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you in a faint red aura. For the duration, whenever a creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} casts a spell that deals Fire or Necrotic damage, it can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the Fire or Necrotic damage dealt to one target.

In addition, Celestials in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the spells and Channel Divinity effects of creatures you chose, and Fiends and Undead in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that turn them, such as a Cleric's Turn Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The bonus die increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Infernal Wound
entries: You touch a weapon, and it takes on a gray pallor. Until the spell ends, the first time on each turn that the weapon hits a creature that doesn't already have an infernal wound, the creature receives one. While wounded, the creature loses {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns.

The wound closes when the spell ends, after a spell restores Hit Points to the creature, or after the creature or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Hit Points lost increase by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Inferno
entries: You wreathe one creature you can see within range in roaring elemental flame. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d6} Fire damage and keeps burning. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only and the spell ends.

While the target burns, it takes Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The damage dwindles each time: {@damage 4d6} on its first turn, then {@damage 3d6}, {@damage 2d6}, and finally {@damage 1d6}, after which the spell ends.

The burning target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to put out the flames, making a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC; the burning target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this save if it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a success, the spell ends. The spell also ends if the target is fully immersed in water or if the flames are magically extinguished.
Flammable objects the target is wearing or carrying are destroyed if the target fails the initial save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Infestation of Maggots

components.m: a handful of dead, dried flies

entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target is infested with magical maggots that burrow into its flesh. Until the spell ends, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, and at the end of each of its turns it takes {@damage 2d10} Necrotic damage and then makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.

The infestation also ends if the target receives {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or any other magic that ends a disease or the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. Constructs and Undead are immune to this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d10|3-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Inhibit
entries: A spiral of dark motes surrounds one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be forced to hold back. On a failed save, the target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the start of its next turn, and its place in the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} order moves to immediately before yours. If the target hasn't yet taken its turn this round, it doesn't take a turn this round; it next acts immediately before your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Inky Cloud

components.m: a small vial of squid or octopus ink

entries: This spell works only underwater. Black ink billows out from you, filling a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on you. The cloud stays in place when you move, and its area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} can't see through it.
The cloud lasts for the duration, until a moderate current disperses it after 4 rounds, or until a strong current disperses it at the end of the turn it was created.

spell.name: Insidious Rhythm

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself casts a spell or makes an Intelligence check

entries: You hum a maddening ditty at the triggering creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or get the tune stuck in its head for the duration. The triggering spell or check is unaffected.

While the tune persists, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. In addition, whenever the target casts a spell, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or the spell fails and has no effect; the action is wasted, but any spell slot isn't expended.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.

spell.name: Insightful Feint
entries: With a chuckle and a whispered word, you read the tells of one creature you can see within range and set up a ruse. Before the end of this turn, the next attack roll you make against that creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. If that attack hits, the creature also can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the start of its next turn.

spell.name: Inspirational Boost
entries: You chant a short refrain that swells your next performance. The next time you give a creature a {@classFeature Bardic Inspiration|Bard|XPHB|1} die before the spell ends, that die is one size larger than normal (to a maximum of a d12), and when the creature rolls it, the creature also gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number rolled. The spell then ends.
If you don't have the Bardic Inspiration feature, this spell has no effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The spell affects one additional Bardic Inspiration die you give before it ends for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Instant Locksmith
entries: You point at a lock or mechanism within your reach and click your tongue, instantly grasping how it works. As part of casting this spell, you can make one Dexterity check to pick a lock or to disarm a trap or similar device within your reach. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check, and you count as having proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB} for it. You still need the tools if the task would normally require them.

spell.name: Instant Refuge

m.text: a concoction of fiend skin and rare herbs worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You lace hidden arcane triggers through your mind and body. When you cast the spell, name a destination you have visited, which can be on any plane of existence, and describe up to six conditions that trigger the spell, such as "when I drop below half my Hit Points" or "when I am {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}."

Immediately after one of those conditions first occurs, whether or not you want it to, you teleport to the named destination along with everything you are wearing or carrying, as long as no single object exceeds 50 pounds. Up to eight willing creatures you designated when you cast the spell can come with you if they are within 30 feet of you when it triggers. The teleportation has no chance of error, works even if you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, and can be stopped only by an effect that prevents teleportation or by an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB}.

When you arrive, the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions end on you. If the trigger was being reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you instead drop to 1 Hit Point and then teleport.
You can have only one Instant Refuge at a time. If you cast it again, the earlier one ends.

spell.name: Instant Search
entries: You point at a nearby spot and whistle, and its secrets leap out at you. As part of casting this spell, you can take the {@action Search|XPHB} action, focusing on a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check you make for it.

spell.name: Interplanar Telepathic Bond

components.m: pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures

entries: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures that can't communicate in any languages aren't affected by this spell.

Until the spell ends, the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language. The communication is possible over any distance and works across planes of existence.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you use a level 8+ spell slot, the duration is 24 hours.

spell.name: Iron Bones

components.m: a miniature skull made of iron or steel

entries: You touch an Undead that has a physical body, and its skeleton turns to iron for the duration. The target gains a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and loses any {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Bludgeoning damage. An unwilling target can make a Constitution saving throw to resist the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Undead for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Iron Silence
entries: You brush your hand over up to six suits of armor, which can be worn or unattended, and an orange sheen like grease settles into their joints. For the duration, a creature wearing one of these suits doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks because of the armor, provided it has training with that armor.

spell.name: Ironguts

components.m: a vial of diluted poison from four different creatures

entries: You touch a willing creature and fill its body with a magical antitoxin. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against poison and to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.
When the spell ends, the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn as the antitoxin leaves its system.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Ironthunder Horn
entries: The last words of your spell boom out in a deep, resonant roar. Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d6} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.
The boom is audible within 300 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Jagged Tooth
entries: Choose a willing creature you can see within range, and choose one of its natural weapons that deals Piercing or Slashing damage, such as a bite, claws, horns, or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} that deals Piercing or Slashing damage. Until the spell ends, the weapon's edges grow wickedly jagged. Attacks made with it deal an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the weapon's type, and they score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.
The spell ends early if you cast it again.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 5+ spell slot, attacks made with the weapon score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 18–20 on the {@dice d20}.

spell.name: Jaws of the Wolf

m.text: a wooden carving of a worg worth 25+ GP for each worg you create

entries: You toss small wooden carvings to the ground, and they swell into snarling worgs. Three {@creature Worg|XMM|Worgs} appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range.

The worgs are allies to you and your allies. In combat, the worgs share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but they take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger.

A worg that ends its turn more than 60 feet away from you, or that drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, shrinks back into a carving. When the spell ends, the remaining worgs become carvings again. A carving is destroyed if its worg dropped to 0 Hit Points.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You create one additional worg for every two spell slot levels above 4 (four worgs with a level 6 slot, five with a level 8 slot). You need a carving for each worg.

spell.name: Joyful Noise
entries: You stomp your foot, and a ripple of sound fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you for the duration. Any magical effect that prevents sound, such as the {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell, is suppressed within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}: sound can be created there normally, and creatures there can cast spells with Verbal components. The suppressed effect isn't dispelled and continues to function outside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

In addition, a creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} can't gain the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition from a spell or other magical effect, and if it already has that condition from such an effect, the condition is suppressed while the creature remains there.

spell.name: Jungle's Rapture
entries: You curse one creature you can see within range that isn't a Construct, Plant, or Undead. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be cursed as its flesh slowly hardens into wood. While cursed, the target has the following effects:

items: Its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet.

Its Dexterity score is reduced by {@dice 1d6} immediately, and by another {@dice 1d6} each time 24 hours pass. These reductions can't be undone while the curse lasts, even by magic that would otherwise restore the score.

If its Dexterity score is reduced to 0, the target transforms into an ordinary, nonmagical plant of roughly the same size and shape. In this form it has no Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma and is unaware of its surroundings.

entries: The curse can't be ended by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}. It ends if the target is affected by {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Wish|XPHB}, or {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} cast with a level 5+ spell slot. When the curse ends, the target's Dexterity score returns to normal, and a transformed target returns to its true form.

spell.name: Junglerazer

components.m: a pinch of ash from a burnt plant

entries: Silent, invisible blight surges from you in a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} in a direction you choose. Each Beast, Fey, and Plant in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d8} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Other creatures are unaffected.
Nonmagical plants in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that aren't creatures wither and crumble, leaving a path of ash.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Kelpstrand
entries: Long strands of wet kelp lash out from your outstretched hand. Choose up to two creatures you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart, and make a ranged spell attack against each one. On a hit, the target is wrapped in kelp and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC) for the duration. The kelp counts as the grappler, can't be attacked or moved, and doesn't move with you. A Huge or larger creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks to escape the kelp.

A creature can't be wrapped by more than one casting of this spell at a time. If you cast this spell while you are within 300 feet of an ocean or while you are in salt water, each creature wrapped by the kelp has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on checks to escape it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Kiss of the Vampire

m.text: a black onyx worth 50+ GP carved with the image of a fanged mouth

entries: You draw on the powers of unlife and take on the aspect of a vampire. Until the spell ends, you gain the following benefits and drawbacks.

items.name: Unliving Flesh.
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Necrotic, and Slashing damage.

items.name: Undead Nature.
entries: You count as Undead, in addition to your own creature type, for any effect that targets, detects, or treats creatures differently based on their type, such as a Cleric's Turn Undead.

items.name: Vampiric Kiss.
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, make a melee spell attack against one creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage, its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage it took, and you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half that damage. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. A target dies if this reduces its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum to 0. This has no effect on Constructs or Undead.

items.name: Dominating Gaze.
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose one Humanoid you can see within 30 feet of yourself. It makes a Wisdom saving throw, with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The {@condition Charmed|XPHB} creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you. When the charm ends, the creature knows it was {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you.

items.name: Mist Form.
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you shape-shift into a misty cloud and gain all the benefits and restrictions of the {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB} spell, except your {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is 20 feet. You return to your normal form when you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to do so, when you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, or when this spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Vampiric Kiss damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|7-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Knight's Move
entries: A glowing chessboard pattern flickers across the ground around you, and you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. The space must be within 5 feet of an enemy that is also within 5 feet of one of your allies who doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If there is no such space within range, the spell fails and the spell slot isn't expended.
The next melee attack roll you make against that enemy before the end of the current turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The distance you can teleport increases by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Know Greatest Enemy
entries: Your eyes flash green, and for the duration you can see auras of power around creatures. Whenever you can see a creature within a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you, you see a green nimbus around it whose intensity reveals its power relative to you, as shown in the Greatest Enemy table. A creature's power is its {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB}, or its level if it doesn't have one.

entries.caption: Greatest Enemy
rows: Half your level up to your level
Higher than your level up to double your level

entries: Among all the creatures in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that share an aura, you also know which one is the most powerful, though not why.
The spell can't evaluate a creature protected from Divination magic, such as by the {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} or {@spell Mind Blank|XPHB} spell; such a creature shows no aura.

spell.name: Know Opponent
entries: Glowing words appear above one creature you can see within range, describing its strengths and weaknesses. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you learn four facts about it. On a successful save, you learn only one.

For each fact, you choose whether to learn a strength or a weakness. If the target has more strengths or weaknesses than you learn, the DM reveals the most dangerous strengths and the most exploitable weaknesses first.

items.name: Strengths.
entries: A strength is one of the target's traits, actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, or Legendary Actions; one of the spells it can cast; or one of its damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}. You learn what it does in general terms, though not exact numbers.

items.name: Weaknesses.
entries: A weakness is one of the target's damage {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerabilities}, a trait that hinders it (such as Sunlight Sensitivity or a vulnerability to running water), the ability for which it has its lowest saving throw modifier, or a type of creature, object, or substance it is harmed or repelled by.
A creature protected from Divination magic, such as by the {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} or {@spell Mind Blank|XPHB} spell, is unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: On a failed save, you learn one additional fact for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Know Vulnerabilities
entries: Runes dance around the head of one creature you can see within range, red for its defenses and green for its weaknesses. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you learn the following about it:

items: Its damage {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerabilities}, {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}, and any condition {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}.
Any traits that protect it against magic or damage, such as Magic Resistance, Legendary Resistance (including how many uses remain), or Regeneration, and what, if anything, stops or bypasses them.
Which of the above, if any, come from spells or magic items currently affecting it.

entries: If the target has none of these, you learn that too. A creature protected from Divination magic, such as by the {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} or {@spell Mind Blank|XPHB} spell, is unaffected.

spell.name: Land Womb
entries: You and up to eight willing creatures sink into the earth, where a hidden chamber cradles you for the duration. You must be standing on soil, sand, mud, or similar loose earth (not stone or worked floors), and each of the other creatures must be touching you or another creature that is touching you when you cast the spell.

The ground swallows all of you, and you appear in a chamber 10 feet below the surface, just large enough to hold you all. The chamber has breathable air, its walls can't be damaged, and nothing can enter it from outside. While inside, you can't see or hear anything on the surface by nonmagical means, but you can cast spells and speak normally. Creatures in the chamber can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

Only you can leave the chamber, and only by ending the spell, which you can do as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When the spell ends, each creature in the chamber rises to the space it occupied when the spell was cast, or to the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

spell.name: Languor
entries: A thrumming blue ray lances toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target is sapped of strength for the duration: its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks, Strength saving throws, and attack rolls that use Strength.

A target hit by the ray must also succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become sluggish for the duration. A sluggish target takes a −2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws, and it can't take Reactions. On its turns, it can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, not both, and it can make only one attack if it takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action. The sluggish target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending that part of the spell on itself on a success.
If the target is affected by the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell, the ray instead ends {@spell Haste|XPHB} on it, and this spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4. Make a separate attack roll against each target.

spell.name: Launch Bolt

m.text: a crossbow bolt worth 1+ CP

entries: The crossbow bolt used in the spell's casting glows red and flies at a creature or object within range as if fired from a {@item Light Crossbow|XPHB}. Make a ranged attack with the bolt, using your spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of Dexterity. You are considered proficient with the attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} Piercing damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
Any magical properties of the bolt apply to the attack, and the bolt can be recovered afterward like ammunition fired from a crossbow.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The attack deals extra Force damage when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 1d6}), 11 ({@damage 2d6}), and 17 ({@damage 3d6}).

spell.name: Launch Item
entries: You hurl a Tiny object you're holding that weighs no more than 10 pounds, and it streaks away in an orange glow. It lands at a point you can see within range, or you can send it into the free hand of a willing creature there, who can catch it.

If the object is one that is thrown to create an effect, such as {@item Acid|XPHB}, {@item Alchemist's Fire|XPHB}, {@item Holy Water|XPHB}, or a flask of {@item Oil|XPHB}, you can instead use it on a target within this spell's range, as if you had thrown it within the object's normal range. If the effect calls for a saving throw, you can use your spell save DC in place of the object's DC.

spell.name: Lay of the Land
entries: A nimbus of green light surrounds you, and a map of the surrounding land unfolds in your mind as if penned by a cartographer. You learn the location of each major landmark within 50 miles of you, such as rivers, lakes, mountains, forests, roads, and settlements of at least hamlet size, along with the direction and distance to each from your current location. You also gain a general sense of the terrain within that area, such as where it is hilly, swampy, or impassable to travel.

The map shows only the land's features as they currently stand. It reveals nothing about creatures, traps, hidden or magically concealed places, or other hazards along a route. You remember the map as clearly as if you had studied it.

spell.name: Dragon Ally

m.text: gems, coins, or art objects worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You call out to a true dragon, offering a taste of treasure. A Young dragon of Challenge Rating 8 or lower (a {@creature Young White Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Young Brass Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Young Black Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Young Copper Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Young Green Dragon|XMM}, or {@creature Young Bronze Dragon|XMM}) appears in an unoccupied space within range. You can name the kind of dragon you want (such as a {@creature Young Bronze Dragon|XMM}) when you cast the spell, though you might get a different one (DM's choice).

When the dragon appears, it is under no compulsion to behave a particular way. You can ask it to perform one task in exchange for payment. The task could range from simple (fly us across the chasm, or help us fight a battle) to complex (spy on our enemies, or protect us during our foray into the dungeon). You must be able to communicate with the dragon to bargain for its services, and the bargaining takes at least 1 round, so the dragon doesn't act on the turn it arrives.

The dragon demands payment in coins, gems, art objects, or magic items it can add to its hoard, and the payment must be made before it begins the task. A task lasting up to 10 minutes requires a payment worth 100 GP × the dragon's {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB}. A task lasting up to 8 hours requires 500 GP × its Challenge Rating. A task measured in days (up to 10 days) requires 1,000 GP × its Challenge Rating for each day. An especially hazardous task might require up to twice that amount. Unlike other called creatures, a dragon never accepts less than these amounts, even for a task it would enjoy, and it rarely accepts a task that seems suicidal.

After the dragon completes the task, or when the agreed-upon duration of service expires, it returns to the place it was called from, after reporting back to you if possible. If you can't agree on a price, the dragon leaves immediately, and it might remember the slight.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the dragon can instead be a Young dragon of any kind or an Adult dragon of Challenge Rating 14 or lower (an {@creature Adult White Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Adult Brass Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Adult Black Dragon|XMM}, or {@creature Adult Copper Dragon|XMM}), and the material component must be worth 1,000+ GP.

With a level 9 spell slot, the dragon can be a Young or Adult dragon of any kind, such as an {@creature Adult Red Dragon|XMM} or {@creature Adult Gold Dragon|XMM}, and the material component must be worth 2,500+ GP.

spell.name: Energized Shield
entries: You touch a Shield, and a silver aura surrounds it before it appears to transform into pure energy. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. For the duration, the creature bearing the Shield has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to damage of the chosen type. In addition, once on each of its turns when the bearer hits a creature with a melee attack, including an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} made by bashing with the Shield, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the chosen type.
A Shield can be affected by only one {@spell Energized Shield|SpellCompendium} spell at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Holy Transformation
entries: Holy energy courses through you, wrapping you in a faint golden aura as you take on the semblance of a winged celestial guardian. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your creature type is Celestial, and your size becomes Medium if it was Small.
You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you can speak and understand Celestial.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 5+ spell slot, the duration increases to 10 minutes. With a level 7+ spell slot, you also gain the following benefits:

items: You gain 40 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. Any of them that remain when the spell ends are lost.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution checks, and you gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws other than Strength and Constitution.
You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage, and to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by Fiends and Undead.
Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} can deal Radiant damage equal to {@damage 1d8} plus your Strength modifier.
Fiends and Undead within 10 feet of you subtract {@dice 1d4} from their attack rolls and saving throws.

spell.name: Infernal Transformation
entries: Your blood runs cold as unholy power twists you into the semblance of a bearded devil, a nest of barbed, snaky tendrils sprouting from your jaw. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your creature type is Fiend, and your size becomes Medium if it was Small.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet, and you can speak and understand Infernal.

When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack with your beard as part of that action. It is an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} that deals Piercing damage equal to {@damage 1d8} plus your Strength modifier. A creature hit by the beard must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. While Poisoned in this way, it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 5+ spell slot, the duration increases to 10 minutes. With a level 7+ spell slot, you also gain the following benefits:

items: Your size becomes Large if there is room for you to grow.
You gain 40 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. Any of them that remain when the spell ends are lost.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution checks, and you gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws other than Strength and Constitution.
You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage, and to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Radiant damage dealt by Celestials.

You grow a stinging tail and can make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} with it, which deal Piercing damage equal to {@damage 1d8} plus your Strength modifier and have the same poison as your beard.
Celestials within 10 feet of you subtract {@dice 1d4} from their attack rolls and saving throws.

spell.name: Ironguard

components.m: a tiny shield of wood, glass, or crystal

entries: You touch a willing creature, whose skin takes on a pale, translucent look. Until the spell ends, the target gains the following benefits.

Metal passes through the target harmlessly. It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage dealt by nonmagical weapons and ammunition whose striking part is metal, and by other nonmagical metal objects. Any poison or other substance coating such a weapon still affects the target as if the weapon had hit.

The target can move through metal objects and barriers, such as iron bars and metal doors, as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. If the spell ends while the target is inside a metal object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, and both it and the object take {@damage 1d6} Force damage.
When the target makes an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against a creature wearing nonmagical metal armor, that armor provides no bonus to the creature's AC.
Magic metal weapons, ammunition, and objects affect the target normally.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 7+ spell slot, the spell also protects against magic metal: the target's {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} and ability to pass through metal extend to magic metal weapons, ammunition, and objects, and its Unarmed Strikes ignore magic metal armor. Casting the spell this way requires a nugget of adamantine worth 100+ GP as an additional material component.

spell.name: Lesser Orb
entries: You hurl an orb of energy at a creature within range. Choose Acid, Cold, Lightning, Fire, or Thunder for the type of orb, then make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} damage of the chosen type and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer the effect for that type in the table below.

rows: The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.
The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
The target can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The target catches fire, taking an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage at the start of its next turn.
The target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. The orb's cacophony can be heard 100 feet away.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Planar Exchange
entries: You call a creature to your precise location and trade places with it. Choose a {@creature Brown Bear|XMM}, {@creature Griffon|XMM}, {@creature Ape|XMM}, or {@creature Tiger|XMM} (or a stronger creature if you use a higher-level spell slot), which appears in your space (the spell fails if the creature wouldn't fit there). At the same instant, you are transported to the creature's home plane, where you exist in stasis for the duration. To onlookers, it appears you have transformed into the creature.

You have full control over the creature's actions and perceive through its senses. It uses the chosen stat block, but it can't cast spells that summon creatures or use abilities that summon creatures. While in stasis, you can't take any actions other than controlling the creature or dismissing the spell, and nothing on that plane can affect you. When the spell ends or you dismiss it, you appear in the creature's space, and it returns to its home plane.

If the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, you take {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage (3d6 with a level 6–7 spell slot, 4d6 with a level 8+ spell slot), the spell ends, and you return to the space last occupied by the creature.

If you use a level 4 or 5 spell slot, the creature gains the Celestial or Fiend type (your choice) and the following traits: resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and, if Celestial, resistance to Acid, Cold, and Lightning damage, or if Fiend, resistance to Acid and Fire damage. Once per turn, when it hits with an attack, it can deal extra Radiant (Celestial) or Necrotic (Fiend) damage equal to its Challenge Rating.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can choose a stronger creature, which doesn't gain the Celestial or Fiend traits:

items: {@b Level 6–7 Slot.} A {@creature Couatl|XMM} or a {@creature Barlgura|XMM}.
{@b Level 8–9 Slot.} A {@creature Barbed Devil|XMM} or a {@creature Hezrou|XMM}.

spell.name: Lesser Spell Immunity
entries: You touch a willing creature and choose one spell of level 2 or lower. For the duration, the target is immune to that specific spell, including similar effects from creatures' innate spellcasting, but not to supernatural or extraordinary abilities such as breath weapons. Only a specific spell is protected against, not a school or group of similar spells. A creature can benefit from only one casting of this spell at a time.

spell.name: Spell Matrix

m.text: a piece of amber worth 500+ GP

entries: You prepare a magical matrix that can hold one spell for later use. Until the end of your next turn, you can cast one spell of level 3 or lower that has a casting time of an action or bonus action; instead of taking effect, it is stored in the matrix, and its slot is expended. The matrix closes at the end of that turn whether or not you stored a spell. You take {@damage 1d6} Force damage when you cast this spell, and your Hit Point maximum is reduced by the damage taken until the matrix ends.

While the matrix holds a spell, you can cast it as a Bonus Action, and it is then gone. If the matrix is successfully targeted by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, the stored spell is lost. Inside an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB}, the matrix is suspended and its duration is paused. If you die, the matrix and spell fade harmlessly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 7 or 8 spell slot, the matrix can hold two spells: for 2 turns, you can cast and store spells as described above, and the matrix closes after those 2 turns even if it isn't full. You take {@damage 2d6} Force damage instead. If both stored spells are level 2 or lower, you can link them into a sequence and cast both as a single Bonus Action. The material component must be a sapphire worth 1,000+ GP.

With a level 9 spell slot, the matrix can hold three spells stored over 3 turns, and you take {@damage 3d6} Force damage instead. You can link two stored spells of level 2 or lower into a sequence cast together. When you cast this spell, you can also designate one stored spell or sequence that affects only you (such as {@spell Levitate|XPHB} or {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB}) to trigger when a condition you describe occurs. The condition must be clear, though it can be general. When it occurs, the designated spell takes effect immediately, requiring no action, and you can't choose to prevent it. The material component must be a diamond worth 1,500+ GP.

spell.name: Lesser Telepathic Bond
entries: You forge a telepathic link between yourself and one willing creature within range that has an Intelligence of 6 or higher. For the duration, you can communicate telepathically through the link regardless of language, over any distance (but not across planes). The link grants no other power or influence.

spell.name: Visage of the Deity
entries: You take on a hint of divine or infernal power. Choose a celestial aspect or a fiendish aspect. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks for the duration, and you gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, and Lightning damage (celestial aspect) or to Cold and Fire damage (fiendish aspect).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 6+ spell slot, you also gain these benefits for the duration: {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet; {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells. In addition, once during the duration, when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can deal an extra {@damage 6d8} Radiant damage (celestial aspect) or Necrotic damage (fiendish aspect) to it.

With a level 9 spell slot, the duration is 1 hour, and you gain the level 6 benefits plus the following: your creature type changes to Celestial (celestial aspect) or Fiend (fiendish aspect), and if you die in this form, you can still be returned to life; your Armor Class increases by 1; your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} range is 120 feet; and your Strength, Constitution, Wisdom, and Charisma scores become 19 if they are lower. You also gain the following, based on your aspect:

items: {@b Celestial Aspect.} You grow feathered wings and gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to twice your Speed, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and to disease.

{@b Fiendish Aspect.} You grow batlike wings and gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your Speed, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and to disease. You also gain claws and a bite; when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can replace any attack with a claw ({@damage 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier Slashing damage) or a bite ({@damage 2d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier Piercing damage).

spell.name: Life Bolt
entries: You draw on your own life force to hurl up to three golden rays of positive energy. You can hurl them at one Undead within range or at several. You lose 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for each ray you create, and this loss can't be reduced in any way.
Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d10} Radiant damage. The rays have no effect on creatures that aren't Undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Life Ward
entries: You touch a creature, and a cloak of crawling shadows swirls across its body. An unwilling target can make a Wisdom saving throw to resist the spell. For the duration, the target has the following traits:

items: It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage.
It can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from spells or other magical effects.

It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that turn Undead, such as a Cleric's {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Cleric|XPHB|2|XPHB} or a Paladin's {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Paladin|XPHB|3|XPHB}.

spell.name: Life's Grace
entries: You touch a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, and symbols of warding flow across its body before sinking into it. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits:

items: It has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.
Its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and ability scores can't be reduced.
It can't be killed outright by a magical effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage.
It is immune to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition from Undead, and it can't contract a disease or be cursed by an Undead's attack or trait.
Undead that can move through creatures and objects, such as ghosts and specters, have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against it.

spell.name: Light of Lunia
entries: You begin to glow with the silver light of Lunia, the first layer of the Seven Heavens of Mount Celestia. For the duration, you shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

Starting on your next turn, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to expend some of that radiance as a ray of light aimed at a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage, or {@damage 4d6} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.

After you fire the first ray, your light shrinks to Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. You can fire a second ray on the same turn or a later one; doing so quenches your light and ends the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1, or by 2d6 against a Fiend or an Undead.

spell.name: Light of Mercuria
entries: You begin to glow with the golden light of Mercuria, the second layer of the Seven Heavens of Mount Celestia. For the duration, you shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

Starting on your next turn, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to expend some of that radiance as a ray of light aimed at a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Radiant damage, or {@damage 6d6} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.

After you fire the first ray, your light shrinks to Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. You can fire a second ray on the same turn or a later one; doing so quenches your light and ends the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2, or by 2d6 against a Fiend or an Undead.

spell.name: Light of Venya
entries: You begin to glow with the soft, pearly light of Venya, the third layer of the Seven Heavens of Mount Celestia. For the duration, you shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.

Starting on your next turn, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to expend some of that radiance as a ray of light aimed at a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d6} Radiant damage, or {@damage 8d6} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.

Alternatively, you can aim the ray at a willing creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead. No attack roll is needed; the creature instead regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 4d6} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

After you fire the first ray, your light shrinks to Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. You can fire a second ray on the same turn or a later one; doing so quenches your light and ends the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3, or by 2d6 against a Fiend or an Undead. The healing also increases by {@dice 1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Lightfoot
entries: Your steps become quick and weightless. For the duration, your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and you can move through the space of any hostile creature, treating that space as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. You can't end your move in another creature's space.

spell.name: Lightning Ring

components.m: a small glass ring and a bit of fur from any animal

entries: A ring of crackling lightning whirls around you for the duration. It doesn't hinder your movement, your spellcasting, or attacks made by or against you. While the ring persists, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Lightning damage.

At the start of each of your turns, each other creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

In addition, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your turns to hurl two bolts of lightning from the ring, each a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} pointing in a direction you choose. Each creature in a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in both {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}s makes only one saving throw but takes the damage from each bolt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of the ring and of each bolt increases by 1d6 when you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot.

spell.name: Lion's Charge
entries: A nimbus of golden energy shaped like a lion surrounds you until the end of your current turn. Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet, and opportunity attacks against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature this turn and then take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make one additional attack against that creature as part of that action. If that additional attack hits a Large or smaller creature, the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

spell.name: Lion's Roar
entries: You unleash a roar as loud as a falling mountain. Choose any number of creatures in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you to be your enemies and any number to be your allies.

Each enemy makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 8d8} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

Each ally gains {@dice 4d8} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and, for the next minute, has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by 1d8 and the Temporary Hit Points increase by 1d8 when you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot.

spell.name: Lionheart

components.m: a hair from a lion's mane

entries: A willing creature you touch is filled with unshakable courage. If the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, the condition ends. Until the spell ends, the target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Listening Coin
entries: You touch two coins, turning one into an {@condition Invisible|XPHB} sensor and the other into a receiver. You can then hand the sensor coin to another creature, openly or covertly, or leave it somewhere.

While you hold the receiver coin to your ear, you can hear through the sensor coin as if you were in its space. If the sensor coin is inside a pocket, pouch, sack, or similar container, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks to hear through it.
The coins work at any distance but fall silent while they are on different planes of existence. The spell ends early if you cast it again.

spell.name: Listening Lorecall
entries: Your hearing sharpens to supernatural keenness. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing, and you have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 15 feet.

The {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} relies on hearing, so it doesn't function while you have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition or are in an area of magical silence, such as that created by the {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The range of the {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} increases by 15 feet for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Lively Step
entries: Beating a marching rhythm, you exhort your companions onward. You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you gain the following benefits for the duration:

items: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.
Your overland travel pace is treated as one step faster (Slow becomes Normal, and Normal becomes Fast), without the usual drawbacks of the faster pace.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid gaining {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels from travel.

entries: The spell ends for a creature if it makes an attack roll, casts a spell, deals damage, or takes any action other than {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Dodge|XPHB}.

spell.name: Living Prints
entries: Your eyes glow green, and you see tracks as if they had just been made. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks made to follow tracks, and you ignore any penalty or increase to the DC of such checks caused by the passage of time, rainfall, snow, or similar weather.
The spell has no effect on tracks more than 30 days old.

spell.name: Living Undeath
entries: A willing creature you touch takes on the sallow, rotting look of a zombie as its vital processes are temporarily suspended. It isn't actually Undead. For the duration, the target gains the following effects:

items: Any {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against it becomes a normal hit.
It has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.
It doesn't need to breathe.
It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.

spell.name: Love's Lament
entries: A dirgelike melody fills a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, reminding those who hear it of lost loves and life's disappointments. Each creature in the Cone makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d6} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute as grief sickens it. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A creature that can't hear automatically succeeds on the save.
A {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Low-Light Vision
entries: You pass your hand over the eyes of a willing creature, and its pupils become speckled with starlight. For the duration, the target can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within 120 feet of it as if it were {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, so such areas aren't {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} for it. This doesn't let it see in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.
If the target already has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, the range of its {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} instead increases by 30 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Loyal Vassal
entries: Glowing silver runes encircle the heads of up to three willing creatures you touch, then fade. For the duration, each target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

In addition, a target can't be magically compelled to harm you or another target of this spell, whether the compulsion began before or after you cast the spell. If an effect such as the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition or the {@spell Command|XPHB}, {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}, or {@spell Dominate Person|XPHB} spell would force it to do so, the target ignores that command, and if the effect allows a saving throw to end it, the target can immediately make that save.
The spell ends for a target if it willingly deals damage to you or to another target of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Lucent Lance

components.m: a clear glass or crystal rod

entries: The light around you coalesces into a needle-sharp lance of radiance. You can't cast this spell if your space is in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}.

Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes Radiant damage based on the light in your space: {@damage 8d8} if your space is in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, or {@damage 8d6} if it is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. The target also has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn, and for 1 minute after that it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight.
Hit or miss, the lance's light counts as sunlight for the target until the end of its next turn, which affects traits such as Sunlight Sensitivity.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by 1d8 (in Bright Light) or 1d6 (in Dim Light) for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Luminous Gaze
entries: Your eyes blaze with unearthly radiance for the duration, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet.

When a creature other than you starts its turn in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you and can see you, it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is dazzled until the start of its next turn: it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight. Creatures that can't see, including those with the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition, are unaffected.

spell.name: Lunar Beam
entries: A swath of pale moonlight springs from your hand, filling a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you with {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} for the duration. The light counts as moonlight, not sunlight, so it doesn't trigger Sunlight Sensitivity or similar traits. At the start of each of your turns, you can change the direction the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} points (no action required). The light isn't blocked or suppressed by magical {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} created by a spell of level 2 or lower, such as {@spell Darkness|XPHB}, though it doesn't end that spell.

A lycanthrope in its Humanoid form that is in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} when it appears, that enters it for the first time on a turn, or that ends its turn there must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or immediately shape-shift into its beast or hybrid form (your choice). A lycanthrope in one of those forms can't shape-shift back to its Humanoid form while it's in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} unless it succeeds on this save. A lycanthrope that succeeds on this save is unaffected by your castings of this spell for 24 hours.

spell.name: Maddening Scream
entries: Speaking an incomprehensible word, you touch a creature with a hand wrapped in black magic. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target is driven to screaming lunacy for {@dice 1d4 + 1} rounds; roll the duration when you hit. A creature that can't gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition is unaffected.

Until the effect ends, the target can't take actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions, and on each of its turns it must use all its movement to race about caterwauling in a random direction (roll a {@dice d8} to choose the direction) unless something prevents it from moving. Attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, it automatically fails Dexterity saving throws, and it gains no benefit from a Shield.

spell.name: Maddening Whispers
entries: Your muttered words burrow into the minds of your foes. Choose up to six creatures you can see within range, then choose one of the following effects. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it suffers the chosen effect for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

items.name: Hysteria.
entries: The target falls into uncontrollable laughing or weeping. It has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, and on its turn it can do nothing but move.

items.name: Panic.
entries: The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and must take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action and move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns. If it has nowhere to move, it cowers and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until it can move away.

items.name: Violent Hallucinations.
entries: The target perceives every creature around it as a dangerous enemy. On each of its turns, it must move toward the nearest creature it can see and use its action to make a melee attack against it, or, if no creature is in reach after moving, take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action toward the nearest one. It can't cast spells or take Reactions.

items.name: Stupor.
entries: The target curls up, oblivious to its surroundings. It has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions.

spell.name: Magic Miasma

components.m: a small piece of quilted cloth soaked in water

entries: A thick, sparkling cloud of mist fills a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. The area is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} and {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and attack rolls made by creatures inside it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. The cloud lasts for the duration; wind, even a strong one, doesn't disperse it.
The mist saps magic. A creature inside the cloud is {@i sapped}, which has the following effects:

items: Its spell attack rolls have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
Creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against its spells.
It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entries: When a creature enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it remains sapped for the duration even after it leaves the cloud. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

spell.name: Make Manifest
entries: You reach across the planar boundary and drag a creature into your world. Choose one creature within range that is in the Border Ethereal or the Shadowfell in the location corresponding to a point within range, and whose presence there you can perceive or know about; this spell doesn't reveal such creatures. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or appear, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, on your plane in the space corresponding to its location, or in the nearest unoccupied space. If you are in the Border Ethereal or the Shadowfell, you can instead pull a creature from the plane it borders to your plane.

For the duration, the target can't leave your plane by any means, including spells, magic items, and features such as a ghost's Etherealness, though it otherwise keeps all its abilities, including the ability to move through creatures and objects. When the spell ends, the target returns to the plane it came from, even if it is no longer within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4. Alternatively, with a level 6+ spell slot, you can instead pull every creature and every object that isn't being worn or carried in the Border Ethereal or the Shadowfell location corresponding to a 25-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range; these creatures get no saving throw.

spell.name: Malevolent Miasma
entries: You click the stones together, and a gray fog shot through with dark streaks bursts in a 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range, then dissipates. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Holding one's breath offers no protection. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can choose to leave it {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} and Stable instead of dying.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Mantle of the Icy Soul

m.text: a pinch of sapphire dust worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a creature, and its body turns an icy blue as the cold seeps into its soul. An unwilling target can resist with a successful Constitution saving throw. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage and {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage.
If the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage, it instead loses that Resistance or Immunity for the duration and gains no Immunity to Cold damage.

spell.name: Manyjaws
entries: You conjure six pairs of disembodied jaws made of blue force, which float around you for the duration.

When you cast the spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can send one or two of the jaws streaking toward creatures you can see within range. Each pair of jaws targets one creature, and you can send both pairs at the same creature. Each targeted creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} Force damage from each pair that targeted it on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature targeted by two pairs makes only one save against both.
A pair of jaws vanishes after it attacks. The spell ends early if you have no jaws left.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You conjure two additional pairs of jaws for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Mark of the Hunter

components.m: a bit of skin or bone from a creature of the target's kind

entries: You point at one creature you can see within range and mark it with a glowing rune that only you can see. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be marked for the duration.
While the target is marked, you gain the following benefits against it:

items: Your attack rolls against the target ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and Three-Quarters Cover.

The rune limns the target for you. You can see it while it is within 120 feet of you even if it is {@condition Invisible|XPHB} or in a {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} area, provided it doesn't have Total Cover from you, and it can't take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action to hide from you.
Your weapon attacks against the target score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB} or {@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks you make to find the target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Your {@status Concentration|XPHB} can last longer with a spell slot of level 4 (up to 8 hours) or 5+ (up to 24 hours).

spell.name: Mark of the Outcast
entries: You invoke an ancient anathema on one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be marked with a dull purple splotch in the shape of a skull on its face (or another prominent part of its body if it has no face). The mark is visible to anyone who can see the target, including with {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}.
While marked, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB} and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks, and its Armor Class is reduced by 1.
The mark is a curse. It lasts until it is dispelled or ended by {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, or {@spell Wish|XPHB}.

spell.name: Marked Object

components.m: an object owned by the creature you wish to track, or a piece of that creature such as a tuft of hair or a fingernail

entries: You hold the spell's material component to your nose and become attuned to the creature that owns it (or that it came from). A creature owns an object if it was the last creature other than you to carry the object for 24 hours or more.

For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks made to track that creature or to find evidence of its passage, and you can tell whether any tracks, scents, or traces you examine were left by it.
The spell doesn't reveal the creature's identity or location, and it doesn't create a trail where none exists.

spell.name: Mass Awaken

m.text: an agate worth 1,000+ GP for each target, which the spell consumes

entries: You spend the casting time tracing magical pathways within precious gemstones. Choose up to five targets within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. All targets must be of the same kind, and each must be either a {@filter Beast|bestiary|type=beast|intelligence=[0;3]|miscellaneous=!swarm} or {@filter Plant|bestiary|type=plant|intelligence=[0;3]|miscellaneous=!swarm} creature with an Intelligence of 3 or less or a natural plant that isn't a creature.

Each target gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. A natural plant becomes a Plant creature and gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth, and it gains senses similar to a human's. The DM chooses statistics appropriate for each awakened Plant, such as the statistics for the {@creature Awakened Shrub|XMM} or {@creature Awakened Tree|XMM}.

Each awakened target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 30 days or until you or your allies deal damage to it. When that condition ends, the awakened creature chooses its attitude toward you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target two additional creatures for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Mass Contagion
entries: A swirling red-and-black mist rises in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Choose one ability when you cast the spell. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, a target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

A {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If it succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on it. If it fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it.

Whenever a target {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} by this spell receives an effect that would end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition doesn't end on it.

spell.name: Mass Darkvision

components.m: a dried carrot or three small agates

entries: For the duration, up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 150 feet.

spell.name: Mass Death Ward
entries: Choose up to ten creatures within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Until the spell ends, the first time a target would drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it instead drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}, and the spell ends on it.
If the spell is still in effect on a target when it is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends on it.

spell.name: Mass Fire Shield
