components.m: a bit of phosphorus or a firefly

entries: Wispy flames wreathe up to six willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range. For the duration, each target sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

For each target, choose a warm shield or a chill shield. The warm shield grants {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage, and the chill shield grants {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage.

In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of a target hits that target with a melee attack roll, the target's shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage from a warm shield or {@damage 2d8} Cold damage from a chill shield.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Mass Mage Armor
entries: Choose up to five willing creatures within range who aren't wearing armor; each glows briefly with a silver aura. Until the spell ends, each target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early on a target if it dons armor.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Mass Restoration
entries: Choose up to six creatures that you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. You can end one of the following effects on each target: one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}; the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition; a curse, including the target's attunement to a cursed magic item; any reduction to one of the target's ability scores; or any effect reducing the target's Hit Point maximum.

spell.name: Mass Sanctuary
entries: Choose up to six creatures within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. Until the spell ends, any creature that targets a warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect a warded creature from area effects. The spell ends for a warded creature if it makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.

spell.name: Mass Shield of Faith

components.m: a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it

entries: Choose up to six creatures you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. A shimmering field surrounds each target, granting it a +2 bonus to Armor Class for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Mass Snake's Swiftness
entries: Choose up to six allies in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. For the duration, each target's Speed increases by 10 feet, and each has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.

spell.name: Master Air

components.m: a wing feather from any bird or the wing bone of a bat

entries: You sprout a pair of insubstantial wings, feathery or batlike (your choice). For the duration, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet.

When the spell ends while you are aloft, the magic fades slowly: for {@dice 1d6} rounds, you descend 60 feet at the start of each of your turns and take no damage if you land during that time. If you're still aloft after that, you fall (see {@hazard Falling|XPHB}).

spell.name: Master Earth
entries: You sink into the ground beneath you and travel through the earth to a destination of your choice on the same plane of existence, emerging there instantly along with whatever you are wearing and carrying. You must be standing on earth or stone to cast this spell. There is no limit to the distance you can travel.

You need only picture the destination. If you don't picture an exact location, you emerge at the edge of the general area you have in mind. You always emerge on the surface, in an unoccupied space on solid ground, and never become trapped within the earth; if your destination can't be reached, the earth carries you as close to it as it can. Structures built underground don't hinder your travel as long as you can pass around them.
The spell fails if you cast it anywhere other than the Material Plane.

spell.name: Master's Touch

components.m: the weapon or Shield you want to wield

entries: You hold a weapon or Shield and command it to obey you. For the duration, you have proficiency with that specific item (for a Shield, you have training with it). The proficiency applies only to that particular item, not to others of the same kind.

If you stop holding the item, you keep the proficiency with it for the duration and regain its use if you pick it up again. You can benefit from multiple castings of this spell at once, each on a different item.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 2+ spell slot, the duration is 8 hours.

spell.name: Maw of Chaos
entries: The air within range splits open into a yawning, mouthlike rift of roiling blue-green energy that fills a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose. The area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

Each creature in the Sphere when it appears makes a Wisdom saving throw. A creature also makes this save when it enters the Sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 10d10} damage of a type determined by rolling on the table below, and until the start of its next turn, it can't take Reactions and can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. Roll a new damage type each time the Sphere deals damage.

The chaotic energy also makes focusing difficult. A creature in the Sphere other than you that casts a spell must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, or the spell fails and the action is wasted, though any spell slot isn't expended. Creatures in the Sphere also have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

spell.name: Maw of Stone
entries: You animate one natural cave mouth or tunnel opening up to 20 feet in diameter, or one natural cavern chamber that fits within a 50-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}, that you can see within range. The stone sprouts a jagged maw. It can't move, but it can attack.

When you cast the spell, decide which creatures the maw attacks: all creatures, creatures of a particular kind, or creatures meeting a circumstance you specify (such as trying to leave or touching a particular object). You and creatures you designate when you cast the spell are never attacked. Only one Maw of Stone can affect a given opening or chamber at a time.

items.name: Opening
entries: When a creature the maw can attack tries to move into or through the opening, the maw makes a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have its movement end and be pushed back to the space it last occupied outside the opening.

items.name: Chamber
entries: When a creature the maw can attack enters the chamber for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, the maw makes a melee spell attack against it. On a hit, the creature takes {@damage 5d10} Bludgeoning damage.

The maw attacks a creature no more than once per turn. The animated stone is an object with AC 17 and 60 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and it has a {@variantrule Damage Threshold|XPHB} of 10. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Mechanus Mind
entries: You touch a willing creature, and its thoughts settle into the cold, ordered precision of Mechanus. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits and drawback:

items: The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks.
The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Memory Rot
entries: You blow a cloud of glowing yellow spores at one creature you can see within range. The spores burrow toward its brain. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on this save.

On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 6d10} Psychic damage, and the spores infest it for the duration. While infested, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws, and it takes {@damage 2d10} Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns, after which it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
On a successful save, the target takes half as much initial damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d10|5-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Mesmerizing Glare
entries: Your eyes glow with a warm, enrapturing light. Choose up to three Humanoids you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Each target that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, a target stares blankly at you and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.

The spell ends for a target if it takes any damage, if it can no longer see you, or if someone else takes an action to shake it out of its stupor. An affected target also repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Metal Melt

components.m: a drop of mercury in a vial

entries: Choose one nonmagical metal object you can see within range that weighs 50 pounds or less, or a 5-foot-{@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} portion of a larger nonmagical metal object. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to protect it, and the spell has no effect on a success.

The metal flows like water for the duration without changing temperature, then hardens again, usually into a shapeless puddle. A melted object is destroyed; armor melted while worn slides off its wearer, and a melted weapon or Shield can no longer be used. A melted lock, hinge, or bar no longer holds anything shut.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The weight limit increases by 50 pounds for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Miasma
entries: You hiss out a red mist that streaks toward one creature you can see within range and forces its way into the creature's mouth and nose. A creature that doesn't need to breathe is unaffected. Otherwise, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or begin choking on the unbreathable gas.

While choking, the target can't breathe or speak, can't cast spells that have a Verbal component, and can't use a breath weapon or any other ability that requires breathing or speech. It can otherwise act normally.

A choking target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. If it succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends. If it fails three of these saves, the target drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} as it suffocates, and the spell ends. The successes and failures don't need to be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind.

spell.name: Miasma of Entropy
entries: A red mist billows from you, causing rapid decay. Choose one of the following effects:

items.name: Cloud of Rot
entries: Each nonmagical object made of wood, leather, paper, cloth, or other once-living organic matter that weighs 10 pounds or less in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} rots into a slimy, pulpy, useless mass. A creature wearing or carrying such objects can make a Dexterity saving throw to protect them; on a success, the creature's objects are unaffected. In addition, each Plant creature in the Cone makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Focused Decay
entries: One nonmagical object of once-living organic matter that weighs 100 pounds or less, or a 10-foot-{@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} portion of a larger such object, that you can see within 30 feet of you rots away. If the object is worn or carried, its owner can make a Dexterity saving throw to protect it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Necrotic damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Mind Poison
entries: You touch a creature and infect it with a poison that saps its willpower. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 5d8} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for the duration. While {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom saving throws and Wisdom checks. On a successful save, the spell ends with no effect.

The {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 2d8} Poison damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on it. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Mindless Rage

components.m: a scarlet handkerchief, waved toward the target

entries: Choose a creature within range that can see you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be filled with a rage that focuses it entirely on fighting you in melee. For the duration, the affected target is bound by the following rules:

items: It can't make attack rolls against any creature other than you.
It can't make ranged attacks, cast spells, or take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

If it starts its turn within reach of you, it must take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action against you using a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike. Otherwise, it must use its movement to approach you by the most direct safe route and, if it ends that movement within reach of you, take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action against you.
It doesn't knowingly move into obviously harmful terrain, such as off a cliff or into a fire, to reach you.

entries: The target can otherwise use its normal melee abilities, Bonus Actions, and Reactions, and it can't end the spell by closing its eyes or otherwise breaking line of sight on purpose. The spell ends early if the target can't see you at the end of its turn or if you are more than 120 feet from it. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.
If the target has the Rage class feature and at least one use of it remaining when it fails the save, it immediately enters its Rage, expending a use.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. Each target must be able to see you, and each can attack only you.

spell.name: Minor Disguise
entries: You make minor cosmetic changes to your appearance for the duration, such as adding color to your hair, painting wrinkles or a scar on your face, or darkening your teeth. The changes are real rather than illusory, so they hold up to physical inspection, but they can't alter the structure of your features or body.
The next ability check you make before the spell ends to create a disguise, to pass yourself off as someone else, or with a {@item Disguise Kit|XPHB} has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

spell.name: Miser's Envy
entries: Choose a creature and an object within range. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be consumed by greed for that object for the duration. Dragons have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on this save.

While the affected creature doesn't have the object, it uses its movement on each of its turns to approach the object and uses its action to pick the object up, or, if another creature is holding or wearing it, to attack that creature or otherwise try to take the object.

Once the affected creature has the object, it guards it jealously, attacking any creature that moves within 30 feet of it or that otherwise appears to be trying to take the object. If no creature approaches within 30 feet or seems interested in the object, the affected creature can act normally.
At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. The spell also ends if the object is destroyed.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. All targets crave the same object.

spell.name: Moment of Clarity
entries: You touch a creature and lift the weight pressing on its mind. Choose one effect on the creature that is giving it the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, or another effect that alters its mind and that allowed a saving throw to resist it. The creature immediately repeats the saving throw against that effect with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the effect didn't allow a saving throw, this spell has no effect on it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Monstrous Thrall
entries: One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Unlike {@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB}, taking damage doesn't let the target repeat the save, and the spell doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

You have a telepathic link with the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "{@action Attack|XPHB} that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. You can command the target to take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} but must take your own {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to do so.

When you order the target to do something deeply against its nature (as determined by the DM), it can make a Wisdom saving throw with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. On a success, it refuses that order but remains your thrall. Thereafter, it makes saves against that same order without {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
You can have only one thrall from this spell at a time. If you cast it again on another creature, the spell ends on your previous thrall.

spell.name: Moon Blade

components.m: a small candy made with wintergreen oil

entries: You call a 3-foot, swordlike beam of moonlight into your free hand. It lasts for the duration. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, but you can evoke it again as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The blade sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

The blade counts as a Simple Melee weapon with which you are proficient. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make melee attacks with it, using your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack roll. On a hit, the blade leaves no visible wound and deals {@damage 2d8} Radiant damage, without adding an ability modifier, or {@damage 4d8} Radiant damage if the target is Undead.

A creature hit by the blade has its magic scrambled until the end of its next turn. During that time, whenever it casts a spell, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, or the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by 1d8 (2d8 against Undead) for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Moon Bolt
entries: You call a bolt of shimmering moonlight that streaks unerringly at one creature within range, or splits to strike two creatures within range that are within 15 feet of each other. Constructs are unaffected. Each target makes a saving throw, depending on what it is:

items.name: Living Creature
entries: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 5d8} Radiant damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength-based {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

items.name: Undead
entries: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. Afterward, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and Wisdom saving throws for 1 minute. On a successful save, nothing happens.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Moon Lust

m.text: a silver ingot worth 5+ GP

entries: You extol the beauty of the moon in a dead language, and a silver-white glow briefly surrounds a creature you can see within range. A creature that can't see is unaffected. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

On a failed save, the target becomes obsessed with the moon, staring at it or picturing it in its mind, and has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. The spell also ends on the target if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it out of its stupor.

On a successful save, the target is dazzled instead: it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks until the end of its next turn, and the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Moon Path
entries: Pale moonlight shapes itself into a railless stair or bridge of glowing, translucent force, connecting two points within range. The path is up to 150 feet long, and its width is 3 to 20 feet, as you decide; you can vary the width along its length. It needs no supports and holds fast to its endpoints, even in midair. The path must be straight and continuous when it forms; if any creature or object would interrupt its surface, the spell fails. A bridge must be level, and a stair can't rise or descend more steeply than 45 degrees.

The path is immune to all damage and blocks spells, breath weapons, gaze effects, and ethereal travel, but teleportation can bypass it. {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} can end the spell. A {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell blasts a 10-foot-square gap in the path without destroying the rest.

When you cast the spell, choose up to six creatures. While a chosen creature is on the path, it can't fall or be moved off the path against its will, and any creature that targets it with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. If any chosen creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell that targets an enemy, or deals damage, this protection ends for all chosen creatures, though the path remains.

spell.name: Moonbow
entries: You conjure three glowing motes of electricity that hover around you. When you cast the spell and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can send any number of the remaining motes at one or more targets within range. Make a ranged spell attack for each mote. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d6} Lightning damage.
The spell ends when no motes remain or if you end a turn after the one on which you cast it without having sent a mote.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You create one additional mote for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Moonfire
entries: A cone of fiery white moonlight springs from your hand. Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} originating from you makes a Dexterity saving throw, feeling an unnatural chill. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 12d8} Radiant damage, or {@damage 20d8} Radiant damage if it is Undead or a shape-shifter (a creature that has a trait or action that lets it change form, or that is currently shape-shifted). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

In addition, each creature or object in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that is disguised, shape-shifted, or polymorphed (as with {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} or {@spell Polymorph|XPHB}) must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or immediately return to its true form and be unable to change form or disguise itself again until the spell ends. Even on a success, a ghostly white outline of its true form clings to it for the duration, revealing that form to anyone who can see it.

For the duration, the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} glows with silver-white {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}, and each magical creature or object in it at the time of casting sheds a faint blue glow that reveals it as magical. The glow also smothers lightning: whenever a creature or object would deal Lightning damage to a target in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}, or a Lightning effect originates in or passes through it, the creature creating the effect must succeed on an ability check using its spellcasting ability (or Constitution, if it has none) against your spell save DC, or the Lightning damage is negated.

spell.name: Mountain Stance
entries: You touch a creature and fill it with the stubborn might of elemental earth. Until the spell ends, while the target isn't moving and isn't flying or swimming, it can root itself to the ground (no action required). While rooted, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws made to avoid being moved against its will, knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}, lifted, or {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. Any effect that would push or pull it against its will moves it only half as far, rounded down to the nearest 5 feet.
If the target is moved against its will while rooted, the spell ends. Voluntary movement doesn't end the spell; the target simply uproots and can root itself again when it stops.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Murderous Mist
entries: You exhale a cloud of scalding steam: a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} spreads around corners and is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as that created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}) disperses it.

When a creature enters the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 4d8} Fire damage and has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition. A creature Blinded in this way makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
The {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Nature's Avatar
entries: You touch a Beast and fill it with the fury of the wild. For the duration, the target gains the following benefits: it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls, its damage rolls with attacks deal an extra 5 damage, it gains {@dice 60} {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, its Speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains one additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.
The Temporary Hit Points are lost when the spell ends.

spell.name: Nature's Balance
entries: Choose Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. You touch a willing creature and transfer vigor to it. Your score in the chosen ability decreases by 4 (to a minimum of 3), and the target's score in that ability increases by 4 (to a maximum of 22) for the duration. You can't avoid the loss, but the target can decline the gain.
You can end the spell early by touching the target again, and it ends if you or the target drops to 0 Hit Points. When it ends, both scores return to normal.

spell.name: Nature's Favor
entries: You touch a Beast and grant it the favor of luck. For the duration, the target adds {@dice 1d4} to its attack rolls and its damage rolls.

spell.name: Nature's Rampart

m.text: a small quartz gem engraved with a tiny castle

entries: You shape natural terrain in a 40-foot square within range into a defensive position. Artificial structures and features aren't affected. The effect depends on the terrain:

items.name: Open Outdoor Site.
items.entry: A 5-foot-high, 5-foot-thick rampart of earth rises along the perimeter, behind a 5-foot-wide, 5-foot-deep ditch. Creatures behind the rampart have Half Cover. A creature climbing the rampart from the ditch must spend 15 extra feet of movement.

items.name: Rough Outdoor Site or Cavern.
items.entry: Stones, boulders, dead wood, and briars form a 5-foot-high, 2-foot-thick wall around the perimeter. Creatures behind it have Half Cover.

items.name: Marshy or Low-Lying Site.
items.entry: Instead of a wall, a 10-foot-wide, 5-foot-deep water-filled ditch is created around the perimeter. It is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and creatures in it can't use the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

spell.name: Naturewatch
entries: For the duration, you sense the vitality of plants and animals in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that you create when you cast the spell and can move as you move (the cone points in the direction you face). You know the number and location of living and dead Beasts and Plants in the cone, and for each one whether it is healthy, wounded, or near death.

You also learn mundane details about them, such as whether a plant is dehydrated or diseased, or whether an animal is malnourished, poisoned, or pregnant. The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

spell.name: Nauseating Breath

components.m: a piece of fish at least one day old

entries: You breathe out a {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} of nauseating vapors. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute and can't take actions until the end of its next turn. A poisoned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

spell.name: Negative Energy Aura
entries: A 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of deathly energy surrounds you. Until the spell ends, a living creature other than you takes {@damage 4d8} Necrotic damage when it enters the Emanation for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there (no saving throw). An Undead creature in the Emanation instead regains {@dice 1d8} Hit Points when it starts its turn there. Creatures immune to Necrotic damage aren't affected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage and healing increase by {@scaledamage 4d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Nerveskitter

time.condition: which you take when you or an ally you can see within range is about to roll Initiative

entries: You sharpen the reflexes of a creature you can see within range that is about to roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}. The target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the roll.

spell.name: Net of Shadows
entries: Choose up to three creatures within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw (a willing creature can choose to fail). On a failed save, shifting shadows coat the creature for the duration. Attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, but it can't see anything more than 5 feet away (Darkvision doesn't help), and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against creatures more than 5 feet away.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Night's Caress
entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 8d8} Necrotic damage and makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it also gains 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

If the target is an Undead, it takes no damage and doesn't gain Exhaustion, but it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (repeating the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Nightmare Lullaby
entries: A lulling, discordant song drags a creature you can see within range into a waking nightmare. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, at the start of each of its turns for the duration it rolls {@dice 1d4}: on a 1, it uses all its movement to move in a random direction and takes no action; on a 2 or 3, it takes no action, bonus action, or movement; on a 4, it acts normally. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Nightshield
entries: You are warded against harm. For the duration, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws, which increases to +2 if you cast this spell using a level 3 or 4 spell slot, and to +3 if you use a level 5 or higher slot. In addition, you are immune to the {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} spell.

spell.name: Nightstalker's Transformation

m.text: a potion of any kind, which you drink

entries: You become a shadowy predator. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws, and you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.
You have proficiency with simple weapons and with the Hand Crossbow, Rapier, and Shortsword.
When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with a {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} or ranged weapon and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll, or an ally of yours is within 5 feet of the target and doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, the attack deals an extra {@damage 3d6} damage.

entries: While the spell lasts, you can't cast spells (including from magic items), and you can't use other features that require casting a spell.

spell.name: Nimbus of Light
entries: A nimbus of light surrounds you, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. The light grows stronger the longer it is held.

Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to fling the nimbus at a creature you can see within 30 feet, ending the spell. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes Radiant damage: {@damage 2d8} if the spell has lasted less than 1 minute, {@damage 3d8} if 1 minute or more, or {@damage 4d8} if 10 minutes or more.

spell.name: Nixie's Grace

components.m: a lock of a nixie's hair, freely given to you by a nixie

entries: The fey grace of a nixie fills you. For the duration, you gain a Swim Speed of 30 feet, you can breathe underwater, you have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 60 feet, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't made with cold iron. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity and Charisma checks and saving throws, and on Wisdom saving throws.

spell.name: Obedient Avalanche
entries: You call down an avalanche of snow centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 14d8} Bludgeoning damage plus {@damage 6d6} Cold damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (buried). On a success, it takes half as much damage and isn't Restrained. A Restrained creature can use an action to make a DC 20 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check to free itself, and another creature can free it by spending 1 minute digging.

Each creature in the 20-foot band surrounding that Sphere also makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes half the Bludgeoning and Cold damage, is pushed 20 feet away from the center, and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a success, it takes no damage.

The whole 40-foot-radius area becomes covered in snow, which is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and lasts as long as ordinary snow. The avalanche uproots small trees and vegetation, deals {@damage 6d10} Bludgeoning damage to structures, and extinguishes all nonmagical flames and any magical flames it touches.

spell.name: Omen of Peril

m.text: a set of marked sticks, bones, or similar tokens

entries: You assess your surroundings and intended path and receive one of three visions about the next hour of your journey: {@i safety} (no significant monsters, traps, or challenges), {@i peril} (a challenge typical of an adventure), or {@i great danger} (powerful foes or deadly traps that put your life at grave risk).

The DM secretly rolls a {@dice d100}. On a 1-80, the vision is accurate; otherwise it is one of the two incorrect results, chosen at random, and you don't know it is wrong. The form of the vision reflects your faith or nature, such as a white dove, a dark cloud, or a forest fire for a druid. Unlike {@spell Augury|XPHB}, this spell answers no specific question.

spell.name: One Mind
entries: You strengthen your mental bond with your steed (a mount you have bonded with, such as one conjured by {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}). For the duration, while you are mounted on it, your link sharpens your senses: you and the mount can communicate telepathically, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks, and you have a keen sense of smell, giving you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell. The spell ends if the mount is ever more than 10 feet from you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 2+ spell slot, you and the mount also gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls while you are mounted. Using a level 3+ spell slot, you also gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with melee attacks while mounted.

spell.name: One with the Land
entries: You forge a strong link with nature. For the duration, you gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}), Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}), Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}), and Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

spell.name: Ooze Puppet
entries: You telekinetically seize an Ooze you can see within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you control it for the duration: on each of your turns, you can use a Bonus Action to mentally command it to move and take actions as you see fit, within its abilities. If you give no command, telekinetic force holds it immobile. If you lose sight of the ooze, or you and it are on different planes, the spell ends.
If a controlled ooze splits (such as from being damaged), you retain control of only one of the resulting oozes, chosen at random.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 7 slot, the duration is 8 hours. With a level 8 slot or higher, the duration is 24 hours. In either case, you still must concentrate.

spell.name: Opalescent Glare
entries: Your eyes blaze with the deadly radiance of a celestial gaze. Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (repeating the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success), and if it is evil and has 40 Hit Points or fewer, it dies.
On a successful save, an evil creature with 40 Hit Points or fewer is still Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

spell.name: Otyugh Swarm
entries: You call forth otyughs from a large heap of filth, such as a sewer or cesspool within range. You must be within range of at least 6,000 pounds of sewage, refuse, or offal, and {@dice 1d4+2} {@creature Otyugh|XMM|Otyughs} burst from it in unoccupied spaces within range. Each otyugh has the maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for its stat block.

The otyughs are allies to you and your allies. In combat, they share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger. If you command them to guard a specific site, they can't move more than 120 feet away from it.
As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can dismiss any number of the otyughs you can see. Each otyugh disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Owl's Insight
entries: You touch a willing creature and grant it the keen insight of an owl. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws, and it can't be Surprised.

spell.name: Panacea
entries: You channel positive energy into a creature you touch to wipe away its afflictions. The target regains {@dice 3d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and the spell ends on it every one of the following effects: the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions; one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}; and any one disease, curse, or effect that is putting it to sleep or reducing an ability score or its Hit Point maximum is also ended.

If the target is an Undead, it instead makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one, and the spell has no other effect on it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing and the damage increase by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Pavilion of Grandeur
entries: You conjure an extradimensional pavilion, a grand tent decorated in the colors of your faith, whose single entrance is a shimmering opening 10 feet wide and 15 feet tall in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The pavilion contains up to fifty 10-foot Cubes of space, and you choose the lighting (from dark to bright) and a temperature between 40 and 90 degrees Fahrenheit. It is sumptuously furnished and holds a full meal for up to 24 creatures.

Only creatures you designate can enter. The entrance is invisible and shut from the inside once creatures have passed through, and you can open it again from the inside at will. Any creature that spends 1 hour dining in the pavilion gains the benefits of {@spell Heroes' Feast|XPHB}. While in the pavilion, a creature that finishes a Short Rest can treat each Hit Point Die it spends as its maximum roll.
When the spell ends, any creatures still inside are expelled into the nearest unoccupied spaces outside the entrance.

spell.name: Persistent Blade
entries: You create a spectral dagger of force in an unoccupied space within range. When you cast the spell, and as a Bonus Action on each of your later turns, you can move the dagger up to 40 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} Force damage. The dagger can't be attacked, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on its attack roll if one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Phantasmal Assailants
entries: You create phantasmal images of nightmare creatures in the mind of one creature you can see within range; only you can see them, as shadowy shapes. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the phantasms strike it, and it takes {@damage 4d6} Psychic damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target recognizes the images as unreal and the spell has no effect. Constructs and Undead are immune to this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Phantasmal Decoy
entries: You sift through the subconscious of one creature you can see within range and create a phantasmal image of its most hated enemy, visible only to you and the target. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you choose a space within range for the phantasm to appear to occupy. On each of its turns, the target must move toward the phantasm by the most direct safe route and then use its action to attack it. If moving to the phantasm would take the target through dangerous terrain, it moves as close as it can and takes no further action until the phantasm moves to a space it can reach.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the phantasm up to 60 feet in any direction; it ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Each time the target attacks the phantasm, it repeats the saving throw, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Phantasmal Disorientation
entries: You twist the senses of one creature you can see within range so it can't tell true landmarks from false ones. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, whenever the target moves on its turn, it moves in a direction 90 degrees to the left or right (determined randomly) of its intended direction, and it can't target creatures with ranged attacks or ranged spells. The target doesn't realize it is headed the wrong way until it meaningfully interacts with its environment (such as by making an attack or opening a door).

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. The spell affects only the direction of movement and ranged attacks; the target can otherwise act normally, including making melee attacks and casting spells that target only itself or touch.

spell.name: Phantasmal Thief
entries: An invisible, mindless, shapeless force comes into being at a point you choose within range. While the spell lasts, you can direct it (no action required) to steal an object. It can take an unattended object, or an object from a creature that isn't wielding or wearing it, as long as the object weighs no more than 10 pounds and isn't in a locked container. It can even take objects from a bag. The force has a {@skill Stealth|XPHB} bonus equal to your spellcasting ability modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. If a creature notices the force (a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC), it fails to steal that turn but can try again on the next.

The force needs one of your turns to take an object and another to bring it to you; it can hold only one object at a time, and the object turns invisible while held. Alternatively, it can take an object from a creature's grasp: the creature makes a Strength saving throw, and on a failed save the force takes the item, then vanishes after bringing it to you. The force can't be harmed, but {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} ends it.

spell.name: Phantom Bear
entries: You conjure an incorporeal Huge bear with a fearsome roar in an unoccupied space within range. Use the {@creature Polar Bear|XMM} stat block, with these changes: it is a Monstrosity, has a Fly Speed of 60 feet, AC 19, and {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 150, resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant, immunity to {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, and it can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} (taking 5 Force damage if it ends its turn inside one). Its attacks use your spell attack modifier, and each hit deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Cold damage.

Recharge 5-6, as an action the bear lets out a roar. Each creature of your choice within 120 feet of it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature within 30 feet has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute, and any other creature has it until the end of its next turn.

The bear is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your mental commands (no action required by you) while within range, and the spell ends if the bear is ever outside the spell's range. If you issue no commands, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action. The bear disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Phantom Foe

m.text: a tiny pewter figure of a warrior

entries: You touch a creature, which makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, an illusory double of whichever creature threatens the target and that the target deems most dangerous forms in its mind, changing as the target perceives a more dangerous threat. The target can't tell the phantom from the real creature. While the spell lasts, each time the target makes an attack roll against the creature the phantom duplicates, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the roll, and attack rolls made by that creature against the target have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} (the target believes it is flanked). Other creatures can't see the phantom. The spell ends if no creature threatens the target at the start of its turn.

spell.name: Phantom Stag
entries: You conjure a Large, quasi-real stag with a black body, sharp silvery antlers, and silent, smoky hooves in an unoccupied space within range. It is a Large Beast that uses the {@creature Giant Elk|XMM} stat block, with these changes: its AC is 17, it has {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 40 plus 10 for each spell slot level above 5, its Speed is 90 feet, it ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} from natural undergrowth, rubble, or mud, and its attacks use your spell attack modifier. It can bear you or a creature you designate as a rider; it has no saddle or bridle but responds to its rider's balance and nudges. It acts as a controlled mount, and it disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points, when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action, or when the spell ends.
Its antler attack deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage, and when it moves 20 feet in a straight line toward a creature and hits with the attack, it deals an additional {@damage 1d8}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: If you cast this with a spell slot of level 7 or higher, the stag gains a Fly Speed of 90 feet. If you cast it with a level 9 slot, its antlers count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity, and as a Magic action it can carry its rider into the Border Ethereal as with {@spell Etherealness|XPHB} for up to 1 hour.

spell.name: Phantom Threat
entries: You make one creature you can see within range feel threatened by more foes than it actually faces. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the first attack roll made against it on each turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, as if it were flanked, even if no other creature threatens it. No amount of convincing helps; the target can't be freed from the effect except by a successful save. A creature that can't be flanked is unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Phantom Wolf
entries: You conjure an incorporeal white wolf with abnormally large, frosty jaws in an unoccupied space within range. Use the {@creature Winter Wolf|XMM} stat block, with these changes: it is a Monstrosity, AC 18, {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 100, resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant, immunity to {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, and it can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} (taking 5 Force damage if it ends its turn inside one). Its attacks use your spell attack modifier, and its bite deals an extra {@damage 4d6} Cold damage.

The wolf is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your mental commands (no action required by you) while within range, and you needn't see it once the spell is cast. If you issue no commands, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action. The spell ends if the wolf is ever outside the spell's range; the wolf disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Plague of Rats
entries: You summon two {@creature Swarm of Rats|XMM|Swarms of Rats} in unoccupied spaces within range. Each swarm must appear adjacent to at least one other swarm, and a swarm can share a space with another creature. You don't control the swarms: each attacks any creature in its space, or if none, pursues the nearest creature as best it can. Each swarm disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You summon one additional swarm for each spell slot level above 5 (to a maximum of six swarms).

spell.name: Planar Bubble
entries: You touch a willing creature, and a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that moves with it emulates the native planar environment of the touched creature. The area has the gravity, temperature, atmosphere, and magical properties of that plane (for example, a creature native to the Material Plane has normal gravity, temperature, and magic within the bubble, no matter what plane it is on). Creatures in the Emanation are unaffected by the harmful environmental effects of the plane they are in, such as extreme heat, cold, or toxic atmosphere, and traits of the plane that alter spellcasting don't apply to spells cast in the Emanation.

spell.name: Planar Tolerance
entries: You touch a willing creature and ward it against the hazards of other planes. For the duration, the target is unaffected by harmful planar environmental effects such as extreme heat or cold, a toxic atmosphere, or oppressive gravity, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that originate from planar traits.

spell.name: Plant Body
entries: You imbue yourself with transformative magic and take on some characteristics of the Plant type. For the duration, any spell or effect that affects Plants also affects you. You have immunity to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions, you can't be put to sleep, and attack rolls against you can't be Critical Hits. Your ability scores and skills are unaffected.

spell.name: Poison Thorns
entries: Thorns sprout from your skin and weep poison. For the duration, a creature that hits you with a melee attack, or that starts its turn grappling you, takes {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage and makes a Constitution saving throw (once per turn per creature). On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn; on a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned.

spell.name: Poison Vines
entries: Poisonous vines erupt from the ground in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. For the duration, the area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the creature also has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn.
You and up to five other creatures you choose when you cast the spell are immune to the vines' effects.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Portal Alarm
entries: You ward a magic gate or portal within range. When you cast the spell, choose whether the alarm is mental or audible. Each time a creature of Tiny size or larger passes through the warded portal, the alarm triggers.

{@b Mental.} You (and only you) are alerted while within 1 mile of the portal and on the same plane. The alert is a mental tremor that wakes you from ordinary sleep but doesn't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB}. {@spell Silence|XPHB} doesn't affect it.

{@b Audible.} The portal rings like a hand bell, clearly audible within 60 feet and faintly within 180 feet, even through closed doors and onto other planes. The ringing lasts 1 round. {@spell Silence|XPHB} blocks it.
Ethereal and astral creatures trigger the alarm. When you cast the spell, you can name a password; creatures that speak it before passing through don't trigger the alarm.

spell.name: Portal Beacon
entries: You alter a magic gate or portal within range so that it sends out a mental beacon. Choose up to six creatures known to you (you can include yourself); they needn't be present. For the duration, each chosen creature knows the direction and distance to the portal. A creature that travels to a plane other than the two the portal connects stops being affected, but the spell continues for the others.

spell.name: Positive Energy Aura
entries: A 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of life-giving energy radiates from you. Until the spell ends, at the start of each of your turns, each creature of your choice in the aura (other than you) that isn't an Undead or a Construct regains {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, and each Undead creature in the aura takes {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage. Creatures immune to Radiant damage take no damage from the aura. The emanation moves with you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 1d6|4-9|1d6} and the damage by {@scaledamage 2d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Primal Form
entries: You take on the form of a Medium elemental. Choose air, earth, fire, or water when you cast the spell. For the duration, you gain 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, and when a creature scores a Critical Hit against you, roll {@dice 1d4}: on a 1, it's a normal hit instead. You can't cast spells, and your equipment melds into your form and can't be used.
You also gain a benefit based on your chosen element:

items: {@b Air.} You have a Fly Speed of 30 feet and can hover.
{@b Earth.} You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
{@b Fire.} You have Resistance to Fire damage, and a creature that hits you with a melee attack or starts its turn within 5 feet of you takes {@damage 1d4} Fire damage.
{@b Water.} You have a Swim Speed of 60 feet and can breathe water.

spell.name: Prismatic Eye
entries: You create a floating, visible orb of rainbow light in an unoccupied space within range. For the duration, you can use a Bonus Action to move the eye up to 30 feet (it can't leave the spell's range) and have it fire one ray at a creature within 60 feet of it. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the ray's color, rerolling any color already used and any result of 8. Each color can be used only once; after all seven rays are fired, the eye remains but can fire no more.

items: {@b 1, Red.} {@damage 8d6} Fire damage.
{@b 2, Orange.} {@damage 8d6} Acid damage.
{@b 3, Yellow.} {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage.
{@b 4, Green.} {@damage 8d6} Poison damage.
{@b 5, Blue.} {@damage 8d6} Cold damage.
{@b 6, Indigo.} The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.
{@b 7, Violet.} The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entries: The eye has AC 18 and 9 hit points, and the spell ends if it drops to 0 hit points. It uses your saving throw bonuses.

spell.name: Prismatic Ray
entries: You fire a ray of shifting color at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, roll {@dice 1d8} (rerolling any result of 8) to determine the color of the ray. If the target has 50 hit points or fewer, it also has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

items: {@b 1, Red.} {@damage 8d6} Fire damage.
{@b 2, Orange.} {@damage 8d6} Acid damage.
{@b 3, Yellow.} {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage.
{@b 4, Green.} {@damage 8d6} Poison damage.
{@b 5, Blue.} {@damage 8d6} Cold damage.
{@b 6, Indigo.} The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
{@b 7, Violet.} The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of the first five colors increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Probe Thoughts
entries: You target one creature you can see within range that has a mind. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw; a creature can choose to fail. On a failed save, all of the target's memories and knowledge are open to you. Until the spell ends, you can use your action to ask the target one question, to the best of the target's knowledge, and it telepathically imparts the answer to your mind. You and the target needn't share a language; less intelligent creatures might respond only with images. The target isn't aware its mind is being probed unless you wish it to be. The spell ends if the target moves beyond the range.

spell.name: Programmed Amnesia

m.text: a set of small crystal lenses set in gold loops

entries: You reshape the memories and personality of one creature you can see within range that is willing or is {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw; a willing creature can choose to fail. On a failed save, you gain access to its thoughts and memories and can apply any of the following effects in any combination:

items: {@b Memory Erasure.} Erase up to one week of the target's memories, including knowledge of specific events, people, or places.
{@b Memory Implant.} Create false memories, such as friendship with a hated enemy or events that never happened.
{@b Persona Rebuilding.} Erase the target's personality and implant a new set of memories, altering its alignment, beliefs, values, and personality traits.

{@b Programmed Trigger.} Delay any effect above until a specific event occurs, such as receiving a coded message or arriving at a location. You can also specify an event that ends some or all of the alterations.

entries: A target given new memories might suspect they are false if the programming leaves obvious gaps; for example, an unexplained sudden change of belief. If it investigates and finds evidence, the DM can allow it to make a new saving throw. The effect can't be ended by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, but {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Wish|XPHB}, or a trigger you specified ends it.

spell.name: Protection from Positive and Negative Energy
entries: You touch a willing creature and choose Necrotic or Radiant. For the duration, it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to damage of the chosen type, plus an additional benefit:

items: {@b Necrotic.} Its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum can't be reduced.
{@b Radiant.} It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that deal Radiant damage.

spell.name: Protégé
entries: You touch a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or higher and briefly grant it a measure of bardic talent. For the duration, the creature has a number of Bardic Inspiration dice (d6s) equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1). As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, it can give one of these dice to another creature within 60 feet that can hear it, using the rules of the Bard's Bardic Inspiration feature. Unused dice vanish when the spell ends. The spell grants no spellcasting ability.

spell.name: Puppeteer
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is forced to mimic your actions. On each of your turns, the target uses its movement to match your movement as closely as it can, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and on Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws. Its motions look awkward, and creatures that watch can tell it is being controlled with a successful DC 10 Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check (DC 15 if you aren't visible).

The target repeats its save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success. If you make the target do something suicidal or obviously self-destructive, it repeats the save immediately. If it succeeds, the spell ends and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. The target gains none of your special abilities or spellcasting, even if you use them.

spell.name: Quick March
entries: Choose a point within range. Each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point has its Speed increased by 30 feet until the end of your next turn. The increase doesn't apply to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim speeds.

spell.name: Quick Potion
entries: You touch a flask of water and attune it to hold a spell. For the duration, you or another spellcaster can use an action to cast a spell of level 3 or lower into the flask, expending the slot as normal. The spell must be one that could target a single creature or the caster. The water becomes a potion of that spell: a creature can drink it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to be affected as if targeted by the spell, using the original caster's spell save DC and spellcasting ability modifier, and with the spell's duration starting when it drinks. The potion loses its potency after 1 hour. A creature can't be affected by potions of this kind more than once at a time.

spell.name: Quill Blast
entries: You unleash a spray of quills in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save is also lodged with quills and takes a -1 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the quills are removed. A creature can remove the quills from itself or another creature within reach as an action with a successful DC 15 Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check; otherwise, removing them deals {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Quillfire
entries: Poisonous quills sprout from your hand. Until the spell ends, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a melee or ranged spell attack with them against a creature within 30 feet. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} Piercing damage and makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Radiant Assault

components.m: an eye from a Celestial, Fey, Fiend, or Elemental of Challenge Rating 3 or higher

entries: A multitude of rainbow-colored beams erupts in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the area that isn't {@condition Blinded|XPHB} makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 10d6} Radiant damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d6|7-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Raging Flame
entries: You inflame existing fire within a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. For the duration, nonmagical fires in the area burn twice as hot and twice as bright: their bright and dim light radii double, and a creature that takes Fire damage from them takes double damage. A nonmagical fire affected by the spell also burns out in half the usual time. When a creature in the area takes Fire damage from a spell, it takes 1 extra Fire damage for each damage die rolled. Fires that leave the area remain affected.

spell.name: Rainbow Beam

m.text: a small clear gem or crystal prism worth at least 10 gp

entries: You fire a beam of prismatic light at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Roll {@dice 1d6} to determine the damage type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning; 5, Thunder; 6, roll again twice (rerolling any 6) and divide the damage evenly between the two types.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Rainbow Blast

m.text: a small clear gem or crystal prism worth at least 50 gp

entries: A wide-spectrum blast of prismatic energy shoots from you in a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d10} Acid damage, {@damage 1d10} Cold damage, {@damage 1d10} Fire damage, {@damage 1d10} Lightning damage, and {@damage 1d10} Thunder damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Apply Resistance and Immunity separately to each damage type.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: One damage roll of your choice increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Raise from the Deep
entries: Choose one creature or object of Gargantuan size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution saving throw to resist. For the duration, the target is magically buoyant and floats on the surface of water regardless of weight; it can't swim below the surface. If the target is underwater, it rises to the surface at 150 feet per round and takes no harm from the ascent. The spell doesn't prevent a creature from breathing water.

The spell can raise a sunken ship from the deep. If you know the ship's appearance, name, history, and the circumstances of its sinking, the distance to the ship doesn't matter. The spell brings up all surviving fragments of the ship and any loose objects in contact with or enclosed inside it. When the spell ends, the ship sinks again if it hasn't been repaired.

spell.name: Ram's Might
entries: Your muscles surge with the strength of a charging ram. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal {@damage 1d6} plus your Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage instead of the usual damage. The spell has no other effect on you; you can cast spells and manipulate objects normally.

spell.name: Rapid Burrowing
entries: You touch a creature that has a Burrow Speed. For the duration, that Burrow Speed increases by 20 feet. The spell grants no Burrow Speed to a creature that lacks one and doesn't let a creature burrow through materials it couldn't already burrow through.

spell.name: Ray Deflection
entries: For the duration, you are protected against ranged spell attacks. Any ranged spell attack made against you automatically misses, whether it comes from a ray spell or a creature's ability.

spell.name: Ray of Clumsiness
entries: A ray of stiffening energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity checks and Dexterity saving throws, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet, until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1. The targets must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Ray of Deanimation
entries: A ray of magic-disrupting energy streaks toward a Construct within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 8d8} Force damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Ray of Dizziness
entries: You strike a creature within range with a ray that causes intense vertigo. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target's Speed is halved, and on each of its turns it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Ray of Entropy
entries: You unleash a ray of negative energy that saps the life force of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit against a creature that isn't a Construct or an Undead, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks and saving throws, and its Speed is halved, until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 6. The targets must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Ray of Flame
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Fire damage and catches fire. A burning creature takes {@damage 1d6} Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The fire burns until a creature uses an action to put it out, or until the target is submerged in water or otherwise extinguished.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The initial damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Ray of Ice

components.m: a piece of ice or a vial of melted mountain snow

entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} Cold damage and makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, its feet are frozen to the ground by ice: its Speed is 0 and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls. The effect ends if the target uses an action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, or if the ice takes 15 or more Fire damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Ray of Light
entries: You direct a searing ray at a creature's eyes. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 8d8} Radiant damage and has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the Blinded target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
