entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Ray of Stupidity
entries: This ray clouds the mind of your enemy. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Psychic damage. For the duration, it also has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws, and on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Ray of Weakness
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target feels weaker for the duration: it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. Make a separate attack roll for each target.

spell.name: Reality Maelstrom

components.m: a golden hoop at least 1 inch across

entries: You tear a temporary hole in reality that sucks material and creatures into a random plane of existence. Choose a point within range. A 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point is the maelstrom's core, and the space out to 40 feet from the point is its windstorm.
Each unattended object of 100 pounds or less in the core vanishes. Each creature in the core makes a Charisma saving throw; on a failed save it vanishes.

Each unattended object of 50 pounds or less in the windstorm is pulled into the core and vanishes. Each creature in the windstorm makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled into the core and must then make the Charisma saving throw described above.

Everything that vanishes is sent to the same random plane of existence, chosen by the DM. Creatures that succeed on their saving throws can move and act normally. The hole is a one-way portal and closes at the end of the spell, so nothing emerges from it.

spell.name: Reaving Dispel
entries: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of level 8 or lower on the target ends. For each spell of level 9, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus the spell's level); on a success, the spell ends. You can also end any curse or similar effect that {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} could end.

For each spell you end on a creature or object this way, you can choose to reave it. The spell's effects transfer to you and continue for the remainder of the original duration as if cast on you by the original caster. If the spell requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, you must concentrate on it as though you had cast it. If you reave a harmful spell, you are subject to its effects and can make the same saving throws the original target could.
If you target an area with this spell, you can't reave any of the effects it ends.

spell.name: Rebuke

components.m: a stick at least 1 foot long

entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for the duration and the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While Frightened this way, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the Frightened condition on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 4+ spell slot, a target that fails the save has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for as long as it is {@condition Frightened|XPHB} by this spell, rather than only until the end of its next turn, and you can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Rebuking Breath
entries: You must have a breath weapon, such as the Dragonborn's Breath Weapon, for this spell to work. You imbue your breath weapon with negative energy. If you use your breath weapon before the spell ends, each Undead that fails its saving throw against it is {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you until the end of your next turn.

spell.name: Reciprocal Gyre

components.m: a tiny closed loop of copper wire

entries: Choose one creature you can see within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking {@damage 2d8} Force damage for each spell currently affecting it (maximum 6 spells, or 12d8) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails the save, it must also succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
Only spells that specifically target the creature count. Spells that affect an area, and persistent effects of magic items, don't count.

spell.name: Recitation
entries: Each ally of your choice in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you at the moment you cast the spell gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class and can add {@dice 1d4} to attack rolls and saving throws for the duration. A creature that worships the same deity as you, or shares your faith, can add {@dice 1d6} instead.

spell.name: Red Tide
entries: A surging wave of thick, red seawater washes over a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area is knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB} and makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d6} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute; on a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't have the condition. A Poisoned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success. Creatures immune to Poison damage or the Poisoned condition ignore these effects.

Each creature in the area that has Immunity to Fire damage or is made of fire (such as a fire elemental) also makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d6} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The tainted water vanishes almost immediately, leaving creatures and objects dry.

spell.name: Refusal

components.m: a pinch of dust from a wizard's tomb

entries: You create an invisible ward in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range that bars spellcasters from entering. A creature that has spell slots, prepared spells, or the Spellcasting or Innate Spellcasting trait and tries to enter the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be halted by an invisible barrier. The DC increases by the level of the highest-level spell the creature can currently cast (to a maximum of +9).

You can designate a password or condition (such as species, a token, or another observable trait) by which creatures can enter freely. Creatures without spellcasting can pass freely. Spellcasters already in the area when you cast the spell aren't forced out, but must make the save to return if they leave. Spells can pass through the barrier in either direction. A creature teleporting into the area makes the save; on a failure, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space outside the area.

spell.name: Regal Procession
entries: Four {@creature Riding Horse|XMM|Riding Horses} appear in unoccupied spaces within range, each with a bridle, saddle, saddle blanket, ribbons, and a banner. You choose their colors and livery, which can include a heraldic or personal symbol. The horses are friendly to you and your companions and obey your verbal commands. Each horse vanishes when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You summon one additional horse for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Rejection
entries: Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed up to 60 feet away from you in a straight line; if it hits a wall or similarly solid surface before moving the full distance, it takes {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was unable to move and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. This forced movement can carry the creature beyond the spell's range.

spell.name: Rejuvenation Cocoon
entries: A cocoon of flexible force forms around a willing creature you touch, giving it Total Cover. The creature has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a Speed of 0 while enclosed. At the end of your next turn, the cocoon restores {@dice 8d8} plus your spellcasting modifier Hit Points to the creature and ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition and one disease affecting it. The cocoon then dissipates at the end of the spell. The cocoon has AC 15 and 50 Hit Points, and the spell ends if it drops to 0.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 8d8|5-9|2d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Rejuvenative Corpse
entries: You charge the corpse of a Humanoid that died within the past week with negative energy. If an Undead creature eats a full meal of the corpse's flesh within the duration (typically 10 minutes), it regains 3 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns for 5 minutes. This doesn't stack with other regeneration the Undead has, can't regrow lost body parts, and discharges the spell from the corpse.

You can cast this spell on the same corpse multiple times, allowing more than one Undead to feed. A Medium corpse provides ten meals, a Small corpse five, and a Tiny corpse two. A living creature that eats a charged corpse must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours.

spell.name: Remove Scent

components.m: a pinch of unscented candle wax

entries: You hide the scent of a creature or object you touch for the duration. Creatures can't detect the target by smell, and creatures with scent-based senses (such as Keen Smell) can't use them to find it. The target is also unaffected by noxious odors such as that of a ghast's Stench.

spell.name: Renewal Pact

m.text: a topaz worth at least 500 GP

entries: You touch a willing creature, placing a dormant restorative pact on it. The pact triggers when the target gains the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, or {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition, gains a level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, or contracts a disease or curse. One round later, the target is affected by {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}. The spell then ends.
A creature can have only one Renewal Pact at a time. Casting this spell on a creature that already has an untriggered one ends the earlier pact.

spell.name: Repair Damage
entries: You touch a Construct and transmute its structure to repair damage. The Construct regains a number of Hit Points equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 2d8|1-9|2d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Repair Minor Damage
entries: You touch a Construct and mend a small amount of its damage. The Construct regains {@dice 1d4} Hit Points plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The healing increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach levels 5 (2d4), 11 (3d4), and 17 (4d4).

spell.name: Replicate Casting

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature cast a spell of 8th level or lower within 60 feet of you

entries: You duplicate the effect of the triggering spell as if you had cast it yourself, using a 9th-level spell slot and the spell's normal casting rules. You choose any targets or options for the duplicate as normal, using the spell's level as cast by the original caster. If the spell has a Material component with a cost, you must provide that component. The spell must be a spell you can see being cast, but it can be from any class's spell list.
If the original spell's casting time is longer than 1 minute, you can't duplicate it with this spell.

spell.name: Resonating Bolt
entries: A bolt of sonic energy blasts from you in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The bolt also deals this damage to each unattended object in the Line and shatters nonmagical barriers of glass, wood, or stone up to 1 foot thick in its path; if the bolt destroys a barrier, it continues past it if its range allows.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Resurgence
entries: You touch one creature that is under the effect of a spell or other magical effect that allowed a saving throw. The target immediately repeats that saving throw against one such effect of your choice (using the original DC), ending the effect on a success. If an effect didn't allow a saving throw, this spell can't end it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Revenance
entries: You touch a creature that died within the last minute and that has been dead no longer than that. The creature returns to life with half its Hit Point maximum, without suffering the usual penalties of being raised. It is alive (not Undead) for the duration and can be healed normally, but it dies again when the spell ends. While the spell lasts, it can't be targeted by spells that return the dead to life.
Additionally, the creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws against the creature that killed it.

spell.name: Reverse Arrows

components.m: a piece of tortoise shell and a ball of tree sap

entries: You are protected from ranged weapon attacks. When a ranged weapon attack hits you, the damage you would take from it is reduced to 0, and the projectile is turned back on the attacker, who makes a new attack roll against its own AC with the same modifiers; on a hit, it takes damage as if it had hit with the weapon, rolling the damage again.
The spell ends once it has negated a total of 50 damage this way (the attack that reaches the total is still fully negated).

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The total damage negated increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Revive Outsider

m.text: a diamond worth at least 5,000 gp and a bit of soil, water, or other natural material from the creature's native plane

entries: You touch a dead Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend that has a challenge rating no higher than your level. The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point and a -4 penalty to D20 Tests; the penalty is reduced by 1 each time it finishes a Long Rest. It can have been dead for any length of time, but this spell can't return a creature to life if its body has been destroyed.

spell.name: Revive Undead

m.text: a black pearl worth at least 5,000 gp

entries: You touch an Undead creature that was destroyed within the last 24 hours and whose body is whole. If its animating spirit is free and willing, the creature returns to unlife with 1 Hit Point and gains one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} that can't be removed by spells. Missing body parts remain missing, and its equipment is unaffected. This spell can't revive an Undead whose destruction was caused by the Turn Undead feature.
A spellcasting Undead that is revived loses each of its unused spell slots or prepared spells with a 50 percent chance.

spell.name: Rhino's Rush
entries: You propel yourself into a deadly charge. The first time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack before the spell ends, after moving at least 10 feet in a straight line toward it on the same turn, you roll the weapon's damage dice an additional time and add the result to the damage.

spell.name: Righteous Aura
entries: You are bathed in an unearthly glow. For the duration, you shed {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks.

If you die while the spell is active, your body is converted into an explosive blast of energy in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on where you fell. Each creature of your choice in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Fiends and Undead have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the save. Each ally of your choice in the area instead regains Hit Points equal to the damage a creature would take on a failed save. Your body is disintegrated, so you can't be returned to life by {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB}; spells that don't require an intact body, such as {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB}, work normally.

spell.name: Righteous Fury
entries: Summoning the power of your deity, you charge yourself with divine energy. You gain 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws for the duration. The Temporary Hit Points last until the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 5 for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Righteous Wrath of the Faithful
entries: Up to ten allies of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you are filled with zealous fury for the duration. When an affected creature takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, it can make one additional attack with a melee weapon as part of that action (this doesn't stack with other effects that grant an additional attack, such as {@spell Haste|XPHB}). Each affected creature also adds {@dice 1d4} to its melee attack rolls and {@dice 1d6} to its melee damage rolls. {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

spell.name: Ring of Blades
entries: A ring of swirling, magical blades surrounds you, extending 5 feet from you in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} and moving with you. When you cast the spell, and at the start of each of your turns, each creature of your choice in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Slashing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The blades count as magical and silvered. {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Ruby Ray of Reversal

components.m: a ruby worth at least 500 gp

entries: You send out a ruby ray that "corrects" one hazard in range. Choose one of the following effects:

items: {@b Spring Trap.} One trap you are aware of within range is sprung. Creatures in the trap's area are affected normally.

{@b Release.} One knot, chain, manacle, or similar restraint falls away, any {@spell Entangle|XPHB} or similar magical restraint on one creature or area ends, and one door, chest, or other lock that is locked, barred, or under {@spell Arcane Lock|XPHB} is opened.

{@b Breach Force.} A 5-foot-diameter hole opens in a {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, {@spell Forcecage|XPHB}, or similar effect. The effect isn't destroyed, and the hole lasts until the end of your next turn.
{@b Restore Form.} One creature that has been polymorphed, turned to stone, or otherwise transformed from its natural state is returned to its natural form (the transforming effect ends).
{@b Shatter Jar.} A {@spell Magic Jar|XPHB} spell ends if the ray targets the vessel holding the caster's soul.

{@b Clear Hindrance.} Webs, slime, grease, and other substances that would hamper movement are destroyed in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range.

spell.name: Ruin Delver's Fortune

time.condition: which you take when you are forced to make a saving throw or are about to take damage

entries: Choose one of the following benefits. You can cast this spell multiple times, but each casting must grant a different benefit.

items: Add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to your Constitution saving throws, including the triggering save, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.
Add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to your Dexterity saving throws, including the triggering save, and you gain the Evasion trait.
Add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to your Wisdom saving throws, including the triggering save, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.
You gain {@dice 4d8} plus your Charisma modifier {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and they absorb the triggering damage. They vanish when the spell ends.

spell.name: Rushing Waters
entries: Cold water gushes in a great wave outward from a point you choose within range, filling a 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. Each creature in that area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} Bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away from the point, and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. The water also drenches everything in the area and extinguishes nonmagical flames there.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Rust Ray

components.m: rust particles or a piece of a rust monster

entries: Make a ranged spell attack against one nonmagical metal object or one creature made largely of metal (such as a Construct of iron or steel). On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d8} Acid damage. If the target is nonmagical metal armor being worn, it also takes a permanent -1 penalty to the AC it provides; if it is a nonmagical metal weapon being wielded, it takes a permanent -1 penalty to damage rolls. These penalties are cumulative and can be removed with {@spell Mending|XPHB}. A nonmagical metal object that is reduced to 0 Hit Points is destroyed.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Sacred Haven
entries: You and up to ten allies of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class for the duration, and attack rolls against an affected creature don't gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} from the attacker being unseen by that creature. You also know the current Hit Points of each affected creature, and you can use your Lay On Hands on any affected creature at any distance, as long as you are on the same plane, without needing to touch it.

spell.name: Safe Clearing
entries: You make an area safe from attacks. The area is a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you when you finish the spell, and it doesn't move. When a creature attempts to enter the area or to attack or target a creature in the area with a spell, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it can act normally and isn't affected by this casting. On a failure, it can't enter the area or target creatures in it for the duration. Creatures that don't try to attack those in the area are unaffected, and the spell doesn't stop area effects from affecting creatures in the ward. A creature in the area that makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage is no longer protected by this spell.

spell.name: Safety
entries: You touch one willing creature. For the duration, the target knows the shortest, most direct route to the nearest place of safety, meaning a location where it is not taking immediate environmental damage and none is imminent. The spell doesn't grant the means to travel that route, and it doesn't reveal or protect against creatures that inhabit that place. It doesn't function against effects that deal no physical damage, such as {@spell Maze|XPHB}.

If {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB} is cast on the target while it is under this spell's effect, the target arrives in a place of relative safety on the destination plane, such as a pocket of air on the Elemental Plane of Water.

spell.name: Saltray
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage and makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Sandblast
entries: You send out a blast of stinging sand. Each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d4} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. You are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|1-9|1d4} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Sarcophagus of Stone
entries: Stone erupts from the ground and closes around one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is sealed inside an airtight stone coffin just large enough to hold it. While inside, the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}, and can't be targeted by attacks or spells from outside the coffin.

The coffin is an object with AC 17, 30 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The target and any creature adjacent to the coffin can attack it; the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against it. As an action, a creature can make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, breaking the coffin open on a success. The coffin crumbles to rubble when it drops to 0 Hit Points or is broken open, freeing the target.
The coffin holds enough air for 1 hour. After that, a creature inside that needs to breathe begins to suffocate.

spell.name: Scale Weakening
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target's natural armor withers: if its Armor Class is based on natural armor, its AC is reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 10) for the duration. This spell has no effect on magical bonuses to AC, such as those from {@spell Barkskin|XPHB}.
The target can't be affected by this spell again until the duration ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The AC reduction increases by 1 for every two spell slot levels above 2 (3 at level 4, 4 at level 6, 5 at level 8).

spell.name: Scatterspray
entries: You point to a collection of at least six tiny, unsecured objects (such as coins, pebbles, or sling bullets) within range, all within 1 foot of each other and weighing no more than 25 pounds in total. The objects fly off in all directions in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on them. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or no damage on a successful one. Soft objects (eggs, fruit, and the like) can be used, but deal no damage and instead force each creature that fails the save to have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Scent

components.m: a sprinkle of mustard and pepper

entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) and Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell, and it can detect the approximate distance and direction of any creature within 30 feet by scent, provided the wind isn't blowing the scent away from it.

spell.name: Scintillating Sphere
entries: A massive electrical discharge erupts at a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The discharge also damages unattended objects in the area.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Scorch
entries: A line of flame erupts from you in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Scourge

components.m: a black whip or riding crop, which you crack in the direction of your targets while casting

entries: You infect up to six living creatures you can see within range, no two of which can be more than 50 feet apart, with a vile wasting disease. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength and Dexterity scores each decrease by {@dice 1d6} (to a minimum of 1), and it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A Poisoned target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the Poisoned condition (but not the disease) on itself on a success. The disease persists, and at the end of each of the target's Long Rests it must repeat the save; on a failure, its Strength and Dexterity scores each decrease by another {@dice 1d6}. A successful save doesn't end the disease or restore lost ability score points.

The disease ends only if it is cured by {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} followed by a {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}. {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} also restores the lost ability score points; otherwise they return after the target finishes a number of Long Rests equal to the points lost.

spell.name: Scramble Portal
entries: You randomize the destination of one interplanar gate or portal within range for the duration. Whenever a creature passes through the portal from either side, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is sent to a random plane of existence (determined by the DM) instead of the portal's normal destination. All creatures that fail the save on the same round arrive at the same location on that plane.

spell.name: Seal Portal

m.text: a silver bar worth at least 50 GP

entries: You permanently seal one interplanar gate or portal within range. The spell prevents any use of the portal. The seal can be ended by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, but {@spell Knock|XPHB} has no effect on a sealed portal. If the portal is opened by other means, such as a key or command word, the seal ends and the spell must be cast again.

spell.name: Sense Heretic
entries: You touch a weapon or holy symbol. For the duration, if a creature that serves an evil power and can cast spells using divine magic comes within 100 feet of the object, the object sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius. The object doesn't reveal the creature's location or direction, only that such a creature is within range. One foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks this spell.

spell.name: Sensory Deprivation

components.m: a black silk cloth tied like a blindfold

entries: You wrap one creature you can see within range in a dark, clinging shadow that only it perceives. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions for the duration, and it can't use {@sense Blindsight|XPHB}, {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}, or senses of smell or touch to perceive its surroundings. It retains any telepathic link it has with other creatures. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Serene Visage
entries: Simple illusions aid your attempts to be persuasive. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) and Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks.

spell.name: Servant Horde

components.m: a small stick to which many lengths of knotted thread are attached

entries: You create {@dice 2d6 + 8} invisible, mindless, shapeless servants at points you choose within range. Each servant uses the rules of the {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB} spell: it has AC 10, 1 Hit Point, and a Strength of 2, can't attack, and can perform simple tasks such as fetching, cleaning, mending, folding, and serving, or carry up to 20 pounds. Servants can't be commanded to use magic items or perform tasks requiring skill. A servant that drops to 0 Hit Points disappears. You can give a command to all servants as a Bonus Action while within 60 feet of them.

spell.name: Shadow Binding

components.m: a few links of iron chain

entries: Shadowy chains lash around creatures in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can increase the radius of the Sphere by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Shadow Cache
entries: You touch a flat surface and open a 1-foot-diameter portal to the Shadowfell that is invisible on the Material Plane. You can reach into the portal, but only small nonliving objects can pass entirely through it. The cache holds up to 30 cubic feet of material, or 250 pounds. You can recover objects placed in the cache for the duration, or by casting this spell again at the same location later. The cache remains stationary at the point where you create it.

Items left in the cache can be picked up by natives of the Shadowfell or drift away. For every 24 hours that pass, there is a 10 percent chance that the items placed in the cache are gone. The spell can't be cast in the Shadowfell itself.

spell.name: Shadow Form

components.m: a small piece of black cloth taken from a funeral shroud

entries: Shadows wrap your form. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and attack rolls against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} unless the attacker has {@sense Truesight|XPHB}. This benefit is suppressed while you stand in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} created by {@spell Daylight|XPHB} or natural sunlight.

As a Magic action, you can attempt to slip through a solid object or barrier up to 10 feet thick by making a DC 15 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check. This ends the spell as soon as the attempt is completed, whether or not you succeed. A barrier made of magical force can be passed only if you have proficiency in Acrobatics and the check total is 20 or higher.

spell.name: Shadow Hand
entries: You create a floating Medium hand of shadow at a point you can see within range. It is 5 feet long and wide, opaque gray, and has AC 18 and Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum. It makes all saving throws as you do, and the spell ends if it drops to 0 Hit Points or moves out of range. When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can command the hand to move up to 60 feet and perform one of these tasks:

{@b Obscure.} Choose a creature within 5 feet of the hand. That creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you until the start of your next turn, as the hand blocks its sight of you.
{@b Carry.} The hand carries up to 100 pounds of unattended material, as {@spell Tenser's Floating Disk|XPHB}. If you command it to do something else, it drops what it carries.
{@b Gesture.} The hand points or gestures as a normal hand does.
If you give it no command, the hand follows you at your speed.

spell.name: Shadow Landscape
entries: You twist the terrain in a 1-mile-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within range into a haunting, shadowy mirror of itself. The area becomes {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} even in daylight. Each creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Wisdom saving throw, becoming {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you until the start of its next turn on a failed save. Effects by terrain:

{@b Desert.} The temperature rises or falls by 30 degrees (if tundra) and sandstorms or snowstorms sweep through hourly, imposing the Heavily Obscured condition and {@dice 2d6} Bludgeoning damage per hour of exposure to those caught in the open.
{@b Forest.} Light undergrowth becomes heavy undergrowth (Difficult Terrain), and heavy undergrowth acts as {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, using your spell save DC.
{@b Hills and mountains.} Slopes seem steeper than they are, and each foot of movement uphill costs 2 extra feet.
{@b Marsh.} The ground grows treacherous; Difficult Terrain extends to all open ground, and mist grows heavy.

{@b Plains.} Shadows and mist make all open ground Difficult Terrain and hide distant landmarks (creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to navigate).
The effect lasts for the duration, and can be ended by {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} cast on its center.

spell.name: Shadow Mask
entries: A mask of shadows forms around your face. It doesn't impede your vision, can't be physically removed, and completely hides your features. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and effects that rely on bright light to harm you (such as {@spell Sunbeam|XPHB}) and against gaze effects that require you to see the source, and creatures can't see your face. When the spell ends, the mask fades over {@dice 1d4} rounds rather than immediately.

spell.name: Shadow Phase
entries: You swap some of a willing creature's substance for shadow, making it partially incorporeal. For the duration, attack rolls against the target have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and the target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. The target can't pass through walls or solid objects.

spell.name: Shadow Radiance

components.m: a flame at least the size of a torch

entries: You create an intensifying illusion of searing light in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area that can see makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and for the rest of the duration while in the area, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that leaves the area is unaffected after 1 round. On a successful save, the creature sees only the equivalent of torchlight at the center.

spell.name: Shadow Spray
entries: Ribbonlike shadows explode outward in a 5-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 3d6} Necrotic damage and can take only an action or a Bonus Action (not both) on its next turn, and it can't take Reactions until then. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Shadow Well
entries: You turn the shadow of one creature you can see within range into a gateway to a pocket realm within the Shadowfell. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled into the pocket realm, where it sees a deserted, gloomy duplicate of the world while shadowy phantasms stalk and taunt it without causing harm. It has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and is removed from its space. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, returning on a success.

The target returns when the spell ends, in the space it left (or the nearest unoccupied space). Upon returning, it makes another Wisdom saving throw or has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. Teleportation within a plane doesn't help a creature escape the pocket realm; {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB} does.

spell.name: Shadowblast

components.m: a handful of grave dirt, squeezed tightly and flung

entries: You fling a burst of grave-dirt-laced shadow-banishing energy in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. Each Undead and each creature native to the Shadowfell in the area makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d8} Radiant damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn; on a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A creature that fails the save also can't use spells or abilities to open a portal to the Shadowfell for 1 hour.
The spell also closes all portals, gates, and other openings to the Shadowfell in the area. Creatures on the other side of a portal are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Shadowfade
entries: You open a 10-foot-diameter portal to the Shadowfell at a point on the ground within range, which you can cast only from a region of dim light or darkness on a plane coexistent with the Shadowfell (not the Shadowfell itself). You and any creatures you designate can pass through. Other creatures can pass through the portal in either direction only if they succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. The portal is invisible from the Material Plane and looks like a white hole in the Shadowfell. The portal closes when the spell ends.

spell.name: Shadowy Grappler
entries: You create a shadowy force that seizes one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns while Grappled by the force, it makes a Strength saving throw; on a failure, it also has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can't speak until the spell ends. On a successful initial save, the target is Grappled only until the end of its next turn.
The grapple's escape DC equals your spell save DC. The force occupies the target's space and moves with it, and no other creature can join the grapple.

spell.name: Shard Storm

components.m: a small shard of clear glass or crystal

entries: Minuscule shards of magical force explode outward in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

At the start of each of your turns for the duration, the storm erupts again in the same area, and each creature in it makes the same saving throw. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can suppress the storm until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Sharptooth
entries: Choose one of your natural weapons or your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. For the duration, hits with that weapon deal an extra {@damage 1d8} damage of the weapon's type. This spell doesn't stack with itself.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|4-9|1d4} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Shatterfloor

m.text: a miniature hammer and bell worth at least 10 gp

entries: Each creature and object in a 15-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 7d6} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. If the ground in the area is stone, wood, ice, or anything softer, it is pulverized into soft dust, splinters, or loose crushed ice, and the area becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Sheltered Vitality
entries: You touch one willing living creature. For the duration, it can't gain levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, and any it already has are suppressed. In addition, no effect can reduce its ability scores or its Hit Point maximum.

spell.name: Shield of Warding
entries: You touch one Shield. For the duration, the creature wielding that Shield gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class and to Dexterity saving throws. The bonus applies only while the Shield is worn or carried normally. If a creature already benefits from this spell, the bonus doesn't stack.

spell.name: Shieldbearer
entries: You enchant one Shield you touch so that it hovers near a creature of your choice, chosen when you cast the spell and unchangeable thereafter. For the duration, the Shield stays within 1 foot of that creature and grants it the Shield's Armor Class bonus as though the creature were wielding it. The creature can wield two-handed weapons or a weapon in each hand and still benefit from the Shield. The bonus doesn't stack with other Shields or with the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell.

spell.name: Shifting Paths
entries: You hide a path or road within 1 mile of you and simultaneously create an illusory path. The illusory path starts at a point you choose within range and continues in a direction you choose for up to 1 mile, where it ends abruptly. It avoids obstacles and provides no bridges, stairs, or other means of crossing them; it can't lead over a cliff or across water deeper than 4 feet.

A creature that travels along the area and fails a Wisdom saving throw sees only the illusory path and follows it, believing the terrain slows it only as much as the path warrants. A creature that succeeds on the save sees both paths, though the illusory one looks shadowy and obviously unreal. A creature that investigates the illusion can repeat the save when it does so.

spell.name: Shock and Awe
entries: You distract up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the first time the target rolls {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} before the spell ends, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the roll. A creature that can't be Surprised can't be affected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Shroud of Flame

components.m: a pinch of saltpeter, a small piece of phosphorus, and a scrap of lace or spiderweb

entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within range. On a hit, the target is wreathed in flames for the duration. It takes {@damage 4d6} Fire damage at the start of each of its turns, sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 40-foot radius, and gains no benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition or from Concealment. The spell ends early if the target is fully immersed in nonflammable liquid.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|5-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Shroud of Undeath

components.m: dust or bone fragments from a destroyed undead creature

entries: You shroud yourself in invisible negative energy. For the duration, Undead with an Intelligence of 7 or lower perceive you as one of their own and won't willingly attack you or target you with harmful effects unless you attack or harm them or an ally of theirs. Undead of higher Intelligence aren't fooled automatically but doubt you are alive, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Deception checks to pass as undead (your appearance doesn't change).

You also count as an Undead for the purpose of spells and effects that specifically affect Undead (a spell like {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} can't heal you). If a creature successfully turns or otherwise banishes you as an Undead, the spell ends. The spell also ends if you attack an Undead creature.

spell.name: Sign

components.m: a small piece of dried goat intestine or some tea leaves

entries: For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on your next {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} roll. The spell ends once you make that roll.

spell.name: Sign of Sealing

m.text: a crushed emerald worth 100 gp

entries: You seal a door, chest, or similar closure no larger than a 10-foot square with a prominent magical sigil that bars entry and prevents opening. A sealed closure can be opened only by breaking it (the DC of any check to do so increases by 10), by casting {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} on it, or by {@spell Knock|XPHB}, which suppresses the sigil for 10 minutes.

If the closure is forced open by any means, the sigil detonates. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on it makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
A creature can disarm the sigil with a successful DC 18 Dexterity check using {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}. You can pass through your own sign safely, and it remains set behind you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3. With a level 6+ spell slot, the seal is stronger: it can cover a closure or an open space such as a corridor or archway up to a 20-foot square (a sealed open space is filled with a barrier of force that repels any creature attempting to pass), the DC of checks to break it increases by 15, a sealed object has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells, {@spell Knock|XPHB} can't open or suppress it, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} ends it only if cast with a level 6+ spell slot or with a successful DC 16 ability check, disarming it requires a DC 21 check, and the detonation fills a 40-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

spell.name: Silent Portal
entries: You target one door, window, gate, drawer, chest lid, or similar portal within range. For the duration, opening and closing it produces no sound, however squeaky it is. The spell covers only the normal means of opening and closing it; breaking or kicking it open still makes noise. Portals made of magical energy are unaffected, and a magical or intelligent portal can make a Wisdom saving throw to resist.

spell.name: Silverbeard
entries: Your beard grows and turns to pure, magically hardened silver. If you have no beard, you grow one for the duration, even if you normally couldn't. For the duration, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks against Dwarves.

spell.name: Sink
entries: Choose up to three creatures you can see within range that are in water or another liquid, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. Each target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target sinks 100 feet (or to the bottom, if the liquid is shallower). It can then swim up normally, but while on the bottom its Speed is reduced to one-quarter.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Sirine's Grace
entries: You take on a graceful, aquatic aura. For the duration, your Armor Class increases by an amount equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1, maximum +2), you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws and on Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks, and you gain a Swim Speed of 60 feet and the ability to breathe water. You also suffer no penalties for fighting underwater.

spell.name: Skull Watch

components.m: the humanoid skull targeted by the spell

entries: You touch a humanoid skull and cause it to float 5 feet off the ground, facing a direction you choose. The skull watches a 20-foot-wide, 90-foot-long area in front of it, though opaque barriers block its view. When a Tiny or larger living creature that isn't one you designated when you cast the spell enters that area, the skull emits a piercing shriek audible up to a quarter mile away. Each creature within 60 feet of the skull makes a Constitution saving throw, becoming {@condition Deafened|XPHB} until the end of its next turn on a failed save. You instantly become aware that the alarm sounded if you are on the same plane. The skull can't shriek again for 1d4 rounds.

The skull can be moved by anyone who reaches it without entering its watched area. It has AC 12, 10 Hit Points, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to poison and psychic damage. You aren't alerted if the skull is destroyed before it triggers.

spell.name: Slapping Hand
entries: A Tiny spectral hand slaps a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is distracted: each creature of your choice that can see it and has it within reach can use its Reaction to make one melee attack against it. The hand also deals {@damage 1d6} Force damage to the target on a failed save.

spell.name: Slashing Darkness
entries: You fire a ray of negative energy at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage. If the target is an Undead, it instead regains {@damage 5d8} Hit Points.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage or healing increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Slide
entries: You slide a creature you can see within range along the ground. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you move it up to 10 feet horizontally in a direction you choose (it can be moved over the edge of a drop, but not into an occupied space or a solid object; if you try, the movement stops). This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 2+ spell slot, the spell's range increases to 120 feet and you can move the target up to 30 feet.

spell.name: Slime Wave

components.m: a few drops of stagnant pond water

entries: A wave of green slime spreads from a point you choose within range to fill a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, clinging to any wall or ceiling it touches. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is covered in slime and takes {@damage 5d8} Acid damage, and again at the end of each of its turns while covered. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage once and isn't covered. A covered creature can use an action to scrape off the slime, ending the effect on it. The slime dissolves nonmagical metal and organic armor and gear on contact, and evaporates when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|7-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Slow Burn
entries: You affect all fires in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. For the duration, nonmagical fires burn for twice as long without losing intensity, their Bright Light radius is halved, and they take twice as long to put out. A creature on fire in the area must succeed on two consecutive saves or checks to extinguish the flames, and fire damage dealt by any source to creatures in the area is reduced by 1 for each damage die (to a minimum of 1 per die). You can use this spell to counter or end any effect that is a magical fire you created or that was created by a spell of equal or lower level.

spell.name: Smell of Fear
entries: You touch a creature and bestow on it an aroma that attracts predators. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, for the duration, Beasts that can smell it prefer to attack it over other creatures, and Beasts have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against it.

spell.name: Snake's Swiftness

components.m: a few scales from a snake

entries: One willing creature you can see within range can immediately make one weapon attack (no action required) against a target of its choice. This doesn't affect its place in the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} order. The spell fails if the creature has already made an extra attack this turn from this spell, {@spell Haste|XPHB}, or any similar source.

spell.name: Snakebite
entries: One of your arms turns into a venomous green serpent with a fanged mouth dripping poison. For the duration, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make a melee spell attack with it against a creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Poison damage and makes a Constitution saving throw; on a failed save, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
You can't hold anything in the transformed hand, but your other hand can hold items and perform spell components. You can be under the effect of only one casting of this spell at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The poison damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Sniper's Eye
entries: You attune yourself to the vantage point where you cast this spell. For the duration, you gain the following benefits while you remain within 5 feet of that spot:

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.
You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 60 feet.
Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover and don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} from attacking at long range.
The first ranged weapon attack you make on each of your turns against a target within 60 feet that is unaware of you is a Critical Hit if it hits.

entries: If you move more than 5 feet from that spot, you lose these benefits until you return to it.

spell.name: Sniper's Shot
entries: Until the end of your next turn, your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover and don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} from attacking at long range or from a hostile creature within 5 feet of you. If you have the Sneak Attack feature, you can use it on these attacks regardless of the distance to the target, provided you meet its other requirements.

spell.name: Snowshoes
entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by ice and snow, can walk across ice without slipping and across thin ice without cracking it, has its Speed increased by 10 feet, and leaves no more noticeable a trail in ice and snow than on solid ground.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Solipsism
entries: You manipulate the senses of one creature you can see within range so that it believes itself the only real being in existence and everything around it an illusion. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, its Speed is 0, and it watches the world with bemusement, taking no steps to defend itself. Attack rolls against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. Taking damage doesn't end the effect, since the target takes it for another illusion. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.

spell.name: Songbird
entries: You perform briefly, and everyone who sees or hears you becomes favorably inclined toward you. Once within the next hour, when you make a Charisma check against a creature that witnessed the performance, you can roll a {@dice 1d4} and add it to the check. The spell then ends.

spell.name: Sonic Blast
entries: You blast a creature you can see within range with loud, high-pitched sound. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. This spell has no effect on a target within the area of a {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Sonic Rumble

m.text: a hollow cone of brass and gold

entries: You create a cone of powerful sound. Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the spell ends, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on each of your turns to unleash the cone again in a new direction. The spell has no effect in the area of a {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Sonic Snap
entries: You create a brief, loud noise next to a creature or object you can see within range. A creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage and have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. An object takes the damage with no save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d6}), 11 ({@damage 3d6}), and 17 ({@damage 4d6}).

spell.name: Sonic Weapon
entries: You touch one weapon. For the duration, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage on a hit. The energy doesn't harm the wielder. If the weapon is a bow, crossbow, or sling, its ammunition carries the sonic energy.

spell.name: Sonic Whip
entries: You create a whip of sonic energy in your hand. For the duration, you can use it as a melee weapon with the Reach property, you are proficient with it, and it deals {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage on a hit. Attacks with it use your spellcasting ability modifier for attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can crack the whip. Each Beast of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it must stay at least 30 feet from you if able until the end of your next turn. When you hit a Beast with the whip, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

spell.name: Sound Lance
entries: A projectile of intense sonic energy leaps from you to a creature or object you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. The lance can't penetrate the area of a {@spell Silence|XPHB} spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|3-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Spark of Life
entries: You touch an Undead creature, which makes a Wisdom saving throw (it can choose to fail). On a failed save, for the duration it loses its immunity to Poison damage and to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions, it must breathe, eat, and sleep as a living creature (though the duration is too short for the last two to matter), and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws if it has a Charisma modifier above 0.
While the spell lasts, spells that restore Hit Points heal the creature rather than harming it, and Necrotic damage heals it for half the damage dealt. It retains all of its other traits.

spell.name: Spawn Screen
entries: You touch up to three willing creatures. For the duration, if a target dies from an attack, trait, or effect of an Undead creature that would normally cause it to rise as an undead spawn (such as a Ghoul's or Wight's), it doesn't rise. The spell doesn't prevent death; it only ensures the target's body and spirit can't be hijacked by an undead creature. If the target dies while the spell is still in effect, the protection applies. You can't cast this spell on a body that has already been killed by a spawn-creating undead.

spell.name: Speak to Allies
entries: You point toward any number of allies you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart, and whisper a message. Each target hears it and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear. You and the targets needn't move your lips or make any sound, so lip-readers learn nothing. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt blocks the spell.

spell.name: Spectral Touch
entries: Your hand is wreathed in negative energy. For the duration, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach, up to six times in total. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it gains one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} for 1 hour and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 5 plus your spellcasting ability modifier (they last 1 hour). A creature can't gain more than 2 levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} from a single casting of this spell.

If you hit an Undead creature, it instead gains 5 Temporary Hit Points that last 1 hour and you lose the same amount of Hit Points, with no save. Any uses of the touch unused when the spell ends are lost.

spell.name: Spectral Weapon
entries: You fashion a shadowy melee weapon from the Plane of Shadow, of any type you're proficient with, which appears in your hand. It behaves as a normal weapon of its type, except that attacks with it are melee spell attacks using your spellcasting modifier and it deals {@damage 2d8} Necrotic damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier on a hit, instead of its normal damage.

When you hit a creature, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, it recognizes the weapon's insubstantial nature and takes half damage from it for the rest of the duration. Only you can wield the weapon, and you can maintain only one. It disappears if you let go of it.

spell.name: Speechlink
entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, you and the target can speak to each other and hear each other no matter how far apart you are on the same plane, whatever the volume of the speech. Either of you can end the spell at any time. The spell transfers only vocalizations, not other sounds, and conveys no ability to understand languages. It works on any creature, including animals.

spell.name: Spell Engine

m.text: a disk of polished bone, one of your tears, and a silver wheel worth 1,000+ GP, all of which the spell consumes

entries: You conjure a 5-foot-radius magical wheel of force within range. When you finish casting, you can replace any or all of the spells you have prepared with other spells from your spellbook, as if you'd finished a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Each replacement must be of the same level as the spell it replaces. Spell slots you have already expended aren't restored, including the one used for this spell.

spell.name: Spell Enhancer
entries: This spell makes the next spell you cast this turn harder to resist. That spell's save DC increases by 2, and it is treated as though cast using a spell slot one level higher for any effects that scale with slot level (you still expend the original slot). Casting this spell doesn't prevent you from casting another spell this turn.

spell.name: Spell Flower
entries: For the duration, you can hold the charge of more than one spell with a range of Touch, one per hand, arm, or other limb you could use to touch a target. A held spell is discharged only when you touch a creature with that limb or cast another spell with that limb. If you cast a spell with a Somatic component using a limb that holds a charge, you immediately lose that held spell (your choice of which, if several), unless the new spell is a Touch spell, in which case you can hold it in that limb instead.
If you make an attack with a held Touch spell, it works normally. When the spell ends, the most recently cast Touch spell remains as a held charge, and all other held spells are lost.

spell.name: Sphere of Ultimate Destruction

components.m: a pinch of dust from a disintegrated creature

entries: You create a 2-foot-radius sphere of destructive force at a point you can see within range. When you cast the spell, and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action or Bonus Action on each of your later turns, you can fly the sphere up to 30 feet. The sphere stops moving when it enters a creature's space, and that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 14d10} Force damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is disintegrated, leaving only a trace of fine dust; its equipment is unaffected.

If the sphere touches a nonmagical object that isn't being worn or carried, it disintegrates up to a 10-foot Cube of it. The sphere counts as {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} for the purpose of destroying a {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB} or any other effect that {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} specifically affects. If the sphere moves beyond the spell's range, it winks out.

spell.name: Spider Curse
entries: You curse one Medium or smaller Humanoid you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is transformed into a drider-like creature with a spider's body and a Humanoid head, arms, and torso for the duration. It becomes Large, has a Speed of 30 feet and a Climb Speed of 30 feet, and its Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores each increase by 4 (to a maximum of 22). It also gains a +2 bonus to AC, and its Hit Points are unchanged. Armor and clothing on its lower body or whole body cease to function while it is transformed; items worn or held on the upper body continue to work.

The transformed target gains a Bite attack (melee, reach 5 feet) that uses its Strength or Dexterity modifier and deals {@damage 1d8} plus that modifier Piercing damage plus {@damage 2d8} Poison damage. A creature bitten must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

The target is also {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you for the duration. You can telepathically command it for as long as it is within 1 mile of you and on the same plane; it obeys as long as the commands aren't self-destructive. The spell ends if you are incapacitated, and {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} cast on the target ends it.

spell.name: Spider Plague
entries: You call forth five Large spiders. Choose celestial or fiendish when you cast the spell. Five {@creature Giant Spider|XMM|Giant Spiders} appear in unoccupied spaces you can see within range. Each has the maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for its stat block, and an additional trait based on your choice. A celestial spider has Resistance to Acid, Cold, and Lightning damage; a fiendish spider has Resistance to Acid and Fire damage.

The spiders are allies to you and your allies. In combat, they share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count but take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you); if you issue none, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and move to avoid danger. Each spider disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: One additional spider appears for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Spider Poison

components.m: a poisonous spider, alive or dead

entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. At the start of its next turn, it must make another Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Poison damage on a failed save. A creature that succeeds on the first save takes no damage and isn't poisoned.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage of each instance increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Spiderform
entries: You transform into a {@creature Giant Spider|XMM} or a {@creature Drider|XMM}, as you choose. Until the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to revert to your normal form. While transformed, you replace your Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores, Speed, and Climb Speed with those of the creature, and gain its natural armor (AC), Bite, web abilities, and poison. You retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, alignment, personality, and Hit Points (and gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 20 that last until the spell ends). Only in Drider form can you cast spells, use magic items, and manipulate objects; items worn on the lower body or whole body of a Drider form cease to function until you revert.

spell.name: Spiderskin
entries: You touch a willing creature. Its skin hardens into a carapace for the duration. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC, {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against poison effects and on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks, and Resistance to Poison damage.

spell.name: Spirit Worm

components.m: a piece of fire-blackened ivory or bone carved in the shape of a segmented worm

entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature. On a hit, a lingering decay takes hold in its body and spirit, and the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns for the duration (up to 5 turns). At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Spiritjaws

components.m: a piece of bone from a dinosaur's jaw

entries: You create jaws of force at a point within range. When you cast the spell, and as a Bonus Action on each of your later turns, you can move the jaws up to 30 feet and make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of them. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d6} Force damage and, if it isn't already, has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC). While grappled this way, a creature can't cast spells with Somatic components, and when you use your Bonus Action, the jaws automatically deal {@damage 2d6} Force damage to it instead of requiring an attack.
The jaws can't be damaged by any means except {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} and similar effects. If you become Incapacitated, the jaws vanish.

spell.name: Spiritual Chariot
entries: You conjure a chariot of force to which your steed (such as one summoned by {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}) is harnessed. The chariot holds you as driver and one Medium creature or two Small creatures. The chariot and its occupants weigh nothing for the purpose of the steed's carrying capacity, so the steed moves at full Speed. If the chariot is unhitched, it disappears.

The chariot is immune to all damage and interacts with other spells as a {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB} does. Occupants have Half Cover. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}) checks to control the steed while driving.

spell.name: Spiritwall

components.m: a clear cut gemstone worth at least 50 gp

entries: You create a swirling, opaque wall of spirit energy at a point within range. The wall can be up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a Sphere or hemisphere up to 10 feet in radius. It blocks line of sight, and spells can't target or pass through it. Choose one side to be the wall's front. A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the front or enters that area for the first time on a turn and can hear the groaning must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (repeating the save at the end of each of its turns, immune to this casting on a success).

A creature (other than Constructs and Undead) that enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. On a failed save, the creature's Hit Point maximum is also reduced by 5 until it finishes a Long Rest.

spell.name: Splinterbolt
entries: You hurl a barbed splinter of wood. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, it takes {@damage 4d6} Piercing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
