entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 4d6|2-9|2d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Spontaneous Search
entries: You touch a willing creature. It immediately learns the location of every hidden object, secret door, and trap within a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on it, as though it had spent a long search on each space. It doesn't learn the locations of traps that would require a check higher than DC 20 to find.

spell.name: Stabilize
entries: A burst of positive energy spreads out from you in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each living creature of your choice in the area regains {@dice 1d4} plus your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points, ending the dying state of any that were at 0 Hit Points. Each Undead creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} Radiant damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing and damage each increase by {@scaledamage 1d4|2-9|1d4} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Stalking Brand
entries: You mark a creature you can see within range with a tiny brand, about 1 inch across, visible only to you and to {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB}. You can see the brand even through {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, {@spell Polymorph|XPHB}, {@condition Invisible|XPHB}, and similar effects; it glows light green to you. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks to track the marked creature.

spell.name: Stalwart Pact

m.text: incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a willing creature, and the spell lies dormant. When the creature is reduced to half its Hit Point maximum or fewer, the spell triggers automatically: the creature gains 30 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and a +2 bonus to saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can be protected by only one casting of this spell at a time.

spell.name: Standing Wave
entries: You command water to lift a creature or object of Large size or smaller (and anything it carries) within range that is on or in a body of water. An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity saving throw to avoid being carried. The wave moves its burden in a straight line at 60 feet on each of your turns over water; the spell ends harmlessly when the wave touches land, lowering the burden gently to shore. If you ride the wave, you can steer it; otherwise it travels in the direction you chose at casting.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The maximum size increases by one category (Huge at 4th, Gargantuan at 5th level).

spell.name: Starvation
entries: You inflict wracking hunger on a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage and gains 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and doesn't gain Exhaustion.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Steeldance
entries: You cause a weapon you can see within range to hover and fight for you. When you cast the spell, and as a Bonus Action on each of your later turns, you can move the weapon up to 30 feet and make a melee spell attack with it against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes damage equal to the weapon's damage die plus your spellcasting ability modifier, of the weapon's damage type; the weapon counts as magical. A creature can try to disarm the weapon as if you wielded it, and a disarmed weapon ceases to hover.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 5+ spell slot, you can animate two weapons. When you use the Bonus Action, you can move and attack with each of them.

spell.name: Stick
entries: You affix one nonmagical, unattended object weighing 5 pounds or less to another object. A creature can separate them with a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, and effects such as {@spell Mage Hand|XPHB}, {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB}, or strong wind also do so.

spell.name: Sticky Fingers
entries: Your fingers become nimble. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) checks, and a d20 roll of 9 or lower on those checks counts as a 10.

spell.name: Sticky Saddle

time.condition: which you take when you are mounted and an effect would force you off your mount

entries: You are magically glued to your mount. For the duration, you can't be knocked off or thrown from it, and a creature must succeed on a DC 20 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check to pull you from the saddle. You stay mounted if you have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, and you can still choose to dismount safely at any time (no action required) or if your mount falls.

spell.name: Sting Ray
entries: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target feels countless insects biting and crawling on it and takes a -2 penalty to AC, and makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it can take either an action or move on each of its turns (not both), and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending those restrictions on a success. The AC penalty lasts for the duration.

spell.name: Stolen Breath
entries: You steal the air from the lungs of a creature you can see within range that breathes air. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for the duration. It can take an action at any time to catch its breath, ending the condition.

spell.name: Stone Body

components.m: a small piece of stone from a stone golem, elemental, or castle wall

entries: Your body becomes living stone. For the duration, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, immunity to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions, and critical hits against you become normal hits. Your Strength becomes 20 if lower, your Speed decreases by 10 feet, and you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.

Effects that turn stone to mud, such as Transmute Rock, give you the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute (no save), while effects that turn mud to stone restore all your Hit Points. {@spell Flesh to Stone|XPHB} cast on you ends this spell.

spell.name: Stone Bones

components.m: a miniature skull carved of granite

entries: You touch a willing Undead creature with a physical body. Its bones become as hard as stone, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

spell.name: Stone Shatter
entries: You aim a single note of perfect pitch at a nonmagical, unattended stone object of Large size or smaller, or at a creature made of stone within range. The object shatters, destroyed. A stone creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Stone Sphere

components.m: a smooth marble sphere 1 inch in diameter

entries: You create a 5-foot-diameter sphere of polished stone at a point you can see within range. It has AC 5 and 100 Hit Points. When you cast the spell, and as a Bonus Action on each of your later turns, you can roll the sphere up to 30 feet. When it enters a space containing an enemy, it stops and each creature in that space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d8} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 5d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Stone Spiders
entries: You touch up to three pebbles within range, and each one transforms into a stone construct shaped like a monstrous spider. Each construct uses the {@creature Giant Spider|XMM} stat block, except that it is a Construct, its Armor Class is 6 higher, it has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and its Poison Sense and Spider Climb traits remain. Its poison deals Strength reduction instead of Poison damage: a creature hit by its bite makes a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC and, on a failure, has its Strength score reduced by 1d3 until it finishes a Long Rest (it dies if its Strength reaches 0).

The spiders are allies to you and your allies. In combat, they share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you issue none, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and move to avoid danger. Each spider reverts to a pebble when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Stonehold
entries: Thick stony arms spring from the ground in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} centered on a point within range that contains rock or stone. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a stone arm seizes it: the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and takes {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns while restrained by an arm. On a successful save, the creature moves through the area normally until its next turn starts.

A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success. Each arm can also be destroyed (AC 15, 15 Hit Points, {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage), which frees the creature it holds. The arms are hidden within the stone until they act, and can be found with a successful Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Stony Grasp

components.m: a miniature hand sculpted from clay

entries: Choose an unoccupied 5-foot square of natural ground within range, including rock, earth, mud, grass, or sand. A Large hand made of stone appears there for the duration and acts as you direct. The hand has AC 18 and 30 Hit Points, and it vanishes if it drops to 0 Hit Points.

When the hand appears, and as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on each of your later turns, each creature within 5 feet of the hand makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 3d6} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the spell ends or the hand is destroyed. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Storm Tower
entries: A column of howling windstorm fills a 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point on the ground within range. For the duration:
Lightning. Creatures within the cylinder have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning damage, and {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} can't be cast into, out of, or within it.
Winds. Ranged attacks can't be made into, out of, or within the cylinder. Creatures inside have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing.

Barrier. A creature other than a Gargantuan one that tries to cross the outer edge of the cylinder from outside makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it can't enter and stops at the edge. Creatures inside are Lightly Obscured to creatures outside, who have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against them.

spell.name: Storm of Elemental Fury
entries: A 40-foot-radius, 200-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} storm cloud forms centered on a point within range. At the start of each of your turns for the duration, the storm produces the next effect in this order (the first effect occurs when you cast the spell):

Round 1: Windstorm. Ranged attacks in the area are impossible. Each creature in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a Medium or smaller creature is knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}, a Small or smaller creature is also pushed 20 feet in a random direction, and a Large or larger creature has its Speed halved until your next turn. Flying creatures that fail are instead pushed 20 feet in a random direction. A creature casting a spell in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or the spell is lost.
Round 2: Falling Rock. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Round 3: Deluge. A torrential downpour extinguishes unprotected flames in the area (magical flames are extinguished only on a 11 or higher on a {@dice d20}). The area is Heavily Obscured and is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB|difficult terrain}.
Round 4: Firestorm. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 12d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

spell.name: Stormrage
entries: For the duration, you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB|Fly Speed} of 40 feet, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Lightning damage and damage from nonmagical ranged weapon attacks, and you are unaffected by natural or magical wind.

As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can launch a bolt of lightning from your eyes at a creature you can see within 100 feet. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage. The attack roll has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if the target is wearing metal armor, is made of metal, or carries a lot of metal.

spell.name: Strategic Charge
entries: For the duration, your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks, and you can move through the space of any creature that isn't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} as if it were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB|difficult terrain}.

spell.name: Strength of Stone
entries: Your Strength score becomes 19 for the duration. If your feet leave the ground (you jump, are knocked into the air, or fly), the spell ends at the end of that turn. A natural stone wall or ceiling counts as the ground for this purpose, so you can climb a cavern wall without ending the spell.

spell.name: Stun Ray
entries: You blast a creature you can see within range with a scintillating ray of electricity. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is instead Stunned for the duration, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the condition on itself on a success. A creature immune to Lightning damage is unaffected.

spell.name: Stunning Breath
entries: You must have a breath weapon that deals damage, such as the Breath Weapon trait of a Dragonborn or a breath weapon granted by {@spell Dragon's Breath|XPHB}. When you use that breath weapon before the end of your current turn, you imbue it with concussive force. Each creature that takes damage from it makes a Constitution saving throw (using the breath weapon's save DC). On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: With a level 8+ spell slot, the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition lasts for 1 minute instead. A Stunned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

spell.name: Submerge Ship
entries: You touch a ship and grant it a Swim Speed of 60 feet and the ability to travel beneath the surface of the water. You control its speed and direction (no action required). All interior spaces of the ship stay dry even if a hatch or porthole is open, and creatures aboard when you cast the spell can breathe water while within 10 feet of the ship and move about it easily as if it were afloat on a calm sea. Nothing falls from the ship because of your control of its movement, though outside forces can still jostle it.

You can transfer control of the ship to another creature by giving it the rudder. If the rudder is lost or left unattended, the spell ends. When the spell ends for any reason, the ship ascends toward the surface at a rate of 60 feet per round for 1 minute. If it's still underwater when that minute ends, it sinks.

spell.name: Subvert Planar Essence

components.m: a tuning fork made from cold iron

entries: A 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range disrupts the link between outsiders and the planes that made them. When a Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, for as long as it remains in the area, it loses any {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to damage from nonmagical attacks and to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and its Magic Resistance trait (if any) doesn't function. A creature that succeeds is unaffected by this casting of the spell.

spell.name: Sudden Stalagmite
entries: A stalagmite about a foot wide and up to 10 feet tall shoots up from the ground beneath a creature you can see within range (it stops growing if it hits a ceiling). The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A flying target within 10 feet of the ground has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the save, and a target flying higher than that is unaffected.

On a failed save, the target is also impaled and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. It can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to break free, taking {@damage 3d6} Slashing damage when it does. The stalagmite can also be removed by other means, such as {@spell Stone Shape|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The piercing damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Summon Babau Demon
entries: You call forth a demon of the Abyss. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, using the Babau stat block, and it acts immediately on your turn.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. It can't summon or conjure other creatures, and it can't teleport or travel to other planes. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Summon Bearded Devil
entries: You call forth a devil of the Nine Hells. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, using the {@creature Bearded Devil|XMM} stat block, and it acts immediately on your turn.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. It can't summon or conjure other creatures, and it can't teleport or travel to other planes. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Summon Bralani Eladrin
entries: You call forth a wind-swift celestial eladrin from the Olympian Glades. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, using the {@creature Couatl|XMM} stat block except that it has the appearance of a lithe, radiant elf and its Speed is increased by 10 feet, and it acts immediately on your turn.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. It can't summon or conjure other creatures, and it can't teleport or travel to other planes. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Summon Elemental Monolith

components.m: a lump of the matching element, such as a candle, a pebble, a vial of water, or a feather

entries: You conjure a tremendously powerful elemental. Choose air, earth, fire, or water; it appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, using the {@creature Air Elemental|XMM}, {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}, {@creature Fire Elemental|XMM}, or {@creature Water Elemental|XMM} stat block, except that it is Gargantuan, its Hit Point maximum is tripled, and its Multiattack action makes two additional attacks. It acts immediately on your turn. It can't be summoned into an environment hostile to it (for example, a fire monolith underwater).

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. It can't summon or conjure other creatures, and it can't teleport or travel to other planes. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Summon Elysian Thrush
entries: You summon a Tiny celestial songbird native to the Blessed Fields of Elysium. It appears in an unoccupied space within range and has no significant combat ability. It has AC 12, 1 Hit Point, and a Fly Speed of 30 feet. While it sings, it can't be commanded to do anything else. A creature that spends Hit Dice during a Short Rest while within 30 feet of the thrush and listening to its song regains twice the number of Hit Points it rolls for each Hit Die spent. The thrush disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Summon Greater Elemental
entries: You summon an elemental from its home plane. Choose air, earth, fire, or water; it appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, using the {@creature Air Elemental|XMM}, {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}, {@creature Fire Elemental|XMM}, or {@creature Water Elemental|XMM} stat block, except that its Hit Point maximum is increased by 30. It acts immediately on your turn.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. It can't summon or conjure other creatures, and it can't teleport or travel to other planes. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Summon Hound Archon
entries: You call forth a hound-headed celestial from the Seven Mounting Heavens. It appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range, using the {@creature Warrior Veteran|XMM} stat block, except that it is a Celestial, has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} 60 feet, has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage, has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, and its weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage. It acts immediately on your turn.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, it takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. It can't summon or conjure other creatures, and it can't teleport or travel to other planes. It disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

spell.name: Superior Invisibility
entries: A creature you touch has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the spell ends. Attacking, dealing damage, or casting spells doesn't end the spell.

The spell also masks the target's sound and scent. Others can't hear the target or anything it says, including Verbal components, and can't smell it. It can't be perceived by {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} or {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}, and spells and effects that reveal invisible creatures, such as {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} and {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}, don't reveal it. Only {@sense Truesight|XPHB} or touch reveals the target, though mundane clues, such as footprints or a door opening, can still betray its location.

spell.name: Magic Fang
entries: A yellow aura flashes at the tips of your fingers, claws, fangs, and other natural weapons. For the duration, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} and the attacks of your natural weapons (such as claws, bites, horns, and those of a form you assume with {@spell Polymorph|XPHB}, Wild Shape, or similar magic) count as magical and have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3–5 spell slot and to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

spell.name: Suppress Breath Weapon
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range that has a breath weapon (a Breath Weapon trait or an action that recharges). The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it can't use its breath weapon for the duration.

spell.name: Suppress Glyph
entries: You gain heightened awareness of magical writing within a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. Magical writing such as {@spell Glyph of Warding|XPHB} or {@spell Symbol|XPHB} glows with a blue light that sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. This reveals the writing without triggering it. For each magical writing, you can make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a success, that writing is suppressed for 1 hour, and creatures can read or pass it without effect. This covers any active or triggered writing, though creatures that have already succumbed to its effect are unaffected. When the suppression ends, the writing can be triggered normally and resumes any duration it had left.

spell.name: Surefoot
entries: Your steps are sure and true, even on the narrowest ledges. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks, and you can't be knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB} while balancing or climbing.

spell.name: Surefooted Stride
entries: For the duration, you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} (nonmagical and magical), and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks made to climb.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can also target one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Suspended Silence

m.text: a feather and a handful of gem dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch one object and speak a command word. The next time anyone speaks that word within 5 feet of the object (or when you speak it from any distance), the object becomes the center of a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of silence for 1 minute, and the spell ends if it hasn't already. The Sphere moves with the object.

No sound can be created within or pass through the Sphere. Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere is immune to Thunder damage, and creatures have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

spell.name: Swamp Lung
entries: Stagnant swamp water floods the lungs of one creature that breathes that you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions as it coughs up water, and it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours as filth fever takes hold. The Incapacitated condition ends at the end of any of the target's turns on which it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw. The {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB} spell ends the Poisoned condition.
A creature that can breathe water has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the save and, on a failed save, has only the Poisoned condition.

spell.name: Swamp Stride
entries: Until the spell ends, you can enter a pool of water at least 1 foot deep that is within 5 feet of you, using 5 feet of movement, and emerge from another pool of water of similar depth that you have seen or know of within 500 feet of the first pool, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it. You can use this teleportation once on each of your turns, and you must end each turn outside a pool.

spell.name: Swift Fly
entries: With a sharp cry like an eagle's, you take to the air. Until the end of your next turn, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet and can hover. If you are still aloft when the spell ends, you fall unless you can stop the fall.

spell.name: Swift Haste
entries: Two quick syllables release the spell, and the world slows around you. When you cast it, any {@spell Slow|XPHB} spell affecting you ends. Until the end of your next turn, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is doubled, you gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws, and you gain an additional action on each of your turns. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.
Unlike {@spell Haste|XPHB}, this spell doesn't leave you lethargic when it ends.

spell.name: Swift Invisibility
entries: With a whispered syllable, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. The spell ends early immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

spell.name: Swim
entries: One willing creature you can see within range gains a Swim Speed equal to its Speed and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks made to swim or to resist being swept away. This spell doesn't let the creature breathe water.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Sword of Darkness

components.m: a longsword, which you shatter against stone as you cast the spell

entries: You conjure a blade of black negative energy in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can move the blade up to 30 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, a living target takes {@damage 4d8} Necrotic damage and its Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if this reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0.

If the blade hits an Undead creature, the creature instead gains 25 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} that last for 1 hour. The blade can't be damaged or attacked, and it has no effect on the creature's Hit Points otherwise.

spell.name: Sword of Deception

components.m: a miniature sword replica and a set of loaded dice

entries: You conjure a blade of pale green force in an unoccupied space you can see within range. When you cast the spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can move the blade up to 30 feet and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Force damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
The blade can't be damaged or attacked, and it can strike incorporeal creatures. If it is ever farther than 120 feet from you or out of your line of sight, it returns to hover next to you.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Symbol of Spell Loss

m.text: powdered diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You inscribe a harmful glyph on a surface (such as a wall, table, or floor) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book or chest). The glyph is nearly invisible (DC 15 {@skill Investigation|XPHB} to spot). You decide what triggers it, such as touching it, opening the object, or approaching within 10 feet; the spell ends once triggered, except for the effect below.

When triggered, the glyph attacks the minds of spellcasters for 10 minutes or until it has erased 50 levels of spell slots. At the start of each of their turns, each creature within 60 feet of the glyph that can cast spells or has innate spellcasting makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature loses its highest-level unexpended spell slot (or, if it has none, the next use of its highest-level innate spell, or its at-will spells for 1 round).

spell.name: Symphonic Nightmare

m.text: a small statue of an open skull containing a miniature orchestra, worth 1,000+ GP

entries: A creature you touch makes a Wisdom saving throw (a creature that doesn't sleep succeeds automatically). On a failed save, its dreams are replaced by a discordant orchestra. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom checks, and finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} grants it no benefits: it regains no Hit Points or Hit Point Dice, its Exhaustion level isn't reduced, and it can't change its prepared spells. It is immune to {@spell Dream|XPHB} and other effects that cause nightmares.

You can end the curse as an action. It also ends if {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} or {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} is cast on the target. You can also cast this spell on a creature you can see through a {@spell Scrying|XPHB} spell, or on a distant creature if you hold an item it carried within the past 24 hours.

spell.name: Synostodweomer
entries: You channel the energy of a spell into healing magic. If you cast a spell using a spell slot of level 1 or higher on your next turn before this spell ends, that spell has none of its normal effects. Instead, you touch yourself or another creature, which regains {@dice 2d8} Hit Points for each level of the spell slot you spent.

spell.name: Tactical Precision
entries: Choose up to six allies you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. For the duration, once on each of its turns, when an affected creature hits a target with an attack roll while another affected creature is within 5 feet of that target, the attacker deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the attack's type to the target.

spell.name: Targeting Ray

components.m: a small metal or stone tube

entries: A ray of light acts as a rangefinder. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the ray marks the target for the duration. You and each ally who can see the ray add {@dice 1d4} to attack rolls made with ranged attacks against the marked target, even if you lose line of sight to it. You can otherwise act normally while the spell lasts.

spell.name: Telepathic Aura
entries: For the duration, you can mentally send thoughts to every creature you consider an ally within a 100-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. This communication is one-way, and it reaches all such creatures at once. Recipients understand it regardless of language. A recipient with an Intelligence of 2 or lower understands only basic commands.

spell.name: Thornskin
entries: Thorns sprout from your skin. For the duration, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks and saving throws to escape the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, and any creature that hits you with a melee attack, an Unarmed Strike, or a grapple takes 5 Piercing damage.

spell.name: Thunderhead

components.m: a small piece of copper wire

entries: A small thundercloud appears over the head of one creature you can see within range and follows it, even if it becomes {@condition Invisible|XPHB}. At the start of each of the target's turns, a miniature bolt of lightning leaps from the cloud, and the target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 1d8} Lightning damage on a failed save.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d8|1-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Thunderlance
entries: You create a lance of force that you can extend or retract from 1 foot to 20 feet long. When you cast the spell, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on each of your later turns, you can make a melee spell attack with the lance against a creature within 20 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d6} Force damage. If the target is protected by a spell of level 3 or lower that creates a force effect on it (such as {@spell Shield|XPHB} or {@spell Mage Armor|XPHB}), that spell ends.

spell.name: Thunderous Roar
entries: A deafening blast of sound, audible for 600 feet, erupts at a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered there makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d6} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Tidal Surge
entries: You create a huge wave of water that slams into creatures within range. If a river, lake, or ocean is within range, the wave strikes each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose. Otherwise, it strikes only one creature you can see within range. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 8d8} Bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 30 feet in a direction you choose. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
The wave extinguishes nonmagical flames in the area and on affected creatures. It can push creatures into water.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Tiger's Tooth
entries: You touch one willing creature with natural weapons or Unarmed Strikes. For the duration, those attacks are magical and the creature gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with them.

spell.name: Tortoise Shell
entries: A creature you touch gains a hardened carapace. For the duration, the target's Armor Class can't be lower than 20 regardless of armor worn, but its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

spell.name: Touch of Madness
entries: You touch a Humanoid, which makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, its mind clouds and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for the duration. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Towering Oak
entries: You loom over others like a mighty tree. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks and on Strength checks.

spell.name: Train Animal
entries: You touch a willing Beast. For the duration, it can perform up to five simple tricks of your choice (such as fetch, guard, or attack on command), as though it had been trained in them. The spell doesn't change the Beast's attitude toward you, and it doesn't guarantee cooperation.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The number of tricks increases by one for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Transcribe Symbol

components.m: a piece of slate scoured smooth on one side

entries: You touch an untriggered magical sigil (such as one made by {@spell Glyph of Warding|XPHB} or {@spell Symbol|XPHB}) and make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check against DC 15 plus the sigil's spell level. On a failure, the sigil triggers. On a success, you lift the sigil from its location and hold it as magical potential in your hand.

As an action, you can place the sigil on a surface (not a creature) where it could normally be inscribed. It then works normally, keeping its original trigger conditions. If your concentration ends or the spell ends while you still hold the sigil, it triggers on you alone, with its normal saving throw.

spell.name: Transfix
entries: Choose a point within range and a condition that will end the spell (such as "wait here until the dragon arrives"). Each Medium or smaller Humanoid in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered there makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition, knows the condition, and can't communicate it. It repeats the save at the end of every hour, and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.
Any Medium or smaller Humanoid that enters the Sphere later must also make the save. A creature removed from the Sphere is freed. The effect ends on the creature when the chosen condition is met.

spell.name: Translocation Trick
entries: You and one creature you can see within range swap places, as if using {@spell Dimension Door|XPHB}, and each of you takes on the appearance of the other, as if using {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}. An unwilling target makes a Wisdom saving throw, and the spell fails if it succeeds. The spell also fails if the two of you are too different in body type for {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} to mimic.
True Seeing and similar effects reveal the true identities. When the spell ends, you revert to your true appearances where you stand; you don't switch places again.

spell.name: Transmute Rock to Lava
entries: You transform natural, unworked rock in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range into molten lava. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 10d10} Fire damage and is trapped in the lava; on a successful save, it takes half as much damage and moves to the nearest unoccupied space outside the lava.

A creature in the lava has its Speed reduced to 5 feet, has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws, and takes {@damage 6d10} Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature that enters the lava takes the same damage. Wooden structures touching the lava ignite, and worked stone adjacent to it takes 10d6 Fire damage per round. Worked or magical stone can't be targeted.
The lava cools and reverts to stone when the spell ends.

spell.name: Traveler's Mount
entries: You touch a willing Beast. For the duration, its Speed increases by 20 feet, and it can travel at a Fast pace for the entire duration without suffering any ill effects. While it carries a rider, it can't make attacks, but it willingly bears its rider into battle.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Beast for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Treasure Scent
entries: For the duration, you can sense the presence of coins, precious metals and gems within 30 feet of you, and you know whether each source is copper, silver, gold, platinum or gems. You learn only the direction of each source, not its exact location, until you come within 5 feet of it, at which point you know its precise location.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

spell.name: Tremor
entries: You cause a minor quake in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point on the ground within range. The quake isn't strong enough to damage structures. The ground in the area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB|Difficult Terrain} for the duration.

When you cast the spell and at the start of each of its turns, each creature on the ground in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. A creature that is Prone from this spell has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} until the start of its next turn.

spell.name: Tremorsense

components.m: a fleck of skin from a creature that has tremorsense

entries: For the duration, you have {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet, automatically pinpointing the location of any creature or object within that range that is in contact with the ground.

spell.name: True Creation

m.text: a small piece of the same matter as the object you plan to create, worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You create a nonmagical, nonliving object of any sort of matter that appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. The object must fit within a 5-foot Cube and can't be worth more than 5,000 gp. To create a complex object, such as a crafted weapon or a cut gem, you must be proficient with the appropriate Artisan's Tools; otherwise you can create only raw or simple objects.
The object is permanent and can't be negated or dispelled. For all purposes it is completely real, and unlike objects made by {@spell Creation|XPHB}, it can be used as a material component.

spell.name: True Domination
entries: You attempt to seize control of a Humanoid you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for the duration, and you establish a telepathic link with it. You know what it experiences, though you receive no direct sensory input from it. While the link lasts and you and the target are on the same plane, you can issue commands (no action required) from any distance, and the target does its best to obey. If it doesn't share a language with you, you can communicate only basic commands such as "Come here" or "Fight."

Each time you command the target to do something clearly against its nature, it repeats the saving throw with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, and a clearly self-destructive command is ignored on a success. {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB} on the target prevents you from using the link or commanding it while the ward lasts, but doesn't end the spell.

spell.name: Tunnel Swallow

components.m: a lump of chewed vegetable or meat

entries: You cause a section of tunnel or corridor within range, up to 20 feet in diameter and 50 feet long, to convulse and drive its contents along its length in a direction you choose. Each creature and object in the section makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d8} Bludgeoning damage and is moved to a point just outside the section at the end you chose. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is moved halfway toward that end. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.
The spell works on worked and natural tunnels and on corridors in buildings, and it doesn't harm the structure.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d8|6-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Unbinding

components.m: a lodestone and a pinch of saltpeter

entries: A wave of liberating force bursts from you in a 180-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. Anything you carry or wear and every effect on you is unaffected, but everything else in the area is subject to the following, with no regard to your wishes, including the effects of your allies:
{@b Charm and Hold.} Every spell of level 8 or lower that has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition as an effect on a creature in the area ends.

{@b Closures and Barriers.} Magical locks and seals, such as those from {@spell Arcane Lock|XPHB}, end, as do spells that create a physical or magical barrier, such as {@spell Wall of Fire|XPHB}, {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}, {@spell Forcecage|XPHB}, {@spell Guards and Wards|XPHB} and {@spell Slow|XPHB}. A {@spell Magic Circle|XPHB} holding a creature is dispelled, and {@spell Magic Jar|XPHB} is shattered, destroying the life force within. Opening a lock or closure this way triggers any alarms or traps attached to it.

{@b Stored Magic.} Any spell that holds magical effects, such as {@spell Magic Mouth|XPHB}, {@spell Glyph of Warding|XPHB} or {@spell Contingency|XPHB}, immediately releases them at a range of 0 feet.
{@b Curses.} A curse or {@spell Geas|XPHB} ends if it was created by a spell of level 8 or lower.

The spell doesn't affect {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Shield|XPHB}, {@spell Globe of Invulnerability|XPHB} or similar protective spells, doesn't free creatures bound to service (such as familiars or summoned creatures), doesn't restore {@condition Petrified|XPHB} creatures, and neither affects nor penetrates an {@spell Antimagic Field|XPHB}. Released creatures might not be friendly to you.

spell.name: Undead Bane Weapon
entries: You touch a weapon (or up to 20 pieces of ammunition that are in contact with each other). For the duration, the weapon is magical and deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage to Undead on a hit. Ammunition loses this property after it hits or misses a target. The spell has no effect on a weapon that already has this property, and it ends early if you cast it again.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The extra damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Undead Torch

components.m: a living or dead firefly or glowworm

entries: Choose up to three Undead you can see within range that are willing or under your control, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. Once on each of its turns, when a target hits a creature that isn't Undead with a melee attack, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Fire damage.

If a target is destroyed, spectral flames continue to burn in its space (a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}) for the rest of the duration. A creature that isn't Undead takes {@damage 2d6} Fire damage the first time it enters the flames on a turn or ends its turn there. If a target becomes incorporeal or gaseous, the spell ends for it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional Undead for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Undeath's Eternal Foe
entries: You choose up to four creatures you can see within range. For the duration, each target gains the following benefits:
{@b Death Ward.} The first time a target would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, it instead drops to 1 Hit Point and the effect of this benefit ends for it.

{@b Undead Warding.} The target has immunity to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions and to disease from Undead, can't have its Hit Point maximum reduced by Undead, and has a +2 bonus to AC against attacks made by Undead.
{@b Undead Slayer.} The target's attacks count as magical and can harm incorporeal and ethereal Undead without penalty.

spell.name: Undermaster

m.text: a deep blue spinel worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You take up the mantle of the earth, gaining mastery over it while you are standing on or beneath the ground. For the duration, on each of your turns you can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cast one of the following spells without expending a spell slot or using components, using your spell save DC: Bones of the Earth, {@spell Earthquake|XPHB}, Erupting Earth, {@spell Flesh to Stone|XPHB}, Maximilian's Earthen Grasp, {@spell Meld into Stone|XPHB}, {@spell Move Earth|XPHB}, {@spell Reverse Gravity|XPHB}, {@spell Stone Shape|XPHB}, Transmute Rock or {@spell Wall of Stone|XPHB}.

A spell cast this way uses its lowest level, and it takes an action to cast even if it normally takes longer. If it requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, you don't need to concentrate on it separately, and it ends when this spell ends. Only one spell cast this way that would require Concentration can be active at a time; if you cast another such spell, the earlier one ends.

spell.name: Undersong
entries: A song comes to mind that helps you keep your focus. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

spell.name: Unluck

components.m: a piece of a broken mirror

entries: You skew the fortunes of a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the first {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} it makes on each round (including attack rolls and saving throws) is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. A creature carrying a Stone of Good Luck is immune to this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Unyielding Roots
entries: You touch a willing creature that is standing on or touching the ground. Roots anchor it for the duration: its Speed is 0, and it can't be moved from its space or knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB} by any effect short of a massive earthquake. The roots also feed the creature: at the start of each of its turns it regains 20 Hit Points, ends the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition, and reduces its Exhaustion level by 1. It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution and Wisdom saving throws and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.

spell.name: Updraft
entries: Rushing air propels you 30 feet straight up, after which you float gently back down, taking no fall damage as if under {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB}. While descending, you can move up to 10 feet horizontally.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The height increases by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Valiant Fury
entries: A willing creature you can see within range surges with valor. For the duration, it gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to 15 when the spell is cast, has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks, Strength saving throws and Wisdom saving throws, and, when it takes the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, can make one additional attack with a weapon it holds as part of that action. This extra attack doesn't stack with the benefit of {@spell Haste|XPHB}.

spell.name: Veil of Shadow
entries: Swirling wisps of darkness obscure you. For the duration, attack rolls against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, even if the attacker has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks while in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or Darkness. The spell ends if you enter sunlight or an area of light created by a spell of level 3 or higher. {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB} doesn't counter it, but {@spell True Seeing|XPHB} does.

spell.name: Veil of Undeath
entries: You take on the traits of the undead. For the duration, you have Immunity to Poison damage and to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions, you suffer no effects from Exhaustion or disease, and critical hits against you are normal hits. You don't need to breathe, eat or sleep.

Like an undead creature, you are harmed by healing and healed by harm: when you would regain Hit Points from a spell, you take that amount of Necrotic damage instead, and when you would take Necrotic damage, you regain that many Hit Points instead. You don't gain the Undead creature type.

spell.name: Vigor
entries: You touch a creature. For the duration, it gains 3 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the creature has 0 Hit Points when you cast this spell, it becomes {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}. A creature can't benefit from more than one casting of this spell at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The Temporary Hit Points increase by 2 for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Vigorous Circle
entries: Choose up to six creatures you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. For the duration, each target regains 6 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns, and if it has 0 Hit Points when you cast the spell, it becomes {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}. The spell doesn't restore Hit Points lost to starvation, thirst or suffocation, nor does it regrow or reattach lost body parts. Vigor spells don't stack; only the highest-level effect applies.

spell.name: Vine Mine
entries: You create and direct rapid vine growth in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point within range. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following effects:
{@b Climbing Aid.} The vines act as knotted ropes. Creatures climbing in the area don't need to make checks to do so and don't spend extra movement.

{@b Bind Helpless Targets.} Each {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} creature in the area has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. A restrained creature can escape by succeeding on a DC 25 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check.
{@b Hamper Movement.} The area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB|Difficult Terrain}.
{@b Camouflage.} Creatures in the area have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks to hide in the vines.
As a Bonus Action, you can redirect the vines' growth, choosing a different effect.

spell.name: Vipergout
entries: Vipers leap forth from your mouth to attack your enemies. When you cast the spell, you spit forth {@dice 1d4+1} Poisonous Snakes, which appear in unoccupied spaces adjacent to you. Choose a celestial or fiendish aspect for them; they gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, and Lightning damage (celestial) or to Acid and Fire damage (fiendish).

The snakes are allies to you and your allies. In combat, they share your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count but take their turns immediately after yours. They obey your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don't issue any, they take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and use their movement to avoid danger. A snake disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You spit forth one additional snake for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Viscid Glob

components.m: a tiny ball of spider silk

entries: You toss a ball of silk into the air, and it turns into a 5-foot-wide glob of green-gray goo that rockets toward a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a Medium or smaller target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and a Large or larger target has its Speed reduced to 0. The target can speak and take purely mental actions while stuck. At the end of each of its turns and as an action, it can make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing itself from the goo on a success. The goo dissipates when the duration ends.

spell.name: Vision of Glory
entries: You give a creature you touch a brief vision of a divine entity offering support. Once before the spell ends, the creature can add your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum +1) to one saving throw it makes. It must decide to do so before rolling. Using the bonus ends the spell.

spell.name: Voice of the Dragon
entries: You gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks for the duration, and you can speak and understand Draconic.

Once before the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to cast {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} without expending a spell slot or requiring Concentration, using your spell save DC. Doing so ends this spell, but the suggestion lasts for its normal duration.

spell.name: Vortex of Teeth
entries: A whirling hollow cylinder of snapping teeth made of force appears, centered on a point within range. The vortex is a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}, but a 5-foot-radius circle at its center is a safe zone that takes no damage. Each creature in the area when the vortex appears and at the start of each of its turns makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. This damage affects creatures without regard to whether they are incorporeal.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Wail of Doom
entries: You loose a wail of excruciating pain. Each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is Frightened until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|5-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 5.

spell.name: Wall of Dispel Magic
entries: You create a transparent, permeable barrier of dispelling energy. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, and it can be shaped as a straight line or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter. Each creature or object that enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is the target of a {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} effect cast with a level 4 spell slot, using your spellcasting ability for any ability check it requires. A creature summoned by a spell of level 4 or lower is dispelled (it disappears). A creature or object can be affected by the wall only once per turn. The wall can't be seen or felt by ordinary means, but {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} reveals it and {@spell True Seeing|XPHB} lets you see it.

spell.name: Wall of Gears
entries: You create a wall of moving iron cogs, wheels, gears, and pistons on a solid surface within range. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 6 inches thick, and it can be shaped as a straight line or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter. Each 10-foot section has AC 19, 90 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.

Both sides of the wall have hundreds of flailing moving parts. Each creature within 10 feet of the wall when it appears and at the start of each of its turns makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 7d6} Slashing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 7d6|6-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 6.

spell.name: Wall of Gloom

components.m: a bit of fleece from a black sheep

entries: You create a barrier of ominous shadow on a solid surface within range. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. It is insubstantial, so creatures can move through it without penalty, but its space is Heavily Obscured, and it blocks line of sight, including {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}. Magical light created by a spell of level 2 or lower can't illuminate the wall's space.

spell.name: Wall of Greater Dispel Magic
entries: You create a transparent, permeable barrier of potent dispelling energy. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, and it can be shaped as a straight line or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter. Each creature or object that enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is the target of a {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} effect cast with a level 7 spell slot, using your spellcasting ability for any ability check it requires. A creature summoned by a spell of level 7 or lower is dispelled (it disappears). A creature or object can be affected by the wall only once per turn. The wall can't be seen or felt by ordinary means, but {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} reveals it and {@spell True Seeing|XPHB} lets you see it.

spell.name: Wall of Limbs
entries: An immobile, vertical curtain of whirling limbs resembling your own forelimbs springs into existence at a point within range. The wall is up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ring up to 20 feet in diameter. It provides {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} to attacks made through it.

When the wall appears, each creature in its space makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 5d6} Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition (see below); on a successful save, it is moved to the side of the wall of its choice and takes no damage. A creature that enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn, or that starts its turn within 5 feet of the wall, makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled in, takes {@damage 5d6} Bludgeoning damage, and is Restrained.

A Restrained creature in the wall takes {@damage 5d6} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns. It can end the condition by succeeding on a Strength check against your spell save DC (no action required on its turn), or when a 5-foot section of the wall (AC 10) takes 30 damage.

spell.name: Wall of Smoke
entries: You create a thin wall of black smoke on a solid surface within range. The wall is up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. Its space is Lightly Obscured. When a creature enters the wall's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw, and on a failed save it has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
A moderate wind, such as that created by {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}, destroys the wall. The spell fails if cast underwater.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The wall's length increases by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: War Cry
entries: You let out a thunderous battle cry. The next time you hit a creature with a melee attack before the end of your turn, after moving at least 10 feet in a straight line toward it on that turn, the attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Thunder damage, and the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

spell.name: Warning Shout

time.condition: which you take when you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}

entries: You shout a warning. Each ally of your choice within 30 feet of you doesn't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its Initiative roll for being Surprised. Any creature in the area that is sleeping naturally is awakened.

spell.name: Waterspout
entries: Water rises into a whirling Cylinder with a 5-foot radius and 80-foot height, centered on a point within range. As a Bonus Action, you can move the spout up to 30 feet in a direction you choose. If it moves beyond the spell's range, the spell ends.

A creature or object in the spout's space when it appears, or that the spout enters, or that starts its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d8} Bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature that fails is also sucked in and held suspended in the currents, having the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and taking {@damage 2d6} Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns. After {@dice 1d3} of your turns, the spout ejects the creature out of the top, and it falls to the ground. A creature can't be sucked in again by the same casting for 1 minute after being ejected.

spell.name: Wave of Grief
entries: A wave of despair washes over a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in the area makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature subtracts {@dice 1d4} from its attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks for the duration. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Weapon Shift

components.m: a piece of parchment folded into the shape of the desired weapon

entries: You touch one melee weapon that weighs 15 pounds or less and transform it into a different melee weapon of your choice for the duration. For example, a Greatclub could become a Greatsword or a Dagger could become a Battleaxe. The new weapon can't be a weapon with the Heavy property unless the original has it. A magic weapon retains its magic properties if they could apply to the new form, and a weapon made of a special material retains it. An unwilling creature's held or worn weapon makes a Constitution saving throw to resist; the spell ends if the weapon is destroyed.

spell.name: Weapon of Impact
entries: You touch a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, or up to fifty pieces of bludgeoning ammunition that are in contact with one another. For the duration, attack rolls made with the affected weapon or ammunition score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20. If you affect ammunition, the effect on a piece ends after it is used to make an attack, hit or miss. Other effects that expand a weapon's Critical Hit range don't stack with this spell.

spell.name: Weapon of the Deity
entries: You touch a weapon you are holding that is associated with your deity or faith. You can use the weapon as if you were proficient with it. Until the spell ends, the weapon is magical, you have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and it deals an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of a type chosen when you cast the spell: Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Radiant.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2 with a level 5 spell slot and to +3 with a level 7 or higher spell slot.

spell.name: Weather Eye

components.m: a small wind vane or a vial of rainwater

entries: You accurately predict the natural weather within 5 miles of you for the next 7 days. If unnatural forces, such as spells or other magical effects, currently affect the weather there, you learn which spells or abilities are in effect, though not their source.

spell.name: Whirling Blade

components.m: a melee weapon you are holding, which isn't consumed

entries: You hurl the weapon you used as the Material component along a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. Make a melee spell attack against each enemy in the Line. On a hit, a target takes damage as if you had hit it with the weapon, except you use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the damage. The weapon then flies back into your hand.

spell.name: Wild Runner
entries: You assume the form of a centaur. For the duration, you are a Large Monstrosity, your Speed becomes 50 feet, and your Strength score becomes 18 if it is lower. You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 60 feet, you can carry and drag twice as much as normal, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid being knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB}. You can fight effectively while carrying a rider. You retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, your equipment, and your ability to cast spells. If you drop to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends.

spell.name: Wind Tunnel
entries: You call on the wind to carry the aim of your allies' missiles. Choose up to five creatures you can see within range. For the duration, each target adds {@dice 1d6} to attack rolls it makes with ranged weapons, the normal and long ranges of those weapons are doubled, and the target ignores {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} from attacking at long range.

spell.name: Wind at Back
entries: Choose up to ten creatures you can see within range, no two of which are more than 30 feet apart. For the duration, the overland travel pace of the targets is doubled for travel they undertake together in the same direction. The spell also affects mounts and pack animals traveling with them, but not nonmagical cargo or vehicles, and it doesn't affect combat Speed.

spell.name: Wingbind
entries: A web of force surrounds one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for the duration, and if it was flying, it falls immediately, taking Falling damage as normal. The restrained target can use its action to make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check against your spell save DC, ending the effect on a success. The web is impervious to damage and to most spells, but {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} destroys it, as does a {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} cast with a level 8 or higher slot.

spell.name: Winged Mount
entries: You touch a willing mount that you have bonded with or are currently riding, such as a steed from {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}. For the duration, the mount has a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. Its Speed is reduced as normal by carried weight and barding.

spell.name: Wings of Air
entries: You touch a creature that can fly using wings. For the duration, the creature's Fly Speed increases by 10 feet, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws and Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks made while flying. The creature can't benefit from more than one casting of this spell at a time.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 4+ spell slot, the Fly Speed increase becomes 20 feet, and attack rolls made as {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} against the target have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

spell.name: Wings of the Sea
entries: You touch a creature. For the duration, the target's Swim Speed increases by 30 feet. If it has no Swim Speed, it gains a Swim Speed of 30 feet. The spell has no effect on other kinds of movement.

spell.name: Winter Chill
entries: One creature you can see within range makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} Cold damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Creatures immune to Cold damage are unaffected.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d6|1-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Winter's Embrace
entries: Bitter cold clings to one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns for the duration, taking {@damage 2d6} Cold damage on a failed save. After its second failed save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet for the duration. After its fourth failed save, it gains 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. The spell ends early if the target is immune to Cold damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d6|2-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Wither Limb
entries: You choose either the arms or the legs of a Humanoid you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, if you chose its legs, the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and its Speed becomes 5 feet; if you chose its arms, it can't use objects and can't cast spells that have a Somatic component. The effect lasts for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spell.name: Withering Palm
entries: Make a melee spell attack against a living creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 12d8} Necrotic damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have its Strength and Constitution scores reduced by {@dice 1d4} each until it finishes a Long Rest. On a Critical Hit, the reduction is {@dice 1d4+2} instead and lasts until {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} or similar magic ends it.

spell.name: Wood Rot

components.m: a pinch of sawdust and a drop of acid

entries: You touch a nonmagical wooden object or a plant creature, and rot spreads through it. Against an object, one of the following applies. Unattended Object: a nonmagical wooden object of Large size or smaller, or a 10-foot cube of a larger wooden object, is destroyed. Held Item: make a melee spell attack against a wooden weapon wielded by a creature, destroying it on a hit. Armor or Shield: make a melee spell attack against a creature wearing a wooden shield or armor; on a hit, its AC bonus from that item is reduced by {@dice 1d4} until repaired (a bonus reduced to 0 renders it unusable).
Against a Plant creature, make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Damage against a Plant creature increases by {@scaledamage 6d8|4-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Wood Wose
entries: You conjure a translucent green nature spirit in an unoccupied space you can see within range. It performs simple natural tasks at your command, such as building a campfire, gathering herbs, feeding an animal, or catching a fish. It can't do anything requiring knowledge of technology, such as opening a latched chest. It performs one activity at a time, repeating it until you tell it otherwise, as long as you remain within range.

The wose has Strength 2, can lift 20 pounds or drag 100 pounds, and has a Speed of 15 feet and a Fly Speed of 15 feet (hover). It can't attack, and it can't be harmed except by area effects: it disappears if it takes 6 or more damage from one. If you move more than 30 feet away from it, the spell ends.

spell.name: Word of Binding
