entries: Steel manacles form around a Medium or smaller Humanoid you can see within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, and it can't take actions that require its hands. The target or another creature within reach can use an action to make a DC 20 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, freeing the target on a success. The manacles have AC 19 and 15 Hit Points, vanishing at 0 Hit Points. The spell ends if the manacles are destroyed.

spell.name: Wounding Whispers
entries: Whispering, harmful sound surrounds you. For the duration, any creature that hits you with a melee attack, or touches you with its body or a handheld weapon, takes {@damage 1d6} Thunder damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Attackers using weapons with the Reach property aren't affected. You can't use this spell to deal damage in any other way.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 1d6|3-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Wrack
entries: You inflict excruciating pain on a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Prone|XPHB} conditions and is {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. When the spell ends, if the target failed its first save, it has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes.

spell.name: Wracking Touch
entries: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage, and it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage. If you have the Sneak Attack feature, you can add its extra damage to this attack even if you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on it and no ally is adjacent to the target; the target can't be immune to extra damage from Critical Hits to take it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 3d8|2-9|1d8} for each spell slot level above 2.

spell.name: Wraithstrike
entries: Your weapon strikes become spectral and slip through armor. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on melee attack rolls against a creature that is wearing armor or carrying a Shield.

spell.name: Wrathful Castigation

m.text: a small iron whip worth 100+ GP

entries: Wracking pain and convulsions seize one living creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and takes {@damage 3d8} Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. At the start of your next turn, it takes {@damage 8d10} Psychic damage; if this reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it dies. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the Incapacitated condition and the ongoing damage on itself on a success. On a successful save, the target makes a second Wisdom saving throw. On a failed second save, it has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws until the spell ends.

spell.name: Xorn Movement

components.m: a small piece of iron ore

entries: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target has a Burrow Speed equal to its Speed, can move through natural earth and stone (not worked stone, brick, or metal) leaving no tunnel or trace, and can breathe normally while entombed. If the target hasn't emerged into a space large enough for it when the spell ends, it is shunted to the nearest such space and takes {@damage 1d6} Force damage per 5 feet traveled. If the {@spell Move Earth|XPHB} spell is cast on an area the target occupies flings it 30 feet and gives it the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn, unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw.

spell.name: Zeal
entries: Choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. For the duration, attack rolls made as Opportunity Attacks against you by creatures other than the chosen one have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. You can also move through the spaces of hostile creatures as if they were difficult terrain, provided you end each of your moves closer to the chosen creature than you started it. You can't end a move in a hostile creature's space.

spell.name: Zone of Respite
entries: You ward a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you against interplanar intrusion. Within the area, teleportation and planar travel don't function: spells such as {@spell Dimension Door|XPHB}, {@spell Teleport|XPHB}, and {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB}, and travel via the Astral Plane, the Ethereal Plane, or the Shadowfell, fail. Summoning spells (such as {@spell Conjure Elemental|XPHB}) also fail, though creatures summoned elsewhere can enter the area. Portals can't be created within the area, but existing portals are unaffected. Creatures from the Ethereal Plane or similar coexistent planes can't enter the corresponding area.

spell.name: Zone of Revelation
entries: A 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you choose within range becomes a zone of revelation. For the duration, creatures and objects in the area are visible: those that have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, or that are on coexistent planes such as the Ethereal Plane or Shadowfell, are made visible and Ethereal creatures can interact with the Material Plane while in it. The spell suppresses but doesn't end these effects; they resume once the creature or object leaves the area.
